author: charles-h-spurgeon
fields.title: Ebigambo eri Omulimi
fields.description: Wali weebuuzizza engeri ebintu ebya bulijjo eby'obulamu bw'oku nnimiro gye bisobola okulaga amazima ag'omwoyo amaziba? Mu Ebigambo eri Omulimi, Charles Spurgeon aggya ebyokuyigirako ebikwata ku mutima mu nsigo, mu ttaka, mu kukola, ne mu makungula, n'afuula obulamu bwa buli lunaku obw'oku nnimiro okuba okulowooza okw'amaanyi ku kwenenya, ku kisa, ne ku mulimu gwa Katonda mu mutima. Bikkula empapula zino oleke amagezi gaazo agataggwaawo gakusoomooze, gakugumye, era gasaanyeko okukkiriza kwo.

fields.title: Ennimiro y'Omugayaavu
fields.body_html:
ENNIMIRO Y'OMUGAYAAVU Ennyanjula Okuva mu nnimiro eyalagajjalirwa ne mu musuku ogwamenyeka, wava essomo erinoonyereza erikwata ku bugayaavu obw'omwoyo— tunuulira n'obwegendereza, olowooze n'amagezi, era oyige omugaso gw'obunyiikivu mu kuweereza Katonda n'obwesigwa.

Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, gyonna yali emeze amaggwa, obululu bwali bubisse ettaka lyayo, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese.

«Awo ne ndaba ne nkirowoozaako; nnatunula ne nfuna okuyigirizibwa.» — Engero 24:30–32 (ESV) Tewali kubuusabuusa nti Sulemaani oluusi yali asanyuka okwewulako ebyambalo bye eby'obwakabaka, okuva mu mpisa enkalubo ez'omu lubiri, n'atambula mu byalo nga tamanyiddwa. Ku lumu ku mirundi ng'egyo, yatunuulira ekisenge ekyamenyeka eky'akasaka akatono ak'omuntu munne. Ekintu kino kyalimu ekitundu ky'ettaka eryalimibwa n'olusuku lw'emizabbibu. Okutunula omulundi gumu kyamulaga nti kya mugayaavu eyakiragajjalira. Omuddo gwali gukuze nnyo ne gubikka ettaka lyonna. Okuva mu kulaba kuno, Sulemaani yafuna okuyigirizibwa. Abantu awamu bayiga amagezi bwe baba nga bakyalina amagezi. Eriiso ly'omuyiiya lilaba obulungi mu nsi kubanga alina obulungi mu birowoozo bye. «Alina alyongerwako,» era anaaba n'obungi, kubanga alikungula amakungula ne mu nnimiro ebisiddwako amaggwa n'obululu.

Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w'omuntu omu n'omulala mu ngeri gye bakozesaamu eriiso ery'omu birowoozo. Nnina ekitabo ekiyitibwa The Harvest of a Quiet Eye, era kirungi. Amakungula g'eriiso ery'emirembe gasobola okukungulwa mu nnimiro y'omugayaavu nga bwe gakungulwa mu nnimiro erabiriddwa obulungi. Bwe twali abaana abato, twayigirizibwa oluyimba oluto oluyitibwa Eyes and No Eyes. Lwalimu amazima mangi. Abantu abamu balina amaaso naye tebalaba, ekyenkanankana n'obutaba na maaso n'akatono. Naye abalala balina amaaso amawagguufu ku kuvumbula okuyigirizibwa. Abamu batunuulira waggulu kwokka, ate abalala balaba si kikuta kya kungulu kyokka wabula n'ensigo ennamu ey'amazima ekwekeddwa munda mu bintu eby'okungulu.

Tuyinza okusanga okuyigirizibwa buli wamu. Eri omutima ogw'omwoyo, obululu bulina ekigendererwa kyabwo n'omuddo gulina essomo lyagwo. Amaggwa n'emiddo tebyategekebwa kuyigiriza bantu boonoonyi?

Tebimera kuva mu ttaka okutulaga ekibi kye kikoze, n'ebibala ebivaamu bwe tusiga ensigo ez'obujeemu eri Katonda? «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi,» bw'ayogera Sulemaani. «Nakiraba ne nkirowoozaako; nnatunula ne nfuna okuyigirizibwa.» Kyonna ky'olaba, fuba okukirowoozaako n'obwegendereza, era toolikirabe bwereere.

Onoosanga ebitabo n'okubuulira buli wamu — mu nsi ne mu nnyanja, mu ttaka ne mu ggulu. Oyinza okuyiga okuva mu buli nsolo ennamu, ennyonyi, ekyennyanja, n'akawuka, ne mu buli kimera eky'omugaso oba ekitaliimu mugaso ekimera mu ttaka. Tuyinza n'okukuŋŋaanya ebyigisa eby'omuwendo okuva mu bintu bye tutayagala. Sulemaani mazima teyasiima maggwa na bululu ebyali bibisse olusuku, naye ate n'abisangamu okuyigirizibwa. Bangi baalumwa obululu, naye batono be babuyigiriza. Abamu balumizibwa amaggwa, naye wano waaliwo omu eyalongoosebwa gago. Amagezi galina engeri gye gakuuŋŋaanyizaamu ezabbibu okuva mu maggwa n'ettiini okuva mu bululu. Gaggya obulungi mu bimera ebirabika ng'ebitasanyusa era ebyokosa.

Teweemulugunyanga ku maggwa; wabula ganyweeze obulungi. Teweeruma bululu; bukwate nnyo era bukozese olw'obulamu bw'emmeeme yo.

Ebigezo n'ebizibu, okweraliikirira n'okutabulwa, obunyiikaavu obutono n'okumalibwa amaanyi, byonna bisobola okukuyamba bw'obikkiriza. Nga Sulemaani, bilabe era obirowoozeeko n'obwegendereza — bitunuulire era ofune okuyigirizibwa. Ffe kaakano, tujja kusooka kulowooza ku ngeri Sulemaani gy'annyonnyolamu omugayaavu: «muntu atalina magezi.» Eky'okubiri, tujja kwetegereza engeri gy'annyonnyolamu ettaka ly'omugayaavu: «gyonna yali emeze amaggwa; ettaka lyali libisse obululu.» Bwe tumala okulowooza ku nsonga zino zombi, tujja kukomekkereza nga tukuuŋŋaanya okuyigirizibwa ettaka lino eryalagajjalirwa lye liyinza okutuwa.

Okusooka, lowooza ku ngeri Sulemaani gy'annyonnyolamu omuntu omugayaavu. Sulemaani si muntu gwe twandiwakanyizza, kubanga yalina amagezi mangi, era yawandiika ng'aluŋŋamizibwa Katonda mu Kitabo ky'Engero. Sulemaani agamba nti omugayaavu «muntu atalina magezi.» Naye omugayaavu takirowooza bwe kityo.

Ateeka emikono gye mu nsawo, era ng'olaba obwesige bwe, oyinza okulowooza nti ye nannyini Bbanka ya Bungereza. Alabika ng'omugezi nnyo mu ndowooza ye, era yeeyisa mu ngeri egendereza okuwuniikiriza abalala olw'obusobozi bwe bw'alowoolereza. Amagezi gano bwe yagafuna kizibu kwogera. Talina we yeeraliikiririra kulowooza. Siyinza kugamba nti abuuka n'atuuka ku nsonga, kubanga tabuuka n'akatono; abeera atereera mu zo n'obugayaavu. Naye akkiriza nti amanyi buli kimu era amaze okugonjoola buli nsonga.

Okufumiitiriza kikakubo nnyo gy'ali. Okuyiga kigambo ky'ataali mwetegefu kugumira.

Naye asanyukira okwerowooza nga mugezi obuzaaliranwa. Tayagala kumanya kusinga ky'amaze okumanya, kubanga mu ndowooza ye amanyi bimala — newankubadde nga mu mazima tamanyi kintu.

Olugero teluwaana, naye Sulemaani yali mutuufu okumuyita «muntu atalina magezi.»

Okusinziira ku mpisa z'ab'ekiseera kino, kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekikakanyavu, naddala olw'okuba omusajja yalina ennimiro n'olusuku. Ng'olugero bwe lugamba, «Bwe mba n'embalaasi n'ente, buli muntu ampa amalamusa g'enkya.»

Omuntu ayinza atya okugambibwa nti talina kutegeera ng'alina ettaka n'ebintu? Si kya bulijjo abantu okuteebereza nti amagezi g'omuntu gapimibwa n'obugagga bwe? Obugagga emirundi mingi buleeta ettendo olw'obusobozi obulowoolezebwa. Bw'etyo bwe mpisa ez'ensi.

Naye si mpisa z'Ebyawandiikibwa. Ka abe nga alina ennimiro n'olusuku oba nedda, Sulemaani agamba nti bw'aba mugayaavu, musirusiru — oba okwogera mu bwangu, talina kutegeera.

Si kyokka nti tategeera, naye era talina busobozi bwa kutegeera. Bw'aba mugayaavu, aba talina magezi mu mutwe. Ayinza okuyitibwa omwami. Ayinza okuba nannyini ttaka. Ayinza okuba n'olusuku n'ennimiro.

Naye ebintu bino tebimufuula mulungi kusinga. Mazima ddala, bimwongera bubi, kubanga muntu atalina magezi era noolwekyo tasobola kukozesa bulungi by'alina.

Nsanyuse nti Sulemaani atubuulira mu bwangu nti omugayaavu talina magezi, kubanga ekyo mawulire ga mugaso. Nsisinkanye abantu abaakkiriza nti bategeera bulungi ddala enjigiriza ez'ekisa. Baali basobola okunnyonnyola bulungi okulondebwa kw'abatukuvu, okuteekateeka kwa Katonda okw'edda, obukakafu bw'ekiragiro kya Katonda, obwetaavu bw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo, n'enjigiriza zonna ez'ekitiibwa ezizimba omuzimbe gw'okukkiriza kwaffe.

Naye okuva mu mazima gano baamaliriza nti tebalina kya kukola, bwe batyo ne bafuuka bagayaavu.

Obutakola kintu bwe bwafuuka enzikiriza yaabwe. Tebaali bakubiriza balala kukolerera Mukama kubanga baagamba nti, «Katonda ajja kukola omulimu gwe. Obulokozi bwonna bwa kisa.»

Endowooza yaabwe yali nti omuntu ateekwa kulindirira busa n'atakola kintu — atuule kyenkalu, aleke omuddo gukule gutuuke ku bikakala bye ng'asuubira obuyambi obw'omu ggulu. Okwesiimuula, mu ndowooza yaabwe, kyandidaganyizza ekigendererwa kya Katonda eky'olubeerera.

Mmanyi omuntu ng'oyo ng'atunula bubi, ng'anyeenya omutwe gwe ogukaddiye, ng'ayogera n'obukambwe ku bakkiriza abanyiikivu abaali bagezaako okukyusa emmeeme. Namulabye ng'amalamu abavubuka amaanyi era, ng'ennyondo enzito ey'omuka egutowa, ng'abasesebbula ng'abayita abatali batuufu era abasirusiru.

Tunaagumira tutya okunenya kw'omuntu ng'oyo akakanyavu mu ndowooza? Tunaawona tutya omugayaavu ono eyeeyita omumanyirivu era anoonya ensobi? Sulemaani ajja okututaasa n'amusirisa ng'alangirira nti talina magezi. Ayinza okwerowooza nga ye kipimo ky'enjigiriza entuufu n'asalira buli muntu omusango, naye Sulemaani akozesa ekipimo ekirala n'agamba nti talina kutegeera. Ayinza okumanya enjigiriza, naye tagitegeera mu butuufu. Singa yagitegeera, yandimanye nti enjigiriza ez'ekisa zitutwala okunoonya ekisa enjigiriza ezo kye zirangirira.

Bwe tulaba Katonda ng'akola, tuyiga nti akolera mu ffe, si kutufuula bagayaavu, wabula «okwagala n'okukola olw'okusanyusa kwe okulungi» (Abafiripi 2:13, ESV). Okuteekateeka kwa Katonda abantu kitegeeza nti yabalondera «emirimu emirungi» (Abaefeso 2:10, ESV), balyoke boolese ettendo lye. Bwe nze oba ggwe tuggya mu njigiriza yonna — ka ebe ntuufu etya — okumaliriza nti tuyinza okuba abagayaavu abatafaayo ku bya Katonda, kale tetulina kutegeera. Tukozesa Enjiri obubi. Tutwala ekyategekebwa okuba ekyokulya ne tukifuula obutwa. Omugayaavu, ka abe mugayaavu mu bizinensi oba nga tafaayo ku mmeeme ye, muntu atalina magezi.

Nga etteeka erya bulijjo, tuyinza okupima okutegeera kw'omuntu ng'okusinziira ku mulimu gwe ogw'omugaso. Abamu beeyita «abasoma,» naye ate tebalima kintu. Endowooza nnyingi ez'ekiseera kino, nga bwe ndabye, ziri ng'eccupa ey'omukka — erabika ya kitiibwa, naye tezaala kya nnamaddala. Waliwo abantu abasobola okwekenneenya, okuwakana, okulongoosa, n'okuwakanya, naye mu kiseera kye kimu obusagwa bumera mu lusalosalo, n'ekyokulima kiddugala nga tekikozesebwa. Okumanya kwo, obuwangwa, oba okusoma bwe bitakutwala kuweereza Katonda mu ngeri ey'enkola mu mulembe gwo, kale tononnayiga Sulemaani ky'ayita amagezi. Toli nga oyo Omuweereddwa Omukisa — Amagezi agaafuuka omubiri — gwe kyawandiikibwako nti, «Yatambula ng'akola obulungi» (Ebikolwa 10:38, ESV).

Omugayaavu tafaanana Mulokozi waffe, eyagamba nti, «Kitange akola n'okutuusa kaakano, era nange nkola» (Yokaana 5:17, ESV). Amagezi ag'amazima ga nkola. Obuwangwa obw'obwereere bwogera bwogezi era buteesateesa kwokka.

Amagezi galima ennimiro yaago. Amagezi galima olusuku lwago. Amagezi galabirira ebirime byago. Amagezi gakozesa buli kimu obulungi. Buli atakola bw'atyo, ka abe n'okumanya kwonna kw'ayogera, muntu atalina magezi. Lwaki talina kutegeera? Si lwa kubanga alina emikisa gy'atakozesa? Olunaku lwe lutuuse era luyitawo, naye aleka essaawa nga ziyita obwereere. Ka buli omu ku ffe yeekebeere n'obunyiikivu. Nkozesa eddakiika nga bwe ziyita? Omusajja ono yalina olusuku naye n'atalulima. Yalina ennimiro naye n'atagirima. Tukozesa emikisa gyaffe? Buli omu ku ffe alina obusobozi obumu okuweereza Katonda. Tubukozesa?

Bwe tuba abaana be, tatutadde awo we tuteekwa okuba abataliimu mugaso. Atuwadde ekifo we tuyinza okwaka n'ekitangaala kye yatuwa, ka kibe akatawuliro akatono. Twaka? «Tusiga ku mabbali g'amazzi gonna»? Tusiga ensigo yaffe mu makya ne tutakomya mukono gwaffe akawungeezi? (Omubuulizi 11:6, ESV) Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, omusango Sulemaani gwe yasala guyimirira: omugayaavu muntu atalina magezi; muntu atalimu kutegeera. Omusajja ono yalina emikisa gy'atakozesa. Yalina n'obuvunaanyizibwa bw'atatuukiriza. Katonda bwe yawa buli Muyisirayiri ekitundu ky'ettaka, teyakigendereza kusigala nga kya matumbwe, wabula okulimibwa.

Katonda bwe yateeka Adamu mu nnimiro ya Adeni, tekyali kusiima bulungi bwayo bwokka, wabula «okugirima n'okugikuuma» (Olubereberye 2:15, ESV). Mu ngeri y'emu, ettaka lya buli Muyisirayiri lyategekebwa okutuuka ku kubala kwalyo okutuukiridde nga liyita mu mulimu ogw'obwesigwa. Obwannannyini bwaleeta obuvunaanyizibwa. Omugayaavu yalemererwa mu buvunaanyizibwa obwo, bw'atyo n'atagira kutegeera.

Omulimu gwo gwe guluwa? Kitaawe w'abaana? Mukama? Muweereza? Musumba? Musomesa? Mu mirimu gino olina ennimiro zo n'ensuku zo. Bw'olemererwa okuzikozesa obulungi, olagajjalira ekigendererwa ky'obulamu bwo era togwa ku kuyitibwa Katonda kw'akuwadde. Omulimi omugayaavu naye yalina obusobozi bw'atakozesa. Yandisobodde okulima ettaka lye singa yasalawo okukikola. Teyali mulwadde; yali mugayaavu buggayaavu olw'okwesalirawo.

Katonda tatwetaagisa kye tutalina. «Kyetaagisa ng'ekigero ky'omuntu ky'alina, si ng'ekyo ky'atalina» (2 Abakkolinso 8:12, ESV). Omuntu alina ttalanta bbiri tasuubirwa kuvaamu ttaano, wabula asuubirwa okukozesa ze zibbiri. Omugayaavu ono yagaana okugezaako ekyali mu maanyi ge mu ngeri eyeeyoleka. Bangi balina obusobozi obwebase. Abalala bakozesa ebirabo byabwe ku lwabwe bo mu kifo ky'okubikozesa oyo eyabibawa. Katonda bw'aba atuwadde amaanyi gonna ag'okukola obulungi, ka tugakozese. Ensi eno ekooye era mbi. Tetusaanira kukweka na kitangaala ky'akawuka akamasamasa mu kizikiza ekifaanana bwe kityo. Tetusaanira kumma na kigambo kimu eky'amazima mu nsi ejjudde obukyamu.

Ka eddoboozi lyaffe libe ddenzi litya, ka tuliyimuse olw'amazima n'obutuukirivu. Tuleme kubulwa kutegeera nga tulagajjalira emikisa, nga tuvuunika obuvunaanyizibwa, era nga tulemererwa okukozesa obusobozi bwaffe. Mu nsonga z'emmeeme, omugayaavu asingira ddala okubulwa amagezi, kubanga azannya n'ensonga ezeetaaga okwewaayo okusukkuludde.

Tewali we walimirako mutima gwo? Ekyokulima tekyamenyako ttaka likakanyavu ery'emmeeme yo? Ensigo ey'Ekigambo tewali we yasigibwako — oba teyameza mirandira?

Tewali we wafukiriranga amatabi amato ag'okwegomba? Tewali we wagezaako okukuula omuddo gw'ekibi? Ofaayo ku mubiri gwo ng'omala ebiseera mu maaso g'endabirwamu, naye n'olagajjalira emmeeme yo. Oyonja omubiri, oguli kumpi okuddayo mu nfuufu, ate emmeeme yo n'esigala nga tenaazibwa era nga terabiriddwa. Kuno kwe kusirusiru okusingira ddala. Oyo omugayaavu ku lusuku lw'omutima gwe mazima talina magezi.

Era bw'oba Omukristaayo, alokoddwa ddala, naye nga mugayaavu mu mulimu gwa Mukama, kale olaga okutegeera okutono. Bw'omanya akabi k'emmeeme ezibuze, oyinza otya obutafuba kuzitaasa? Ebiseera tebilwawo. Okufa tekulwawo. Ggeyeena talwawo. Setaani si mugayaavu. Amaanyi ag'ekizikiza gakola. Kale tuyinza tutya okuba abagayaavu ng'Omukama atutadde mu lusuku lwe? Bwe tuba twalokolebwa okwagala kwa Katonda okutaliiko kkomo, tetusaanira kwomeza na kwomezebwa mu kuweereza kwe? Entegeka y'ebintu yennyini yeetaagisa nti omuntu alokoddwa abe munyiikivu.

Omukristaayo omugayaavu mu buweereza tategeera ky'afiirwa. Ekitundu ekisinga obugagga eky'okussaakanya ne Katonda kwe kwewaayo eri Katonda n'omutima gumu. Abamu balina eddiini nga y'emala okuleeta okubuusabuusa oba baba nayo n'akatono. Boolesa okutya Katonda okutono, naye obujulizi obw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo butono. Twategekebwa kwoleka Kristo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, abamu bamuleetera obuvume. Bwe tulaba abaweereza abagayaavu, tuteebereza nti mukama waabwe naye ateekwa okuba atafaayo.

Ensi tereme kulowooza nti Kristo tafaayo ku kubonaabona oba talina bunyiikivu. Naye bayinza okulowooza bwe batyo singa abo abeeyita nti bamuweereza baba bagayaavu bugayaavu. Omugayaavu afiirwa ekitiibwa n'essanyu mu buweereza. Aswaza ensonga gy'ayogera nti ayagala era ateekera amaggwa ku mutto gwe ogw'okufiirako.

Ka kinywezebwe: omugayaavu, ka abe musumba, dikoni, oba Omukristaayo owa bwannannyini, muntu atalina magezi.

Kaakano, eky'okubiri, ka tulowooze ku ttaka ly'omugayaavu: «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, gyonna yali emeze amaggwa, obululu bwali bubisse ettaka lyayo, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese.» (Engero 24:30–31, ESV) Ettaka lijja kubala ekintu bulijjo. Ettaka erisaanira ennimiro oba olusuku lijja kubala ebibala eby'engeri emu. Mu ngeri y'emu, emitima gyaffe n'ebifo bye tukwatako bijja kubala ekintu. Tetuyinza kubeera nga tuli bwereere. Tujja kukola obulungi oba obubi.

Bw'oba mugayaavu mu mulimu gwa Kristo, oba munyiikivu mu gwa Setaani. Ng'ayebase, omugayaavu yalima amaggwa mu ngeri ennungi okusinga bwe yandikoze n'okufuba kwonna. Bwe tutabala ŋŋaano ku lwa Kristo, tujja kumeza muddo gusaanira kwokebwa kwokka. Emmeeme bw'etalimibwa ku lwa Katonda, ejja kubala ebibala byayo obuzaaliranwa.

Kale kibala ekyo eky'obuzaaliranwa kye kiruwa? Ekibi n'ennaku. Abaana bwe balekebwa nga tebatendekeddwa, bajja kubala ki? Ekibuga bwe kirekebwa nga tekiriimu Njiri, wajja kumeramu ki? Obumenyi bw'amateeka n'obuli. Wanaabangawo amakungula bulijjo. Bwe tuba abagayaavu, amakungula ago gajja kuba ga bulumi ne gye tuli ffe kennyini. Tewali awummulira bulungi ku maggwa. Bw'oba weebase, Setaani asiga. Bw'omma ensigo ennungi, ajja kumansa ensigo embi awatali kuziyizibwa. Okuva mu ekyo mujja kuvaamu okwejjusa, oboolyawo okw'olubeerera.

«Erikumeza amaggwa n'emiddo» (Olubereberye 3:18, ESV). Emirundi mingi ekimera ekibi kijja kuba kingi. Ettaka eddungi libala omuddo mungi bwe lilagajjalirwa. Omuntu eyandikoze bingi ku lwa Katonda ajja kukola obubi bungi bw'alekebwa nga mugayaavu. Ekisinga obulungi, bwe kilagajjalirwa, kifuuka ekisinga obubi. Bw'oyagala obulokozi, kwetaagisa okufuba okukulaga ekkubo. Naye bw'oyagala okubula, kyetaagisa kulagajjala kwokka: «Tuliwona tutya bwe tunaanyooma obulokozi obungi bwe butyo?» (Abaebbulaniya 2:3, ESV) Omugayaavu agamba nti, «Otulo otutono, okusumagira okutono, okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako» (Engero 24:33, ESV), n'amaggwa ne geeyongera obungi obutabalika ne gamuteekerateekera ebirumya bingi.

Nga bwe tutunuulira olusuku lw'omugayaavu, ka tutunuulire ne mu mutima gw'omugayaavu atatya Katonda. Tafaayo ku kwenenya na kukkiriza. Okulowoozeza ddala ku mmeeme ye oba ku bulamu obutaggwaawo kikakubo nnyo gy'ali. Ayagala okutwala obulamu mu ngeri ennyangu, «n'okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako.» Kiki ekimera mu birowoozo bye ne mu mpisa ze? Mu bamu ku bagayaavu bano ab'omwoyo, olaba obutamiivu, obutali bulongoofu, omululu, obusungu, amalala, n'emiddo n'obululu obulala bungi. Mu balala, obwonoonyi obweyoleka bwe butyo we buziyizibwa embeera ez'ekitiibwa, osangamu ebika by'ebibi eby'enjawulo. Omutima teguyinza kusigala bwereere. Oba Kristo oba Setaani ajja kuguba mu. Munnange, bw'oba tosazeewo ku lwa Katonda, toyinza kusigala wakati. Mu lutalo luno, buli muntu ayimirira oba awamu ne Katonda oba n'amuwakanya.

Toyinza kusigala ng'olupapula olwereere. Empandiika ya Setaani eyeeyoleka eri ku ggwe; toyinza kulaba bubonero? Okuggyako nga Kristo awandiise erinnya lye ery'ekisa ku lupapula, omukono gwa Setaani gusigalawo. Oyinza okugamba nti, «Sibeera mu kibi kya lwatu; ndi wa mpisa nnungi.» Naye singa oyekebejja omutima gwo n'obwegendereza, wandiraba obulabe eri Katonda n'amakubo ge. Toyagala tteeka lye, newaakubadde Omwana we, newaakubadde Enjiri ye. Wawukanye mu mutima, ojjudde ebirowoozo eby'obwereere n'okwegomba okukyamu.

Bino bijja kukula ne byeyongera ng'okyali omugayaavu mu mwoyo era ng'oleka omutima gwo nga tegulimibwa. Omwoyo gwa Katonda akuzuukuse. Akusiimuule okufumiitiriza okw'amaanyi era okunyiikivu.

Kale olaba nti ebimera bino ebyonoonyi biteekwa okusigulwa, nti omutima gwo guteekwa okumenyebwa okuyita mu kukwatibwa omusango, ne gusigibwa ensigo ennungi ey'Enjiri okutuusa lwe gubala amakungula ku lw'Omulimi omukulu. Munnange, bw'oba okkiriza Kristo, ka nange ntunuulire mu mutima gwo, naddala bw'oba Omukristaayo omugayaavu. Ntya nti obululu n'emiddo biyinza okuba nga bimera n'omwo. Saakuwulira ng'oyimba gyebuvuddeko, «Kino kye kigambo kye njagala nnyo okumanya»? Ekibuuzo ekyo kijja kukweraliikirizanga, kubanga okubuusabuusa kwangu okumera mu birowoozo ebigayaavu.

Sijjukira kusoma mu kitabo kya John Wesley eky'ennaku nti yabuusabuusa obulokozi bwe. Yali mutabuufu nnyo mu makungula ga Mukama we ne kitamujjira kubuusabuusa Katonda we.

Abakristaayo abamu balina okukkiriza okutono kubanga tebaasigako nsigo ya kaamulali gye baaweebwa.

Bw'otokozesa kukkiriza kwo, kuyinza kukula kutya? Okukkiriza bwe kukozesebwa n'obunyiikivu mu buweereza bwa Kristo, kusimba emirandira, ne kukula ne kuba kw'amaanyi, era oluvannyuma ne kuziyiza okubuusabuusa. Abalala babonaabonesebwa okuteebereza okubi. Bafuuka abatamativu, abanyiikaavu, ab'omululu, era abeemulugunya — emirundi mingi olw'okuba bagayaavu. Guno gwe muddo ogumera mu nnimiro y'omugayaavu.

Nnamanya abakkiriza abagayaavu ne bafuuka abanyiikaavu ennyo n'ekintu kyonna ne kitabasanyusa. Omukristaayo asinga obunyiikivu teyabamalanga. Abakkiriza abasinga okwagala tebaali baagalana bumala. Ekkanisa esinga obunyiikivu teyalina maanyi bumala. Baalabanga ensobi buli wamu, ne mu kifo Katonda gye yali akola mu bweyolefu. Omwoyo guno ogw'okunenya, okuwakana, n'okwemulugunya okutasalako, gwe gumu ku bululu obumera mazima ddala awali obugayaavu obw'omwoyo.

Omutima gwo bwe gutabala bibala ku lwa Katonda, mazima gujja kubala ekyonoona ggwe n'abalala.

Amaggwa emirundi mingi gatta ensigo ennungi, naye kya mukisa ensigo ennungi bw'ekula obungi ne etta amaggwa. Katonda asobozesa abakkiriza abamu okubala ebibala ennyo, ekiba nti Setaani bw'asiga omuddo, tegusobola kukula. Omwoyo Omutukuvu anafuya ekibi mu mutima kireme okwongera okufuga. Bw'oba omugayaavu, kebera ennimiro y'omutima gwo era onakuwalire ky'olaba.

Kaakano lowooza ku maka go. Nsonga nkulu omuntu bw'alemererwa okulima amaka ge ye.

Mu nnaku zange ez'edda, nnamanya omusajja eyanamperekeranga mu byalo gye nnabuuliranga. Nnasiima okubeera naye okutuusa lwe nnamumanya obulungi. Yamalanga buli kawungeezi ng'agenda mu nkuŋŋaana, naye n'alagajjalira abaana be abangi. Baakulira mu buvubuka obutatya Katonda kubanga kitaabwe teyanoonya kubakulembera eri Kristo. Obunyiikivu obw'ebweru bugasa ki singa waliwo obulagajjavu mu maka? Nga kya nnaku okugamba nti, «Olusuku lwange nze kennyini sirukuumye» (Oluyimba lwa Sulemaani 1:6, ESV).

Nnawulirako omusajja eyagaana okuyigiriza abaana be ku Katonda kubanga teyayagala kubakyamya ndowooza. Yayagala okubaleka basalewo eddiini yaabwe oluvannyuma. Omu ku batabani be yamenyeka omukono, era omusawo bwe yali agutereeza, omulenzi yali avuma. Omusawo n'ayogera nti, «Watya okukyamya mutabani wo eri obulungi, naye Setaani teyalina kubuusabuusa okufaanana ng'okwo.» Buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okulima ennimiro nga tugigasa ebirime ebirungi, oba mangu ejja kubikkibwa omuddo. Tendeka omwana eri obulungi, oba ye ajja kwewalula eri obubi mu buzaaliranwa. Nga bwe kiri mu maka, bwe kiri ne mu masomero. Omusajja eyavaako yeegatta ku kkanisa eno yali yabadde atakkiriza Katonda. Obutakkiriza bwe yabusinziza mu kitundu ku kye yayitamu mu ssomero.

Ku Ssande, abalenzi baateekebwanga mu kifo eky'ewala mu kkanisa gye baali tebayinza kuwulira kigambo. Baagumira okusaba okutaggwaawo, naye tewali kyakwata ku mitima gyabwe. Oluvannyuma, yakoowa eddiini nnyo ne yamalirira okugiva ku bwe yaba nga wa ddembe. Abasomesa ba Sande sukuulu balina okwegendereza.

Amasomo gasobola okukolebwa nga tegasanyusa n'abaana ne batandika okukyawa Ssande yennyini. Ebiseera bisobola okwonoonebwa awatali kuleeta mitima gya bato eri Kristo.

Abazadde abamu Abakristaayo, olw'obukambwe n'obutaba na kisa, basize ensigo z'obukyayi mu kifo ky'okwagala. Ka tubeere mu baana baffe mu ngeri gye baagalira si ffe fekka wabula ne Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Abazadde ka boolese okukkiriza okusanyufu era okwa mazima, abaana balyoke beegombe okugoberera ekyokulabirako kyabwe. Okukkiriza bwe kutafuga mu maka, tujja kulaba akavuyo, amalala, obusirusiru, n'entandikwa y'obwonoonyi. Amaka go galeme kufuuka nnimiro ya mugayaavu. Ka buli dikoni, omukulembeze w'ekibiina, n'omusumba yeekebejje ennimiro gy'akwasibbwa. Bwe tulagajjalira obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, tufuuka ng'emiti egitabala ebibala egikwata ekifo emiti egibala kye gyandikozesezza. Tujja kuziyiza mu kifo ky'okuyamba okuggyako nga tuwaayo obuweereza obwa nnamaddala. Kirowoozeeko n'amaanyi. Toyinza kusigala wakati. Bw'otobala magoba, oleeta okufiirwa. Katonda atuwe okufuuka abaweereza ab'amagoba.

Kaakano tunuulira ennimiro ennene ey'ensi. Laba nga bw'emeze amaggwa. Ebitundu ebinene bibisse obukyamu, obutakkiriza, n'eddiini ez'obulimba. Ensi ejjudde obukambwe, okujoogebwa, obutali bulongoofu, n'ennaku. Kino kituusibwa ku ki olw'ekkanisa envuvu? Emyaka nga enkumi bbiri giyiseewo, naye ekitundu ekinene eky'olusuku kikyameze amaggwa. Buli kkanisa we yakomya omulimu gw'obuweereza obw'obumisiyonaali, yakendeera. Bw'ekomya okuggyamu eddungu, efuuka ngumba yennyini. Mu kifo ky'okubuuza ekkanisa kye yakola mu myaka egyayita, ka twebuuze kye tunaakola kaakano.

Tujja kweyongera okulima ettaka lye limu emirundi n'emirundi ate ennimiro ennene nga zisigadde nga tezikwatiddwako? Katonda atuzuukuse okuva mu bugayaavu bwaffe. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, alipoota eyinza okuba nti: «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'ekkanisa envuvu, era gyonna yali emeze amaggwa.» Waliwo essomo wano. Bw'olekebwa yekka, obuntu bubala maggwa na bululu bwokka. Awatali kisa, kino kye kyokka kye twandibadde tuvaamu. Bwe kaakano tubala ebibala ebirungi, kyonna kiva ku kisa. Kale ka twoleke ekibala ky'ekisa mu bulamu bwaffe. Tunaaweereza Kristo n'obunyiikivu obutono okusinga bwe twaweereza ekibi? Tunaawaayo eri ye ebitono okusinga bwe twawaayo eri okwegomba kwaffe okw'edda? Omwoyo Omutukuvu abale ebibala ebingi mu ffe.

Tuyiga n'obwereere bw'ebigendererwa ebirungi awatali kikolwa. Omusajja ono bulijjo yateekateeka okukola nnyo ku lunaku olumu. Yagamba nti, «Otulo otutono, okusumagira okutono, okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako» (Engero 24:33, ESV). Okulwawo katono kwokka — n'oluvannyuma yandaba yatandika. Naye olunaku olwo terwajja. Bangi bawulira okubuulira okw'amaanyi ne bateekateeka okwanukula. Bateekateeka okukyukira Katonda «ku lunaku olumu.» Abamu balwawo emyaka amakumi ana. Olikyuka ddi? «Nga sinnafa,» bw'ogamba. Onookulwaza okutuusa ku ssaawa yo esembayo? Ekyo kya magezi? Oyinza okufa mangu. Obulamu tebwesigika. Weegendereze okulwawo okutono. Omaze kwonoona biseera bimala. Salawo kaakano. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuleete okusalawo.

«Mazima toziyiza nze okwongera otulo otutono?» bw'agamba omugayaavu. «Onzuukusizza mangu nnyo. Nsaba butulo bulala butono.» «Ggwe omusajja wange omwagalwa, obudde bwaka nnyo.» Addamu nti, «Obudde buyiseeko, mmanyi; naye tebujja kuyita nnyo bwe nzija okwebaka butulo bulala.» Omuzuukusa nate, n'omugamba nti buli ttuntu. Agamba nti, «Kino kye kiseera ekisinga okwokya olw'enku: nkakasa nti singa naba nzuukuse nandigenze ku ntebe ne nwummulako katono okuva ku njuba ey'okwokya.» Okonkona ku luggi lwe ng'obudde bunaatera okuziba, kale n'akaaba nti, «Tekugasa kugolokoka kaakano, kubanga obudde bunaatera okuggwaawo.»

Omujjukiza ennimiro ye eyameze amaggwa n'olusuku lwe olulimu omuddo, n'addamu nti, «Yee, nteekwa okugolokoka, mmanyi.» Yeenyeenya n'agamba nti, «Sirowooza nti kijja kukyusa kinene bwe nnindirira essaawa okukuba. Nzija kuwummulako eddakiika endala emu oba bbiri.»

Aliko ku kitanda kye ng'aliko lubambo, afudde ng'akyali mulamu, aziikiddwa mu bugayaavu bwe. Singa yandisobodde okwebaka emirembe gyonna yandikoze bw'atyo, naye tasobola, kubanga olunaku olw'omusango lulimuzuukusa. Kyawandiikibwa nti, «N'ali mu magombe, ng'abonyaabonyezebwa, n'ayimusa amaaso ge» (Lukka 16:23, ESV). Katonda abawe mmwe abagayaavu ab'omwoyo okuzuukuka nga luno terunnatuuka; naye temujja kuzuukuka okuggyako nga mwesiimuula mu kiseera, kubanga «kaakano ke kiseera ekisaanidde; laba, kaakano lwe lunaku olw'obulokozi» (2 Abakkolinso 6:2, ESV). Era kiyinza okuba kaakano oba tewali kiseera kirala.

Enkya esangibwa mu kalenda y'abasirusiru bokka; olwa leero lwe lunaku lw'omugezi, ekiseera ekyalondebwa ekya Katonda waffe ow'ekisa. Ayi singa Omwoyo Omutukuvu akutwala okukwata essaawa eno eriwo, olyoke amangu ago weewaayo eri Mukama olw'okukkiriza Kristo Yesu, n'oluvannyuma okuva mu lusuku lwe— «Mangu sigula Omuddo ogunyoomesa, oguyonja awatali magoba Obugimu bw'ettaka okuva mu bimera ebiramu.»
fields.body_text: ENNIMIRO Y'OMUGAYAAVU Ennyanjula Okuva mu nnimiro eyalagajjalirwa ne mu musuku ogwamenyeka, wava essomo erinoonyereza erikwata ku bugayaavu obw'omwoyo— tunuulira n'obwegendereza, olowooze n'amagezi, era oyige omugaso gw'obunyiikivu mu kuweereza Katonda n'obwesigwa. Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, gyonna yali emeze amaggwa, obululu bwali bubisse ettaka lyayo, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese. «Awo ne ndaba ne nkirowoozaako; nnatunula ne nfuna okuyigirizibwa.» — Engero 24:30–32 (ESV) Tewali kubuusabuusa nti Sulemaani oluusi yali asanyuka okwewulako ebyambalo bye eby'obwakabaka, okuva mu mpisa enkalubo ez'omu lubiri, n'atambula mu byalo nga tamanyiddwa. Ku lumu ku mirundi ng'egyo, yatunuulira ekisenge ekyamenyeka eky'akasaka akatono ak'omuntu munne. Ekintu kino kyalimu ekitundu ky'ettaka eryalimibwa n'olusuku lw'emizabbibu. Okutunula omulundi gumu kyamulaga nti kya mugayaavu eyakiragajjalira. Omuddo gwali gukuze nnyo ne gubikka ettaka lyonna. Okuva mu kulaba kuno, Sulemaani yafuna okuyigirizibwa. Abantu awamu bayiga amagezi bwe baba nga bakyalina amagezi. Eriiso ly'omuyiiya lilaba obulungi mu nsi kubanga alina obulungi mu birowoozo bye. «Alina alyongerwako,» era anaaba n'obungi, kubanga alikungula amakungula ne mu nnimiro ebisiddwako amaggwa n'obululu. Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w'omuntu omu n'omulala mu ngeri gye bakozesaamu eriiso ery'omu birowoozo. Nnina ekitabo ekiyitibwa The Harvest of a Quiet Eye, era kirungi. Amakungula g'eriiso ery'emirembe gasobola okukungulwa mu nnimiro y'omugayaavu nga bwe gakungulwa mu nnimiro erabiriddwa obulungi. Bwe twali abaana abato, twayigirizibwa oluyimba oluto oluyitibwa Eyes and No Eyes. Lwalimu amazima mangi. Abantu abamu balina amaaso naye tebalaba, ekyenkanankana n'obutaba na maaso n'akatono. Naye abalala balina amaaso amawagguufu ku kuvumbula okuyigirizibwa. Abamu batunuulira waggulu kwokka, ate abalala balaba si kikuta kya kungulu kyokka wabula n'ensigo ennamu ey'amazima ekwekeddwa munda mu bintu eby'okungulu. Tuyinza okusanga okuyigirizibwa buli wamu. Eri omutima ogw'omwoyo, obululu bulina ekigendererwa kyabwo n'omuddo gulina essomo lyagwo. Amaggwa n'emiddo tebyategekebwa kuyigiriza bantu boonoonyi? Tebimera kuva mu ttaka okutulaga ekibi kye kikoze, n'ebibala ebivaamu bwe tusiga ensigo ez'obujeemu eri Katonda? «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi,» bw'ayogera Sulemaani. «Nakiraba ne nkirowoozaako; nnatunula ne nfuna okuyigirizibwa.» Kyonna ky'olaba, fuba okukirowoozaako n'obwegendereza, era toolikirabe bwereere. Onoosanga ebitabo n'okubuulira buli wamu — mu nsi ne mu nnyanja, mu ttaka ne mu ggulu. Oyinza okuyiga okuva mu buli nsolo ennamu, ennyonyi, ekyennyanja, n'akawuka, ne mu buli kimera eky'omugaso oba ekitaliimu mugaso ekimera mu ttaka. Tuyinza n'okukuŋŋaanya ebyigisa eby'omuwendo okuva mu bintu bye tutayagala. Sulemaani mazima teyasiima maggwa na bululu ebyali bibisse olusuku, naye ate n'abisangamu okuyigirizibwa. Bangi baalumwa obululu, naye batono be babuyigiriza. Abamu balumizibwa amaggwa, naye wano waaliwo omu eyalongoosebwa gago. Amagezi galina engeri gye gakuuŋŋaanyizaamu ezabbibu okuva mu maggwa n'ettiini okuva mu bululu. Gaggya obulungi mu bimera ebirabika ng'ebitasanyusa era ebyokosa. Teweemulugunyanga ku maggwa; wabula ganyweeze obulungi. Teweeruma bululu; bukwate nnyo era bukozese olw'obulamu bw'emmeeme yo. Ebigezo n'ebizibu, okweraliikirira n'okutabulwa, obunyiikaavu obutono n'okumalibwa amaanyi, byonna bisobola okukuyamba bw'obikkiriza. Nga Sulemaani, bilabe era obirowoozeeko n'obwegendereza — bitunuulire era ofune okuyigirizibwa. Ffe kaakano, tujja kusooka kulowooza ku ngeri Sulemaani gy'annyonnyolamu omugayaavu: «muntu atalina magezi.» Eky'okubiri, tujja kwetegereza engeri gy'annyonnyolamu ettaka ly'omugayaavu: «gyonna yali emeze amaggwa; ettaka lyali libisse obululu.» Bwe tumala okulowooza ku nsonga zino zombi, tujja kukomekkereza nga tukuuŋŋaanya okuyigirizibwa ettaka lino eryalagajjalirwa lye liyinza okutuwa. Okusooka, lowooza ku ngeri Sulemaani gy'annyonnyolamu omuntu omugayaavu. Sulemaani si muntu gwe twandiwakanyizza, kubanga yalina amagezi mangi, era yawandiika ng'aluŋŋamizibwa Katonda mu Kitabo ky'Engero. Sulemaani agamba nti omugayaavu «muntu atalina magezi.» Naye omugayaavu takirowooza bwe kityo. Ateeka emikono gye mu nsawo, era ng'olaba obwesige bwe, oyinza okulowooza nti ye nannyini Bbanka ya Bungereza. Alabika ng'omugezi nnyo mu ndowooza ye, era yeeyisa mu ngeri egendereza okuwuniikiriza abalala olw'obusobozi bwe bw'alowoolereza. Amagezi gano bwe yagafuna kizibu kwogera. Talina we yeeraliikiririra kulowooza. Siyinza kugamba nti abuuka n'atuuka ku nsonga, kubanga tabuuka n'akatono; abeera atereera mu zo n'obugayaavu. Naye akkiriza nti amanyi buli kimu era amaze okugonjoola buli nsonga. Okufumiitiriza kikakubo nnyo gy'ali. Okuyiga kigambo ky'ataali mwetegefu kugumira. Naye asanyukira okwerowooza nga mugezi obuzaaliranwa. Tayagala kumanya kusinga ky'amaze okumanya, kubanga mu ndowooza ye amanyi bimala — newankubadde nga mu mazima tamanyi kintu. Olugero teluwaana, naye Sulemaani yali mutuufu okumuyita «muntu atalina magezi.» Okusinziira ku mpisa z'ab'ekiseera kino, kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekikakanyavu, naddala olw'okuba omusajja yalina ennimiro n'olusuku. Ng'olugero bwe lugamba, «Bwe mba n'embalaasi n'ente, buli muntu ampa amalamusa g'enkya.» Omuntu ayinza atya okugambibwa nti talina kutegeera ng'alina ettaka n'ebintu? Si kya bulijjo abantu okuteebereza nti amagezi g'omuntu gapimibwa n'obugagga bwe? Obugagga emirundi mingi buleeta ettendo olw'obusobozi obulowoolezebwa. Bw'etyo bwe mpisa ez'ensi. Naye si mpisa z'Ebyawandiikibwa. Ka abe nga alina ennimiro n'olusuku oba nedda, Sulemaani agamba nti bw'aba mugayaavu, musirusiru — oba okwogera mu bwangu, talina kutegeera. Si kyokka nti tategeera, naye era talina busobozi bwa kutegeera. Bw'aba mugayaavu, aba talina magezi mu mutwe. Ayinza okuyitibwa omwami. Ayinza okuba nannyini ttaka. Ayinza okuba n'olusuku n'ennimiro. Naye ebintu bino tebimufuula mulungi kusinga. Mazima ddala, bimwongera bubi, kubanga muntu atalina magezi era noolwekyo tasobola kukozesa bulungi by'alina. Nsanyuse nti Sulemaani atubuulira mu bwangu nti omugayaavu talina magezi, kubanga ekyo mawulire ga mugaso. Nsisinkanye abantu abaakkiriza nti bategeera bulungi ddala enjigiriza ez'ekisa. Baali basobola okunnyonnyola bulungi okulondebwa kw'abatukuvu, okuteekateeka kwa Katonda okw'edda, obukakafu bw'ekiragiro kya Katonda, obwetaavu bw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo, n'enjigiriza zonna ez'ekitiibwa ezizimba omuzimbe gw'okukkiriza kwaffe. Naye okuva mu mazima gano baamaliriza nti tebalina kya kukola, bwe batyo ne bafuuka bagayaavu. Obutakola kintu bwe bwafuuka enzikiriza yaabwe. Tebaali bakubiriza balala kukolerera Mukama kubanga baagamba nti, «Katonda ajja kukola omulimu gwe. Obulokozi bwonna bwa kisa.» Endowooza yaabwe yali nti omuntu ateekwa kulindirira busa n'atakola kintu — atuule kyenkalu, aleke omuddo gukule gutuuke ku bikakala bye ng'asuubira obuyambi obw'omu ggulu. Okwesiimuula, mu ndowooza yaabwe, kyandidaganyizza ekigendererwa kya Katonda eky'olubeerera. Mmanyi omuntu ng'oyo ng'atunula bubi, ng'anyeenya omutwe gwe ogukaddiye, ng'ayogera n'obukambwe ku bakkiriza abanyiikivu abaali bagezaako okukyusa emmeeme. Namulabye ng'amalamu abavubuka amaanyi era, ng'ennyondo enzito ey'omuka egutowa, ng'abasesebbula ng'abayita abatali batuufu era abasirusiru. Tunaagumira tutya okunenya kw'omuntu ng'oyo akakanyavu mu ndowooza? Tunaawona tutya omugayaavu ono eyeeyita omumanyirivu era anoonya ensobi? Sulemaani ajja okututaasa n'amusirisa ng'alangirira nti talina magezi. Ayinza okwerowooza nga ye kipimo ky'enjigiriza entuufu n'asalira buli muntu omusango, naye Sulemaani akozesa ekipimo ekirala n'agamba nti talina kutegeera. Ayinza okumanya enjigiriza, naye tagitegeera mu butuufu. Singa yagitegeera, yandimanye nti enjigiriza ez'ekisa zitutwala okunoonya ekisa enjigiriza ezo kye zirangirira. Bwe tulaba Katonda ng'akola, tuyiga nti akolera mu ffe, si kutufuula bagayaavu, wabula «okwagala n'okukola olw'okusanyusa kwe okulungi» (Abafiripi 2:13, ESV). Okuteekateeka kwa Katonda abantu kitegeeza nti yabalondera «emirimu emirungi» (Abaefeso 2:10, ESV), balyoke boolese ettendo lye. Bwe nze oba ggwe tuggya mu njigiriza yonna — ka ebe ntuufu etya — okumaliriza nti tuyinza okuba abagayaavu abatafaayo ku bya Katonda, kale tetulina kutegeera. Tukozesa Enjiri obubi. Tutwala ekyategekebwa okuba ekyokulya ne tukifuula obutwa. Omugayaavu, ka abe mugayaavu mu bizinensi oba nga tafaayo ku mmeeme ye, muntu atalina magezi. Nga etteeka erya bulijjo, tuyinza okupima okutegeera kw'omuntu ng'okusinziira ku mulimu gwe ogw'omugaso. Abamu beeyita «abasoma,» naye ate tebalima kintu. Endowooza nnyingi ez'ekiseera kino, nga bwe ndabye, ziri ng'eccupa ey'omukka — erabika ya kitiibwa, naye tezaala kya nnamaddala. Waliwo abantu abasobola okwekenneenya, okuwakana, okulongoosa, n'okuwakanya, naye mu kiseera kye kimu obusagwa bumera mu lusalosalo, n'ekyokulima kiddugala nga tekikozesebwa. Okumanya kwo, obuwangwa, oba okusoma bwe bitakutwala kuweereza Katonda mu ngeri ey'enkola mu mulembe gwo, kale tononnayiga Sulemaani ky'ayita amagezi. Toli nga oyo Omuweereddwa Omukisa — Amagezi agaafuuka omubiri — gwe kyawandiikibwako nti, «Yatambula ng'akola obulungi» (Ebikolwa 10:38, ESV). Omugayaavu tafaanana Mulokozi waffe, eyagamba nti, «Kitange akola n'okutuusa kaakano, era nange nkola» (Yokaana 5:17, ESV). Amagezi ag'amazima ga nkola. Obuwangwa obw'obwereere bwogera bwogezi era buteesateesa kwokka. Amagezi galima ennimiro yaago. Amagezi galima olusuku lwago. Amagezi galabirira ebirime byago. Amagezi gakozesa buli kimu obulungi. Buli atakola bw'atyo, ka abe n'okumanya kwonna kw'ayogera, muntu atalina magezi. Lwaki talina kutegeera? Si lwa kubanga alina emikisa gy'atakozesa? Olunaku lwe lutuuse era luyitawo, naye aleka essaawa nga ziyita obwereere. Ka buli omu ku ffe yeekebeere n'obunyiikivu. Nkozesa eddakiika nga bwe ziyita? Omusajja ono yalina olusuku naye n'atalulima. Yalina ennimiro naye n'atagirima. Tukozesa emikisa gyaffe? Buli omu ku ffe alina obusobozi obumu okuweereza Katonda. Tubukozesa? Bwe tuba abaana be, tatutadde awo we tuteekwa okuba abataliimu mugaso. Atuwadde ekifo we tuyinza okwaka n'ekitangaala kye yatuwa, ka kibe akatawuliro akatono. Twaka? «Tusiga ku mabbali g'amazzi gonna»? Tusiga ensigo yaffe mu makya ne tutakomya mukono gwaffe akawungeezi? (Omubuulizi 11:6, ESV) Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, omusango Sulemaani gwe yasala guyimirira: omugayaavu muntu atalina magezi; muntu atalimu kutegeera. Omusajja ono yalina emikisa gy'atakozesa. Yalina n'obuvunaanyizibwa bw'atatuukiriza. Katonda bwe yawa buli Muyisirayiri ekitundu ky'ettaka, teyakigendereza kusigala nga kya matumbwe, wabula okulimibwa. Katonda bwe yateeka Adamu mu nnimiro ya Adeni, tekyali kusiima bulungi bwayo bwokka, wabula «okugirima n'okugikuuma» (Olubereberye 2:15, ESV). Mu ngeri y'emu, ettaka lya buli Muyisirayiri lyategekebwa okutuuka ku kubala kwalyo okutuukiridde nga liyita mu mulimu ogw'obwesigwa. Obwannannyini bwaleeta obuvunaanyizibwa. Omugayaavu yalemererwa mu buvunaanyizibwa obwo, bw'atyo n'atagira kutegeera. Omulimu gwo gwe guluwa? Kitaawe w'abaana? Mukama? Muweereza? Musumba? Musomesa? Mu mirimu gino olina ennimiro zo n'ensuku zo. Bw'olemererwa okuzikozesa obulungi, olagajjalira ekigendererwa ky'obulamu bwo era togwa ku kuyitibwa Katonda kw'akuwadde. Omulimi omugayaavu naye yalina obusobozi bw'atakozesa. Yandisobodde okulima ettaka lye singa yasalawo okukikola. Teyali mulwadde; yali mugayaavu buggayaavu olw'okwesalirawo. Katonda tatwetaagisa kye tutalina. «Kyetaagisa ng'ekigero ky'omuntu ky'alina, si ng'ekyo ky'atalina» (2 Abakkolinso 8:12, ESV). Omuntu alina ttalanta bbiri tasuubirwa kuvaamu ttaano, wabula asuubirwa okukozesa ze zibbiri. Omugayaavu ono yagaana okugezaako ekyali mu maanyi ge mu ngeri eyeeyoleka. Bangi balina obusobozi obwebase. Abalala bakozesa ebirabo byabwe ku lwabwe bo mu kifo ky'okubikozesa oyo eyabibawa. Katonda bw'aba atuwadde amaanyi gonna ag'okukola obulungi, ka tugakozese. Ensi eno ekooye era mbi. Tetusaanira kukweka na kitangaala ky'akawuka akamasamasa mu kizikiza ekifaanana bwe kityo. Tetusaanira kumma na kigambo kimu eky'amazima mu nsi ejjudde obukyamu. Ka eddoboozi lyaffe libe ddenzi litya, ka tuliyimuse olw'amazima n'obutuukirivu. Tuleme kubulwa kutegeera nga tulagajjalira emikisa, nga tuvuunika obuvunaanyizibwa, era nga tulemererwa okukozesa obusobozi bwaffe. Mu nsonga z'emmeeme, omugayaavu asingira ddala okubulwa amagezi, kubanga azannya n'ensonga ezeetaaga okwewaayo okusukkuludde. Tewali we walimirako mutima gwo? Ekyokulima tekyamenyako ttaka likakanyavu ery'emmeeme yo? Ensigo ey'Ekigambo tewali we yasigibwako — oba teyameza mirandira? Tewali we wafukiriranga amatabi amato ag'okwegomba? Tewali we wagezaako okukuula omuddo gw'ekibi? Ofaayo ku mubiri gwo ng'omala ebiseera mu maaso g'endabirwamu, naye n'olagajjalira emmeeme yo. Oyonja omubiri, oguli kumpi okuddayo mu nfuufu, ate emmeeme yo n'esigala nga tenaazibwa era nga terabiriddwa. Kuno kwe kusirusiru okusingira ddala. Oyo omugayaavu ku lusuku lw'omutima gwe mazima talina magezi. Era bw'oba Omukristaayo, alokoddwa ddala, naye nga mugayaavu mu mulimu gwa Mukama, kale olaga okutegeera okutono. Bw'omanya akabi k'emmeeme ezibuze, oyinza otya obutafuba kuzitaasa? Ebiseera tebilwawo. Okufa tekulwawo. Ggeyeena talwawo. Setaani si mugayaavu. Amaanyi ag'ekizikiza gakola. Kale tuyinza tutya okuba abagayaavu ng'Omukama atutadde mu lusuku lwe? Bwe tuba twalokolebwa okwagala kwa Katonda okutaliiko kkomo, tetusaanira kwomeza na kwomezebwa mu kuweereza kwe? Entegeka y'ebintu yennyini yeetaagisa nti omuntu alokoddwa abe munyiikivu. Omukristaayo omugayaavu mu buweereza tategeera ky'afiirwa. Ekitundu ekisinga obugagga eky'okussaakanya ne Katonda kwe kwewaayo eri Katonda n'omutima gumu. Abamu balina eddiini nga y'emala okuleeta okubuusabuusa oba baba nayo n'akatono. Boolesa okutya Katonda okutono, naye obujulizi obw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo butono. Twategekebwa kwoleka Kristo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, abamu bamuleetera obuvume. Bwe tulaba abaweereza abagayaavu, tuteebereza nti mukama waabwe naye ateekwa okuba atafaayo. Ensi tereme kulowooza nti Kristo tafaayo ku kubonaabona oba talina bunyiikivu. Naye bayinza okulowooza bwe batyo singa abo abeeyita nti bamuweereza baba bagayaavu bugayaavu. Omugayaavu afiirwa ekitiibwa n'essanyu mu buweereza. Aswaza ensonga gy'ayogera nti ayagala era ateekera amaggwa ku mutto gwe ogw'okufiirako. Ka kinywezebwe: omugayaavu, ka abe musumba, dikoni, oba Omukristaayo owa bwannannyini, muntu atalina magezi. Kaakano, eky'okubiri, ka tulowooze ku ttaka ly'omugayaavu: «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'omugayaavu, ne ku lusuku lw'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, gyonna yali emeze amaggwa, obululu bwali bubisse ettaka lyayo, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese.» (Engero 24:30–31, ESV) Ettaka lijja kubala ekintu bulijjo. Ettaka erisaanira ennimiro oba olusuku lijja kubala ebibala eby'engeri emu. Mu ngeri y'emu, emitima gyaffe n'ebifo bye tukwatako bijja kubala ekintu. Tetuyinza kubeera nga tuli bwereere. Tujja kukola obulungi oba obubi. Bw'oba mugayaavu mu mulimu gwa Kristo, oba munyiikivu mu gwa Setaani. Ng'ayebase, omugayaavu yalima amaggwa mu ngeri ennungi okusinga bwe yandikoze n'okufuba kwonna. Bwe tutabala ŋŋaano ku lwa Kristo, tujja kumeza muddo gusaanira kwokebwa kwokka. Emmeeme bw'etalimibwa ku lwa Katonda, ejja kubala ebibala byayo obuzaaliranwa. Kale kibala ekyo eky'obuzaaliranwa kye kiruwa? Ekibi n'ennaku. Abaana bwe balekebwa nga tebatendekeddwa, bajja kubala ki? Ekibuga bwe kirekebwa nga tekiriimu Njiri, wajja kumeramu ki? Obumenyi bw'amateeka n'obuli. Wanaabangawo amakungula bulijjo. Bwe tuba abagayaavu, amakungula ago gajja kuba ga bulumi ne gye tuli ffe kennyini. Tewali awummulira bulungi ku maggwa. Bw'oba weebase, Setaani asiga. Bw'omma ensigo ennungi, ajja kumansa ensigo embi awatali kuziyizibwa. Okuva mu ekyo mujja kuvaamu okwejjusa, oboolyawo okw'olubeerera. «Erikumeza amaggwa n'emiddo» (Olubereberye 3:18, ESV). Emirundi mingi ekimera ekibi kijja kuba kingi. Ettaka eddungi libala omuddo mungi bwe lilagajjalirwa. Omuntu eyandikoze bingi ku lwa Katonda ajja kukola obubi bungi bw'alekebwa nga mugayaavu. Ekisinga obulungi, bwe kilagajjalirwa, kifuuka ekisinga obubi. Bw'oyagala obulokozi, kwetaagisa okufuba okukulaga ekkubo. Naye bw'oyagala okubula, kyetaagisa kulagajjala kwokka: «Tuliwona tutya bwe tunaanyooma obulokozi obungi bwe butyo?» (Abaebbulaniya 2:3, ESV) Omugayaavu agamba nti, «Otulo otutono, okusumagira okutono, okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako» (Engero 24:33, ESV), n'amaggwa ne geeyongera obungi obutabalika ne gamuteekerateekera ebirumya bingi. Nga bwe tutunuulira olusuku lw'omugayaavu, ka tutunuulire ne mu mutima gw'omugayaavu atatya Katonda. Tafaayo ku kwenenya na kukkiriza. Okulowoozeza ddala ku mmeeme ye oba ku bulamu obutaggwaawo kikakubo nnyo gy'ali. Ayagala okutwala obulamu mu ngeri ennyangu, «n'okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako.» Kiki ekimera mu birowoozo bye ne mu mpisa ze? Mu bamu ku bagayaavu bano ab'omwoyo, olaba obutamiivu, obutali bulongoofu, omululu, obusungu, amalala, n'emiddo n'obululu obulala bungi. Mu balala, obwonoonyi obweyoleka bwe butyo we buziyizibwa embeera ez'ekitiibwa, osangamu ebika by'ebibi eby'enjawulo. Omutima teguyinza kusigala bwereere. Oba Kristo oba Setaani ajja kuguba mu. Munnange, bw'oba tosazeewo ku lwa Katonda, toyinza kusigala wakati. Mu lutalo luno, buli muntu ayimirira oba awamu ne Katonda oba n'amuwakanya. Toyinza kusigala ng'olupapula olwereere. Empandiika ya Setaani eyeeyoleka eri ku ggwe; toyinza kulaba bubonero? Okuggyako nga Kristo awandiise erinnya lye ery'ekisa ku lupapula, omukono gwa Setaani gusigalawo. Oyinza okugamba nti, «Sibeera mu kibi kya lwatu; ndi wa mpisa nnungi.» Naye singa oyekebejja omutima gwo n'obwegendereza, wandiraba obulabe eri Katonda n'amakubo ge. Toyagala tteeka lye, newaakubadde Omwana we, newaakubadde Enjiri ye. Wawukanye mu mutima, ojjudde ebirowoozo eby'obwereere n'okwegomba okukyamu. Bino bijja kukula ne byeyongera ng'okyali omugayaavu mu mwoyo era ng'oleka omutima gwo nga tegulimibwa. Omwoyo gwa Katonda akuzuukuse. Akusiimuule okufumiitiriza okw'amaanyi era okunyiikivu. Kale olaba nti ebimera bino ebyonoonyi biteekwa okusigulwa, nti omutima gwo guteekwa okumenyebwa okuyita mu kukwatibwa omusango, ne gusigibwa ensigo ennungi ey'Enjiri okutuusa lwe gubala amakungula ku lw'Omulimi omukulu. Munnange, bw'oba okkiriza Kristo, ka nange ntunuulire mu mutima gwo, naddala bw'oba Omukristaayo omugayaavu. Ntya nti obululu n'emiddo biyinza okuba nga bimera n'omwo. Saakuwulira ng'oyimba gyebuvuddeko, «Kino kye kigambo kye njagala nnyo okumanya»? Ekibuuzo ekyo kijja kukweraliikirizanga, kubanga okubuusabuusa kwangu okumera mu birowoozo ebigayaavu. Sijjukira kusoma mu kitabo kya John Wesley eky'ennaku nti yabuusabuusa obulokozi bwe. Yali mutabuufu nnyo mu makungula ga Mukama we ne kitamujjira kubuusabuusa Katonda we. Abakristaayo abamu balina okukkiriza okutono kubanga tebaasigako nsigo ya kaamulali gye baaweebwa. Bw'otokozesa kukkiriza kwo, kuyinza kukula kutya? Okukkiriza bwe kukozesebwa n'obunyiikivu mu buweereza bwa Kristo, kusimba emirandira, ne kukula ne kuba kw'amaanyi, era oluvannyuma ne kuziyiza okubuusabuusa. Abalala babonaabonesebwa okuteebereza okubi. Bafuuka abatamativu, abanyiikaavu, ab'omululu, era abeemulugunya — emirundi mingi olw'okuba bagayaavu. Guno gwe muddo ogumera mu nnimiro y'omugayaavu. Nnamanya abakkiriza abagayaavu ne bafuuka abanyiikaavu ennyo n'ekintu kyonna ne kitabasanyusa. Omukristaayo asinga obunyiikivu teyabamalanga. Abakkiriza abasinga okwagala tebaali baagalana bumala. Ekkanisa esinga obunyiikivu teyalina maanyi bumala. Baalabanga ensobi buli wamu, ne mu kifo Katonda gye yali akola mu bweyolefu. Omwoyo guno ogw'okunenya, okuwakana, n'okwemulugunya okutasalako, gwe gumu ku bululu obumera mazima ddala awali obugayaavu obw'omwoyo. Omutima gwo bwe gutabala bibala ku lwa Katonda, mazima gujja kubala ekyonoona ggwe n'abalala. Amaggwa emirundi mingi gatta ensigo ennungi, naye kya mukisa ensigo ennungi bw'ekula obungi ne etta amaggwa. Katonda asobozesa abakkiriza abamu okubala ebibala ennyo, ekiba nti Setaani bw'asiga omuddo, tegusobola kukula. Omwoyo Omutukuvu anafuya ekibi mu mutima kireme okwongera okufuga. Bw'oba omugayaavu, kebera ennimiro y'omutima gwo era onakuwalire ky'olaba. Kaakano lowooza ku maka go. Nsonga nkulu omuntu bw'alemererwa okulima amaka ge ye. Mu nnaku zange ez'edda, nnamanya omusajja eyanamperekeranga mu byalo gye nnabuuliranga. Nnasiima okubeera naye okutuusa lwe nnamumanya obulungi. Yamalanga buli kawungeezi ng'agenda mu nkuŋŋaana, naye n'alagajjalira abaana be abangi. Baakulira mu buvubuka obutatya Katonda kubanga kitaabwe teyanoonya kubakulembera eri Kristo. Obunyiikivu obw'ebweru bugasa ki singa waliwo obulagajjavu mu maka? Nga kya nnaku okugamba nti, «Olusuku lwange nze kennyini sirukuumye» (Oluyimba lwa Sulemaani 1:6, ESV). Nnawulirako omusajja eyagaana okuyigiriza abaana be ku Katonda kubanga teyayagala kubakyamya ndowooza. Yayagala okubaleka basalewo eddiini yaabwe oluvannyuma. Omu ku batabani be yamenyeka omukono, era omusawo bwe yali agutereeza, omulenzi yali avuma. Omusawo n'ayogera nti, «Watya okukyamya mutabani wo eri obulungi, naye Setaani teyalina kubuusabuusa okufaanana ng'okwo.» Buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okulima ennimiro nga tugigasa ebirime ebirungi, oba mangu ejja kubikkibwa omuddo. Tendeka omwana eri obulungi, oba ye ajja kwewalula eri obubi mu buzaaliranwa. Nga bwe kiri mu maka, bwe kiri ne mu masomero. Omusajja eyavaako yeegatta ku kkanisa eno yali yabadde atakkiriza Katonda. Obutakkiriza bwe yabusinziza mu kitundu ku kye yayitamu mu ssomero. Ku Ssande, abalenzi baateekebwanga mu kifo eky'ewala mu kkanisa gye baali tebayinza kuwulira kigambo. Baagumira okusaba okutaggwaawo, naye tewali kyakwata ku mitima gyabwe. Oluvannyuma, yakoowa eddiini nnyo ne yamalirira okugiva ku bwe yaba nga wa ddembe. Abasomesa ba Sande sukuulu balina okwegendereza. Amasomo gasobola okukolebwa nga tegasanyusa n'abaana ne batandika okukyawa Ssande yennyini. Ebiseera bisobola okwonoonebwa awatali kuleeta mitima gya bato eri Kristo. Abazadde abamu Abakristaayo, olw'obukambwe n'obutaba na kisa, basize ensigo z'obukyayi mu kifo ky'okwagala. Ka tubeere mu baana baffe mu ngeri gye baagalira si ffe fekka wabula ne Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Abazadde ka boolese okukkiriza okusanyufu era okwa mazima, abaana balyoke beegombe okugoberera ekyokulabirako kyabwe. Okukkiriza bwe kutafuga mu maka, tujja kulaba akavuyo, amalala, obusirusiru, n'entandikwa y'obwonoonyi. Amaka go galeme kufuuka nnimiro ya mugayaavu. Ka buli dikoni, omukulembeze w'ekibiina, n'omusumba yeekebejje ennimiro gy'akwasibbwa. Bwe tulagajjalira obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, tufuuka ng'emiti egitabala ebibala egikwata ekifo emiti egibala kye gyandikozesezza. Tujja kuziyiza mu kifo ky'okuyamba okuggyako nga tuwaayo obuweereza obwa nnamaddala. Kirowoozeeko n'amaanyi. Toyinza kusigala wakati. Bw'otobala magoba, oleeta okufiirwa. Katonda atuwe okufuuka abaweereza ab'amagoba. Kaakano tunuulira ennimiro ennene ey'ensi. Laba nga bw'emeze amaggwa. Ebitundu ebinene bibisse obukyamu, obutakkiriza, n'eddiini ez'obulimba. Ensi ejjudde obukambwe, okujoogebwa, obutali bulongoofu, n'ennaku. Kino kituusibwa ku ki olw'ekkanisa envuvu? Emyaka nga enkumi bbiri giyiseewo, naye ekitundu ekinene eky'olusuku kikyameze amaggwa. Buli kkanisa we yakomya omulimu gw'obuweereza obw'obumisiyonaali, yakendeera. Bw'ekomya okuggyamu eddungu, efuuka ngumba yennyini. Mu kifo ky'okubuuza ekkanisa kye yakola mu myaka egyayita, ka twebuuze kye tunaakola kaakano. Tujja kweyongera okulima ettaka lye limu emirundi n'emirundi ate ennimiro ennene nga zisigadde nga tezikwatiddwako? Katonda atuzuukuse okuva mu bugayaavu bwaffe. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, alipoota eyinza okuba nti: «Nayita ku nnimiro ey'ekkanisa envuvu, era gyonna yali emeze amaggwa.» Waliwo essomo wano. Bw'olekebwa yekka, obuntu bubala maggwa na bululu bwokka. Awatali kisa, kino kye kyokka kye twandibadde tuvaamu. Bwe kaakano tubala ebibala ebirungi, kyonna kiva ku kisa. Kale ka twoleke ekibala ky'ekisa mu bulamu bwaffe. Tunaaweereza Kristo n'obunyiikivu obutono okusinga bwe twaweereza ekibi? Tunaawaayo eri ye ebitono okusinga bwe twawaayo eri okwegomba kwaffe okw'edda? Omwoyo Omutukuvu abale ebibala ebingi mu ffe. Tuyiga n'obwereere bw'ebigendererwa ebirungi awatali kikolwa. Omusajja ono bulijjo yateekateeka okukola nnyo ku lunaku olumu. Yagamba nti, «Otulo otutono, okusumagira okutono, okufunya emikono katono ne wummulako» (Engero 24:33, ESV). Okulwawo katono kwokka — n'oluvannyuma yandaba yatandika. Naye olunaku olwo terwajja. Bangi bawulira okubuulira okw'amaanyi ne bateekateeka okwanukula. Bateekateeka okukyukira Katonda «ku lunaku olumu.» Abamu balwawo emyaka amakumi ana. Olikyuka ddi? «Nga sinnafa,» bw'ogamba. Onookulwaza okutuusa ku ssaawa yo esembayo? Ekyo kya magezi? Oyinza okufa mangu. Obulamu tebwesigika. Weegendereze okulwawo okutono. Omaze kwonoona biseera bimala. Salawo kaakano. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuleete okusalawo. «Mazima toziyiza nze okwongera otulo otutono?» bw'agamba omugayaavu. «Onzuukusizza mangu nnyo. Nsaba butulo bulala butono.» «Ggwe omusajja wange omwagalwa, obudde bwaka nnyo.» Addamu nti, «Obudde buyiseeko, mmanyi; naye tebujja kuyita nnyo bwe nzija okwebaka butulo bulala.» Omuzuukusa nate, n'omugamba nti buli ttuntu. Agamba nti, «Kino kye kiseera ekisinga okwokya olw'enku: nkakasa nti singa naba nzuukuse nandigenze ku ntebe ne nwummulako katono okuva ku njuba ey'okwokya.» Okonkona ku luggi lwe ng'obudde bunaatera okuziba, kale n'akaaba nti, «Tekugasa kugolokoka kaakano, kubanga obudde bunaatera okuggwaawo.» Omujjukiza ennimiro ye eyameze amaggwa n'olusuku lwe olulimu omuddo, n'addamu nti, «Yee, nteekwa okugolokoka, mmanyi.» Yeenyeenya n'agamba nti, «Sirowooza nti kijja kukyusa kinene bwe nnindirira essaawa okukuba. Nzija kuwummulako eddakiika endala emu oba bbiri.» Aliko ku kitanda kye ng'aliko lubambo, afudde ng'akyali mulamu, aziikiddwa mu bugayaavu bwe. Singa yandisobodde okwebaka emirembe gyonna yandikoze bw'atyo, naye tasobola, kubanga olunaku olw'omusango lulimuzuukusa. Kyawandiikibwa nti, «N'ali mu magombe, ng'abonyaabonyezebwa, n'ayimusa amaaso ge» (Lukka 16:23, ESV). Katonda abawe mmwe abagayaavu ab'omwoyo okuzuukuka nga luno terunnatuuka; naye temujja kuzuukuka okuggyako nga mwesiimuula mu kiseera, kubanga «kaakano ke kiseera ekisaanidde; laba, kaakano lwe lunaku olw'obulokozi» (2 Abakkolinso 6:2, ESV). Era kiyinza okuba kaakano oba tewali kiseera kirala. Enkya esangibwa mu kalenda y'abasirusiru bokka; olwa leero lwe lunaku lw'omugezi, ekiseera ekyalondebwa ekya Katonda waffe ow'ekisa. Ayi singa Omwoyo Omutukuvu akutwala okukwata essaawa eno eriwo, olyoke amangu ago weewaayo eri Mukama olw'okukkiriza Kristo Yesu, n'oluvannyuma okuva mu lusuku lwe— «Mangu sigula Omuddo ogunyoomesa, oguyonja awatali magoba Obugimu bw'ettaka okuva mu bimera ebiramu.»

fields.title: Olukomera Olwamenyeka
fields.body_html:
Okuva mu nnimiro y'emizabbibu ey'omugayaavu eyalekebwa awo n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja ekyamenyeka, mujja essomo eritutuumufu— fumiitiriza n'obwegendereza engeri obutafaayo mu by'omwoyo, emisingi eginafuye, n'okwenenya okulwawo bwe biviirako emmeeme okusigala nga teyeekuumidde eri okuzikirira okusooba mpola.

“Nayita ku nnimiro y'omugayaavu, ne ku nnimiro y'emizabbibu ey'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, yonna yali ejjudde amaggwa; obuso bwayo bwali bubisiddwa omuddo oguluma, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese.

Awo ne ndaba ne nkifumiitiriza; ne ntunula ne mpeebwa okuyigirizibwa.” Engero 24:30–32 (ESV) Omusajja ono omugayaavu teyakola kabi eri banne: teyali mubbi, wadde omukambwe, wadde eyeeyingiza mu bya balala. Teyeeraliikiriranga bya balala, kubanga n'ebibye ye teyabifangako—kyali kyetaagisa okufuba kungi nnyo. Teyali mwonoonyi mu lwatu; teyalina maanyi ga kukola ekyo. Yayagalanga okutwala ebintu mpola. Bulijjo yalekanga ekituufu nga bwe kiri, ate era, mu ngeri y'emu, yalekanga n'ekibi nga bwe kiri, ng'omuddo n'amaggwa ebyali mu nnimiro ye bwe byakiraga mu lwatu.

Kyali kya nkyo ki okweteganya? Byonna byandibadde bye bimu emyaka ekikumi okuva kaakano; bw'atyo yatwala ebintu nga bwe byajjanga. Teyali muntu mubi, bwe bagamba abamu ku ye; ate era, oboolyawo, ku nkomerero kirilabika nti tewali muntu mubi okusinga oyo atali mulungi. Mu ngeri ezimu tali mulungi kya kuba mubi; talina maanyi ga mpisa ga kuweereza Katonda oba Baali. Aweereza yekka nnyini, ng'asinza obwenkuubebe bwe era ng'asinza okuwummula kwe.

Kyokka bulijjo yateekateeka okuba omutuufu. Ayii! yali tagenda kwongera kwebaka nnyo; yali agenda kuggyawo bumbejjegere obulala, olwo n'alyoka aba ku mulimu gwe n'akulaga ky'ayinza okukola. Olunaku olumu yali ateekateeka okuba omunyiikivu ddala n'aliyirira ekiseera ekifiiridde. Ekiseera tekyatuuka n'akatono ky'atandika, naye bulijjo kyali kijja. Bulijjo yateekateeka okwenenya, naye n'agenda mu maaso mu kibi kye. Yateekateeka okukkiriza, naye n'afiira mu butakkiriza. Yateekateeka okuba Omukristaayo, naye n'abeera awatali Kristo. Yasagaasagana wakati w'endowooza ebbiri kubanga yali tayagala kweraliikirira kusalawo; bw'atyo n'azikirira olw'okulwawo.

Ekifaananyi kino eky'omugayaavu n'ennimiro ye n'olusuku lwe olujjudde omuddo n'amaggwa kikiikirira omuntu mungi eyeeyita Omukristaayo, naye eyafuuka omugayaavu mu bintu bya Katonda. Obulamu obw'omwoyo bwakala mu ye. Yaddayo ennyuma. Yava mu bulue obw'omwoyo obulamu n'akka mu bunafu n'obutafaayo eri ebintu bya Katonda. Ate ebintu nga byonoonese munda mu mutima gwe, era ng'ebibi bya buli ngeri biyingidde mu ye, ne bikula ne bimera emirandira, akabi kabaawo ne kungulu mu mpisa ze eza buli lunaku. Ekisenge eky'amayinja ekyakuumanga empisa ye kimenyese, era aggwaddewo nga ali mu lujjudde eri buli kabi. Ku nsonga eno kwe tunaafumiitiriza kaakano: “ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese.”

Kale nno, ka tutambule ne Sulemaani, era tuyimirire naye, tufumiitirize, era tufune okuyigirizibwa nga twekaliriza olukomera luno olumenyese. Bwe tumala okulwekenneenya, ka tulowooze ku bivaamu eby'ebisenge ebimenyese; olwo, ku nkomerero, ka tugezaako okuzuukusa omugayaavu ono olukomera lwe luyinze okuddaabirizibwa. Singa omugayaavu ono aba omu ku ffe, ekisa kya Katonda ekitaliiko kkomo kitunyuse nga tuzuukuka nga ekisenge kino ekyayonooneka tekinnayingiza kibinja ky'ebibi ebiyisaayisa.

I. Ka Tutunuulire Olukomera Luno Olumenyese Mu kusooka lwali lukomera lulungi nnyo, kubanga kyali kisenge kya mayinja. Ennimiro emirundi mingi zeetooloozebwa enkomera ez'emiti ezyangu okuvunda, oba ebisaka ebyangu okubaamu ebituli; naye kino kyali kisenge kya mayinja. Ebisenge ng'ebyo bya bulijjo nnyo mu bitundu eby'ebuvanjuba, era ne mu bitundu byaffe ebimu amayinja we gasukkirira. Kyali kiwe eky'okukuuma okuva ku ntandikwa, era ne kigazaamu bulungi ekifo ekitono ekyali kigudde mu mikono emibi. Omusajja yalina ennimiro ey'okulima, n'olukugu olulala olw'ettaka olw'ennimiro y'emizabbibu oba olusuku. Yali ttaka ggimu, kubanga lyameza amaggwa n'omuddo mu bungi; era ebyo we bimera, ebirungi nabyo bisobola okumeramu. Kyokka omugayaavu teyafaayo ku by'obugagga bwe, naye n'aleka ekisenge okugwa mu bwononefu, era mu bifo bingi ne kimenyekera ddala.

Ka njogere ku bimu ku bisenge eby'amayinja abantu bye baleka ne bimenyeka bwe baddayo ennyuma. Emirundi mingi, emisingi emituufu gyayigirizibwa mu buto, naye ne gyerabirwa. Nga okusomesebwa okw'Ekikristaayo mukisa munene! Bakadde baffe, mu kuyigiriza ne mu kwokulaga, baayigiriza bangi ku ffe ebintu ebirongoofu, ebya kitiibwa, era eby'ettutumu eddungi. Twalaba mu bulamu bwabwe engeri y'okubeeramu. Baatuggulirawo Ekigambo kya Katonda mu maaso gaffe, ne batuyigiriza ekituufu eri Katonda n'eri abantu. Baatusabira, era baasaba naffe, okutuusa lwe ebintu bya Katonda bwe byatwetooloola ne bitusibako ng'ekisenge eky'amayinja.

Tetwasobola kwewaza ku bintu ebyo bye twafuna nga tukyali bato. N'ebiseera bye twali tusesa, nga tetunnamanya Mukama mu ngeri ey'obulokozi, amazima ago gaalina obuyinza obulungi ku ffe. Twaziyizibwanga bwe twali tugenda okukola ebibi. Twayambibwanga bwe twali tulafuubana okugolokokera eri Kristo. Kya nnaku nnyo abantu bwe baleka emisingi gino egisooka okunyeenyezebwa n'okuggyibwawo ng'amayinja bwe gagwa okuva ku kisenge eky'ensalo. Abavubuka batandika nga boogera kya bunyoomo ku mpisa enkadde eza bakadde baabwe.

Amangu ago si kifaananyi kya kadde kyokka kye banyooma, wabula n'empisa zennyini. Banoonya obwegattiro obulala, era mu bwegattiro obwo tebayigira wabula ekibi. Banoonya essanyu mu bifo ebyandiwuunyisizza bazadde baabwe. Kino kivaako ebibi n'okusingawo. Bwe bataleeta nviiri za kitaabwe enjeru na nnaku eri entaana, si kya kwenyumiririza gye bali.

Namanya abavubuka, abaali ddala Bakristaayo, abaddayo ennyuma mu bunaku olw'okubasendasenda okukyusa, okukweka, oba okwononga emisingi emitukuvu gye baali baleeddwamu okuva ku vviivi lya nnyaabwe. Kya kabi kanene abo abeeyita abakkiriza bwe bafuuka abatanywevu era bwe batwalibwa buli mpewo ya njigiriza. Kiraga obunafu bw'omutwe n'obutanywevu bw'omutima bwe tuyinza okuseeta emisingi egy'amaanyi era emitukuvu egyafukibwako amaziga ga nnyaabaffe era egyanywezebwa obulamu obwesigwa obwa kitaffe.

“Nze ndi muddu wo, mutabani w'omuweereza wo omukazi” (Zabbuli 116:16, ESV). Dawudi yalowooza nti kitiibwa era kanyweza katukuvu okuba mutabani w'oyo eyayitibwanga muddu wa Katonda.

Mwegendereze, mmwe abaayigirizibwa mu Kikristaayo, muleme kukola nabyo kya bunyoomo. “Mwana wange, kwata etteeka lya kitaawo, era toleka kuyigiriza kwa nnyoko.

Bisibe ku mutima gwo bulijjo; bisibe mu bulago bwo.” (Engero 6:20–21, ESV) Okukuuma empisa era kusangibwa mu njigiriza enywevu. Kino nakyo kisenge kya mayinja kya maanyi. Bangi mu ffe baayigirizibwa enjiri ey'ekisa kya Katonda era ne bagiyiga bulungi, ne basobola okulwanirira n'obunyiikivu okukkiriza okwaweebwa abatukuvu omulundi ogumu. Ba mukisa abo eddiini yaabwe gy'esinziira ku kutegeera okulambulukufu okw'amazima ag'emirembe n'emirembe.

Eddiini eyeesigamye ku kusanyusa kwokka nga tewali kuyigiriza kuyinza okumala akaseera; naye eri amaanyi ag'obulamu bwonna, wateekwa okubaawo okumanya enjigiriza ezo enkulu eziri emisingi gy'enjiri. Nkankana bwe mpulira nti omuntu ateeka wansi, kimu kimu, amazima amakulu ag'enjiri era ng'eyimirira olw'obugabi bwe. Mumuwulira ng'agamba nti, “Kuno kwe kutunula kwange, naye abalala balina eddembe ery'okutunula kwabwe.” Ekyo kituufu bwe twogera ku ndowooza obwokka; naye tetusobola kwogera bwe tutyo ku mazima Katonda ge yabikkulira. Amazima ago gamu era tegakyuka, era bonna basaanidde okugakkiriza. Si ndowooza yo ku mazima ekulokola, wabula amazima gennyini nga Katonda bwe yagabikkula, agakwatibwako olw'okukkiriza.

Nzija kuwaayo n'essanyu engeri yange ey'okwogera enjigiriza, naye si njigiriza yennyini. Omuntu omu ayinza okugyogera bw'ati, omulala mu ngeri endala; naye amazima gennyini tegateekwa kuwaayo. Omwoyo ogw'Essomero Eryeyanjuluze gutuggyako obwesige. Nnandibuuzizza abamu ku bakulembeze baalyo obanga bakkiriza nti waliwo ekyayigirizibwa mu Kyawandiikibwa ekisaanidde okufiirirwa, era obanga abaafiira ku bukakafu baali basirusiru okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe olw'ebyo ebyandibadde ndowooza bwokka. Omwoyo guno ogw'ekkanisa eyeeyanjuluze gumenya ebisenge eby'amayinja. Guyingiza Setaani n'ekibinja kye kyonna, era gulireetera ekkanisa ya Katonda akabi akatapimika bwe kitaziyizibwa. Enkola y'okukkiriza etanywevu yonoona emmeeme y'omuntu yenna.

Tetuli bakwatibwako mu buswavu; kyokka tetwandifudde balema singa twabeera obulamu obwesigwa okutuusa abantu lwe bandituyise bwe batyo. Nasisinkanye omusajja gye buvuddeko eyawawaabirwa obuswavu obw'eddiini, ne mugamba nti, “Mpaayo omukono gwo. Njagala okusisinkana n'abakakafu abaswavu buli luvannyuma. Beeyongera okuba ab'ebbula, era ebintu bye bakolebwamu binywevu nnyo, olwo nga singa waaliwo bingi ku byo twandiraba abantu bangi mu ffe n'ebiwuka ebitalina mugongo bitono.”

Mu biseera bino tulabye abasajja abalina omugongo batono; abasinga baabadde ng'obuwuka obw'omu nnyanja obutalina mugongo. Waaliwo ekiseera lwe nnandigambye nti, “Beera muntu wa kisa era osuule obumpimpi.” Kaakano nteekwa okugamba nti, “Beera munywevu mu mazima.” Okukkiriza okwaweebwa abatukuvu omulundi ogumu nkwagala nnyo kaakano ku kubanga kuyitibwa okumpi, kubanga nkooye obugazi obuva mu bisaka ebimenyese.

Waliwo amazima amanywevu era n'obukakafu obulambulukufu obw'okukkiriza, era zibasanze mmwe abaleka ebisenge bino eby'amayinja okumenyeka. Ntya nti abagayaavu bangi, era nti emirembe egigenda okujja giyinza okukaaba olw'obutafaayo obutenderezebwa mu mulembe guno ogw'obuyeeyeezi.

Olukomera olulala oluterekwa oluvunse lwe lw'empisa entukuvu ezaamala okukolebwa. Omugayaavu aleka ekisenge kino okugwa mu bwononefu. Ka njogere ku bimu ku by'okukuuma ebikulu eby'obulamu n'empisa.

Kimu kwe kuyisa okusaba mu kyama. Okusaba okw'omuntu ku bubwe kusaanidde okuweebwayo bulijjo, waakiri buli nkya na buli kawungeezi. Tetuyinza kubeerera awatali biseera ebiteekebwawo eby'okusemberera Katonda. Okutunula mu maaso g'omuntu nga tosoose kutunula mu maaso ga Katonda kabi. Okugenda mu nsi nga tekiwaddeyo mutima gwo eri Katonda kwe kugulekera ddembe eri buli muyingirira ow'omwoyo. Ekiro, okugenda okwebaka ng'ensolo mu kkomera lyazo, awatali kwebaza Katonda olw'ebyekisa eby'olunaku, kya nsonyi. Ssaddaaka ey'akawungeezi esaanidde okuweebwayo ng'ekituufu nga bwe tunyumirwa omuliro ogw'akawungeezi. Twetekke wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro by'Omukuumi w'abantu.

Kigambibwa nti, “Tusobola okusaba mu biseera byonna.” Ekyo kituufu; naye ntya nti abo abatasaba mu biseera ebiteekebwawo tebasaba n'akatono. Abo abasaba bulijjo mu biseera ebiteekeddwawo be basinga okuba nga basaba obutayosa. Obulamu obw'omwoyo tebukulira ku nkola enkakanyavu, naye kubanga obulamu bulina engeri gye bweyoleka ebweru, tuteekwa okufaayo n'empisa zaabwo ezeeyoleka ebweru awamu n'amaanyi gaabwo aga munda. Toleka bituli binene mu kisenge eky'okusaba mu kyama okwa bulijjo.

Neeyongerayo. Waliwo amaanyi amakulu ag'okukuuma mu kusaba okw'amaka, era nnumwa nnyo olw'amaka mangi ag'Abakristaayo agakuleka. Waaliwo ekiseera Obukatoliki bwe bwali tebusobola kufuna maanyi mangi mu Bungereza kubanga bwaleeta kya kisiikirize bwokka eky'ekyo amaka ag'Abakristaayo kye gaali gakwata mu butuufu.

“Owulira ekide ekyo mu makya?”

“Kya nsonga ki?”

“Kugenda mu kkanisa okusaba.” Omupuritáni yaddamu nti, “Saagala kugendayo. Nkuŋŋaanyizza abaana bange. Tusomye Ekyawandiikibwa, ne tusaba, ne tuyimba ettendo lya Katonda. Tulina ekkanisa mu nnyumba yaffe.” Ekide eky'akawungeezi ne kiddamu okuvuga. Kyali kya kusaba kw'akawungeezi. Naye yali amaze okusinza kw'akawungeezi okwetooloola emmeeza ye, nga Bayibuli ennene ye ekyokwewunda kyayo ekikulu. Baagamba nti tewandibaddewo kusinza awatali kabona. Yaddamu nti buli musajja atya Katonda asaanidde okuba kabona mu nnyumba ye ye.

Bwe batyo abatukuvu baaziyiza obukabona obw'obukumpanya ne bakuuma okukkiriza okuva mu mulembe okutuuka ku mulembe.

Okusinza okw'omu maka n'ekituuti eky'okubuulira, wansi wa Katonda, gy'ebisenge eby'amayinja eby'Obupurotesitanti. Okusaba kwange kwe kuti ebisenge bino bireme kumenyeka.

Olukomera olulala olukuuma lwe lw'okukuŋŋaana kw'oku wakati w'omu wiiki. Abantu bwe baleka enkuŋŋaana ez'oku wakati w'omu wiiki, amaanyi g'eddiini yaabwe gakendeera. Sioogera ku abo abaziyizibwa Katonda olw'obulwadde, emirimu, oba obuvunaanyizibwa. Waliwo ebisukkuluma. Njogera ku abo abandisobola okujja naye ne balonda obutajja. Omuntu bw'agamba nti, “Ebyokubuulira ebya Ssande binmala. Saagala nkuŋŋaana za kusaba oba emisomo,” kiraga obutalina njala ya Kigambo, era ekyo kabonero kabi. Bw'ozimba olukomera okwetooloola Ssande n'oleka ennaku endala ez'omu wiiki nga zaggule, ente za Setaani zijja kuyingira ne zireeta okuzikirira okunene.

Fanayo era okukuuma ekisenge eky'okusoma Bayibuli n'eky'okwogera okw'Ekikristaayo. Beera ne batya Katonda. Weegatte ne Katonda. Olw'omukisa gw'Omwoyo, ojja kukuuma olukomera olunywevu eri okukemebwa. Bw'otenda, okukemebwa kujja kuyingira mu nnimiro z'emmeeme yo ne bulyako ebibala byonna ebirungi. Bangi baazuula okukuumibwa okunene mu nnimiro y'obulamu obwa bulijjo mu kisenge eky'amayinja eky'okwatula okukkiriza mu lwatu. Njogera nammwe abakkiriza ab'amazima, era mumanyi nti emirundi mingi kibadde kiwe eky'amaanyi okumanyibwa mu lwatu era okutegeererwa ng'omugoberezi wa Yesu.

Sinnaba kwejjusa—era sirijjusa n'akatono—olunaku lwe natambulira ku mugga omutono Lark mu Cambridgeshire ne nziikibwako awo ne Kristo mu kubatizibwa. Bwe nnakola bwe ntyo, nakola mu ngeri eyawakanya endowooza za mikwano gyange gyonna gye nnassaamu ekitiibwa; naye bwe nnasoma Endagaano Empya ey'Oluyonaani nzennyini, nawulira nga nsibiddwa okweyibbwa mu mazzi ku kwatula okukkiriza kwange, era bwe kityo ne nkolebwa. Olw'ekikolwa ekyo nalangirira eri ensi nti, “Nfudde gy'oli, era nziikiddwa gy'oli mu Kristo, era nsuubira okuva mu kiseera kino okweyongera okutambulira mu bulamu obuggya.”

Ku lunaku olwo, olw'ekisa kya Katonda, nagoberera enkola ya jenero eyagenderera okulwana okutuusa lw'awangula, era kyeyava ayokya amaato ge waleme kubaawo kudda nnyuma. Nzikiriza nti okwatula Kristo mu lwatu mu maaso g'abantu kiba ng'ekisaka eky'amaggwa, ekikuuma omuntu munda mu nsalo era ne kigoba abo abandimusendasenda okumuggya mu kkubo. Wabula, kiba kisaka kyokka, era tekigasa singa kyetooloola ennimiro ey'omuddo; naye eŋŋaano bw'emera, ekisaka kya mugaso munene.

Mmwe abalowooza nti musobola okuba aba Mukama ate n'okusigala nga muli mu lwatu ng'ettaka lya bonna, mwabuze nnyo. Musaanidde okwawukana ku nsi era okugondera eddoboozi erigamba nti, “Muveemu wakati waabwe, era mube ba njawulo” (2 Abakkolinso 6:17, ESV).

Ekisuubizo eky'obulokozi kiri eri oyo akkiririza mu mutima era ayatuza n'akamwa (Abaruumi 10:9–10). Yogera n'obuvumu nti, “Naye nze n'ennyumba yange, tunaaweerezanga Mukama” (Yoswa 24:15, ESV). Olw'okwatula okufaanana bwe kityo otambula ku luguudo lwa Kabaka era weeteeka wansi w'okukuumibwa kwa Mukama w'abatambuze, era ajja kukufaako.

Emirundi mingi, we wandibadde osagaasagana, ojja kugamba nti, “Obweyamo bwa Mukama buli ku nze; nnyinza ntya okudda ennyuma?” Kyenva nkukubiriza nti: simba ekisenge eky'amayinja era okikuume. Bwe kiba nga mu kifo ekimu kimenyeddwa, kizimbe buto. Kirage mu mpisa zo ne mu mbeera yo nti oli mugoberezi wa Yesu era toswala kumanyibwa nga bw'oli.

Kwata nnyo emisingi gyo egy'eddiini ng'abasajja n'abakazi ab'amazima. Tokyama olw'amagoba oba ekitiibwa mu bantu. Toleka bugagga kumenya lukomera lwo. Namanya abamu abaakola ekituli ekigazi okuyisa eggaali yaabwe, era okwaniriza abagagga ab'ensi mu kibiina kyabwe olw'ekifo kyabwe. Abo abaleka emisingi okusanyusa abantu ku nkomerero balitwalibwa nga bantu batono; naye oyo omwesigwa alifuna ekitiibwa okuva eri Katonda. Kuuma ekisaka kino eky'okunyweza okukkiriza, era ojja kufuna omukisa munene mu kyo.

Waliwo ekisenge eky'amayinja ekirala eky'okwogerako: obunywevu bw'empisa. Okukkiriza kwaffe okutukuvu kuyigiriza omuntu okuba omumalirivu ku Kristo era omunywevu mu kuggyawo empisa embi. “Eriiso lyo erya ddyo bwe likwesittaza, liggyeemu olisuule” (Matayo 5:29, ESV). Tekigamba nti okibikkeko ekiwero.

“Omukono gwo ogwa ddyo bwe gukwesittaza, gutemeko ogusuule” (Matayo 5:30, ESV). Tekigamba nti oguteeke mu lubiriizi. Eddiini ey'amazima ejjuvu. Egamba nti, “Tokwata kintu kitali kirongoofu” (2 Abakkolinso 6:17, ESV).

Naye bangi bagayaavu nnyo mu makubo ga Katonda ne batakwatako bunywevu bwabwe. Banne abakemo babasendasenda, ne batasobola kugamba nti, “Nedda.” Beetaaga ekisenge eky'amayinja ekikolebwa mu kugaana okuddiŋŋana. Amayinja gaali: “Nedda. Nedda. Nedda.” Guma okuba ow'enjawulo. Malirira okwekwatako nnyo ku Kristo. Salawo mu bunywevu obutakkiriza kintu kyonna mu bulamu bwo—ne bwe kiba ekigagawaza oba ekisanyusa—singa kyandiswaza erinnya lya Yesu. Beera atanyeenyezebwa mu mazima, atagondera kabi mu butukuvu, atasiguukululwa mu bwesimbu, anywevu mu kisa, era atanyeenya mu bwesigwa. Katonda olw'ekisa kye bw'akuzimbira ekisaka bwe kityo, ne Setaani agenda kukirabako n'agamba nti, “Tomukomedde kisaka?” (Yobu 1:10, ESV).

Mbaleseeko ebbanga eggwanvu nga mutunuulira waggulu w'ekisenge. Ka kaakano mbayite munda era mufumiitirize ku bivaamu eby'olukomera olumenyese.

Ekisooka, ensalo ebulawo. Ennyiriri ez'okwawukana ezaali zikuumibwa emisingi emituufu, empisa entukuvu, okwatula okw'olwatu, n'okumalirira okunywevu ziweddewo. Kaakano ekibuuzo kivaayo: omuntu ono Mukristaayo oba nedda? Olukomera lugudde nnyo n'ekiba nti tamanyi kayambika kitali kya Mukama era ekigudde nga ettaka lya bonna. Tamanyi obanga ye yennyini wa mu bwakabaka bwa Kabaka oba mukka bwereere wansi w'obufuzi bw'ensi.

Kino kibaawo enkomera bwe zitakuumibwa. Singa omuntu oyo yabeera kumpi ne Katonda, n'atambulira mu bwesimbu, n'anyumirwa okubeerawo kw'Omwoyo okujjudde mu bulamu obutukuvu n'okulindirira n'obugumiikiriza, yandimanyi bulungi ensalo we eri. Yandimanyi obanga ettaka lye lya kitundu kya Batukuvu-Bonna, oba lya Kitali-kya-Muntu, oba lya kitundu Setaani gy'afuga.

Nawulira ku mutukuvu omukadde omwagalwa eyagamba nti, nga ali kumpi n'okufa, nga alumbibwa Setaani. Yawuuba engalo ye mpola n'agamba nti, “Nalondebwa! Nalondebwa! Nalondebwa!” Yamanya nti yalondebwa, era n'ajjukira ebigambo nti, “Mukama eyalonda Yerusaalemi akunenye” (Zekkaliya 3:2, ESV). Olukomera bwe luyimirira nga lunywevu okwetooloola ennimiro, tusobola okuziyiza Setaani ne tumugamba nti, “Leka ebintu bya Mukama. Nze ndi wa Kristo, si wa iwe.” Okwogera bw'otyo, oteekwa okuddaabiriza enkomera n'obwegendereza, ensalo eryoke ebe nga eyeeyolefu era osobole okulangirira nti, “Abayingirira awamu, mwegendereze.” Towa mulabe wadde luta lumu. Yimusa ekisenge waggulu bw'agezaako okulirinnya. Aleme kufuna wabaawo mwagi mwayinza okuyingirira.

Ekyokubiri, ekisenge bwe kigwa, okukuumibwa kubula. Omuntu bw'aba n'omutima ogutaliiko lukomera, ebirowoozo bye bibunyaana ku nsozi ez'obutaliimu. Ng'endiga, ebirowoozo biteekwa okukomerwa, oba biriwabawaba.

Dawudi yagamba nti, “Nkyawa ebirowoozo eby'obutaliimu” (Zabbuli 119:113, ESV). Abagayaavu balina bingi ku byo, kubanga okuggyako nga buli mwagi guziyiziddwa era buli mulyango guggaddwa, ebirowoozo eby'obutaliimu bijja kufubutuka ne biyingira. Okulowooza okutukuvu, okufumiitiriza okuwooza, okwegomba okw'okutya Katonda, n'okussa kimu ne Katonda eky'ekisa biriweddewo bwe tuleka ekisenge kimenyeke olw'obugayaavu.

Ebirungi bwe bigenda, ebibi bijja. Ekisenge bwe kigudde, buli ayitawo alaba nga ayitibwa.

Omulyango muggule, era bayingira. Waliwo ebibala? Babinoga. Batambula ng'abali mu paaka ey'olukale ne banyaba mu buli nsonda. Waliwo ekifo eky'ekyama mu mutima gwo eri Yesu yekka? Setaani n'ensi bajja kukiyingira. Lwaki twewuunye? Buli nsolo eyewaba erinnyirira era eyonoona ebisukka ku by'erya bwe watabaawo miryango miggule. Bwe kityo, buli ngeri ya kwegomba n'ekifaananyi ekibi biriira emmeeme etakuumiddwa.

Tekigasa kusaba nti, “Totutwala mu kukemebwa” (Matayo 6:13, ESV), bw'oba weegenderera okutambulira eri kwo. Katonda tajja kukutwala mu kukemebwa, naye ggwe oyinza okwetwala. Bw'oweeyanjuluza eri ebibi, onakuwaza Omwoyo wa Katonda, era ayinza okukuleka okukungula ebivaamu eby'obusirusiru bwo. Tekyandibadde kya magezi okuddaabiriza olukomera mangu ago?

Waliwo ekivaamu ekirala: ettaka lyennyini liyinza okubula. Mu Bungereza, ekisenge ekimenyese tekiggyawo bwannannyini; naye mu Palesitaina, ennimiro ez'oku busozi zaanywezebwa enkomera ez'amadaala. Enkomera ezo bwe zaagwa, ettaka lyaseerera, ddaala ku ddaala, n'emizabbibu n'emiti nabyo ne bigenda.

Olwo enkuba n'eyiwa ettaka lyonna, n'esigazaawo olwazi olukalu lwokka.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri mu by'omwoyo. Omuntu ayinza okwerekereza ye ne by'omwoyo—ng'afuuka atafaayo ku njigiriza n'obulamu obutukuvu—okutuusa amaanyi ge ag'okukola obulungi lwe gaggwaawo. Amagezi ge, omutima gwe, n'amaanyi ge bulabika ng'ebulawo. Nnabbi yagamba nti, “Efuraimu ali ng'ejjiba, omusirusiru era atalina magezi” (Koseya 7:11, ESV).

Bangi mayiba masirusiru bwe batyo. Omuntu asaaga n'eddiini asaaga n'emmeeme ye era amangu ago afuuka atasobola kulowooza kwa maanyi wadde okuweereza okuli n'omugaso.

Kale nno, yimirira ng'onywevu ku lunaku luno olubi. Ebirowoozo eby'eddiini bwe biseerera ng'ettosi mu Nnyanja Enfu ey'obutakkiriza, zimba ebisenge ebinywevu okwetooloola obulamu bwo, okukkiriza kwo, n'empisa zo. “Kale muyimirire” (Abaefeso 6:14, ESV), era bwe mumala okukola byonna, mukyayimirire. Omwoyo Omutukuvu abasse emirandira era abanyweze, muleme okusuula obwesige bwammwe, “obulina empeera ennene” (Abaebbulaniya 10:35, ESV).

Ekisembayo, ka ngezeeko okuzuukusa omugayaavu. Kiseera kya kugolokoka. Enjuba emaze okukaza omusulo. Osaba “otulo tutono nate.” Bw'oyongera okwebaka akaseera, oyinza obutazuukuka okutuusa lw'oyimusa amaaso go mu nsi endala. Golokoka kaakano. Buuka okuva ku kitanda kyo nga tekinnaba kufuuka ntaana yo.

Tunuulira omutima gwo. Obutafaayo buleseewo ebibi okumera ng'omuddo. Werekereza Katonda ne Kristo okutuusa lw'ofuuse ow'ensi, atafaayo, atassaayo mwoyo. Abamu ku mmwe emabega mwakwata erinnya ettukuvu; kaakano mufaanana ng'ensi. Kebera ebivudde mu bisenge byo ebyalekebwa. Weegeraageranye n'abakkiriza abanyiikivu—abaavu era abatasoma oboolyawo—abaweereza Kristo n'obwesigwa. N'ebirabo byo byonna n'emikisa gyo, ofuuse omuweereza atalina mugaso. Si kiseera kya kwewuubaala?

Lowooza ku balala abaali baagala okuzuukuka oluvannyuma. Abamu bagudde mu kibi eky'olwatu ne baswaza Kristo. Baagenda katono okusinga ggwe. Omutima gwo gufaanagana nnyo. Wansi w'okukemebwa okufaanana, oyinza okugwa nga bwe baagwa. Omwatuzi omugayaavu mwetegefu eri kintu kyonna. Omutima omugayaavu gwe muliro gw'ensasi za Setaani.

Jjukira okujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Anaakusanga ng'weebase? Jjukira omusango. Kya kunsonga ki ky'onooleeta olw'ebiseera ebyayosebwa n'ebirabo ebitakozesebwa, Mukama w'olimu bw'alidda?

Naawe, munnange atakyusibwa, bw'onooyita mu bulamu awatali kufaayo ku mmeeme yo, tolirema kuzikirira. “Obanga omutuukirivu alokolebwa n'obuzibu, omwonoonyi n'atatya Katonda balifuuka batya?”

(1 Peetero 4:18, ESV). Obulokozi bwonna bwa kisa; naye ekisa tekireeta bugayaavu wadde butafaayo. Kireeta amaanyi, obunyiikivu, obwaka, obutakoowa, n'okwefiiriza.

Katonda atuwe okubeera kw'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu munda mu ffe, byonna biryoke bitegekebwe, ebibi bikuulibwe okuva mu mutima, era omuntu yenna akuumibwe olw'ekisa ekitukuza okuva eri abazikiriza abakweka okumpi na buli lukomera oluwadde. Ayi Mukama, mu kisa jjukira ffe. Tukomere n'amaanyi go. Tukuume okuva mu bugayaavu obwandituleseewo eri ekibi, olwa Yesu. Amiina.
fields.body_text: Okuva mu nnimiro y'emizabbibu ey'omugayaavu eyalekebwa awo n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja ekyamenyeka, mujja essomo eritutuumufu— fumiitiriza n'obwegendereza engeri obutafaayo mu by'omwoyo, emisingi eginafuye, n'okwenenya okulwawo bwe biviirako emmeeme okusigala nga teyeekuumidde eri okuzikirira okusooba mpola. “Nayita ku nnimiro y'omugayaavu, ne ku nnimiro y'emizabbibu ey'omuntu atalina magezi, era laba, yonna yali ejjudde amaggwa; obuso bwayo bwali bubisiddwa omuddo oguluma, n'ekisenge kyayo eky'amayinja kyali kimenyese. Awo ne ndaba ne nkifumiitiriza; ne ntunula ne mpeebwa okuyigirizibwa.” Engero 24:30–32 (ESV) Omusajja ono omugayaavu teyakola kabi eri banne: teyali mubbi, wadde omukambwe, wadde eyeeyingiza mu bya balala. Teyeeraliikiriranga bya balala, kubanga n'ebibye ye teyabifangako—kyali kyetaagisa okufuba kungi nnyo. Teyali mwonoonyi mu lwatu; teyalina maanyi ga kukola ekyo. Yayagalanga okutwala ebintu mpola. Bulijjo yalekanga ekituufu nga bwe kiri, ate era, mu ngeri y'emu, yalekanga n'ekibi nga bwe kiri, ng'omuddo n'amaggwa ebyali mu nnimiro ye bwe byakiraga mu lwatu. Kyali kya nkyo ki okweteganya? Byonna byandibadde bye bimu emyaka ekikumi okuva kaakano; bw'atyo yatwala ebintu nga bwe byajjanga. Teyali muntu mubi, bwe bagamba abamu ku ye; ate era, oboolyawo, ku nkomerero kirilabika nti tewali muntu mubi okusinga oyo atali mulungi.
