Mu mutima gw'omuntu ssekinnoomu, singa wabaddewo okumera awatali mukisa gwa Katonda, tekwandireese birungi bya nnamaddala. Ka tugambe nti oli n'okwegomba okulungi, naye awatali mukisa ku kwo—kwandikutawaanyizza ne kukubonyaabonya kwokka. Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, kwandibudde, era oyinza okufuuka omukakanyavu okusinga edda eri okukwatibwa okw'eddiini. Okwegomba okw'eddiini bwe kutava eri Katonda wabula ne kuva mu kusagaasagana, kuyinza okukugaana okutwala Ekigambo kya Katonda n'obuzito mu biseera eby'omu maaso. Okukwatibwa okutagonza mutima kugukakanyaza. Lowooza ku abo abaawulira engeri ey'okumera nga tebatwaliddwa eri Kristo—abamu babetenteddwa okugwa mu bujoozi.

Abantu oluusi bagamba nti eddiini eyusa abantu—si mazima mu bungi bwabwe, naye tewali kubuusabuusa nti ekika ekimu eky'obunyiikivu obw'eddiini kireese bangi mu ddalu.

Emmeeme zino ez'ennaku zaawulira ebiwundu byazo naye tezaalaba ddagala. Tezaamanya Yesu.

Zaawulira ekibi kyazo naye tezaddukira mu bubudamo Katonda bw'awa. Teweewuunya singa abantu bagenda mu ddalu bwe bagaana Omulokozi. Kiyinza okuba omusango Katonda gw'asalira abo, ne mu bunaku obungi, abagaana okudduka eri Kristo. Eri abamu, bwe kiba—muteekwa okudduka eri Yesu, oba omugugu gwammwe guneeyongera okuzitowa okutuusa omwoyo gwammwe lwe gunaamenyeka. Kino si nsobi ya ddiini, wabula ya abo abagaana eddagala ly'ewa. Okumera kw'okwegomba awatali mukisa gwa Katonda kwandibadde kya ntiisa, naye tumwebaza nti tetulekeddwa mu mbeera ng'eyo.

V. Ne kaakano nnyongera ku kirowoozo ekizzaamu amaanyi nti Katonda awa omukisa “okumera kwayo.” Njagala okwogera eri abo abawewuufu era abateganyiziddwa, okulaga nti Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwammwe, emirundi mingi mu ngeri nnyingi. Emirundi mingi akikola ng'ayita mu ssanyu ettono. Olina obudde obumu obuwoomerera nnyo: toyinza kugamba nti oli wa Kristo, naye oluusi endege z'omutima gwo zivuga ku linnya lye. Eby'ekisa bikuwoomera. Bw'ogenda okusinza, owulira emirembe emitukuvu, era ovaayo ng'oyagala waaliwo ssabbiiti musanvu mu wiiki mu kifo ky'emu. Olw'omukisa gwa Katonda, Ekigambo kiyinza okulabika ng'ekyogeddwa ku mbeera yo yokka: oteeka wamu emmuli zo okumala akaseera n'otandika okudduka. Newaakubadde ng'essanyu lino liyinza okuba eddibi, biba bubonero bwa birungi.

Ku luuyi olulala, bw'oba ofunye essanyu ttono oba nga tolina n'akatono, era ng'eby'ekisa bikuleetedde okubudaabudibwa okutono, kirowoozeeko ng'omukisa. Oluusi omukisa omunene kwe kuba nti Katonda aggyawo essanyu okusobola okwanguya okudduka kwo eri enkomerero. Omuntu bw'adduka eri Ekibuga eky'Obubudamo ng'awonawo omuyizzi, kiyinza okuba eky'amagezi okumuleka awummuleko okuddamu amaanyi, naye obulabe nga bulaali, ekikolwa eky'ekisa okusinga kiyinza okuba okumuwa ekitali kyonna, alyoke adduke n'embiro ezitakendeeza. Mukama ayinza okuba ng'akuwa omukisa ng'ayita mu butabeera bwo bulungi. Bw'oba tosobola kugamba nti oli mu Kristo, kiyinza okuba omukisa omunene okuggyawo essanyu eddala olyoke owalirizibwe okudduka gy'ali. Mpozzi obutuukirivu bwo bwennyini obumu bukyaliwo mu ggwe, era okutuusa lwe bunaggwaawo, toyinza kufuna ssanyu na mirembe egya mazima mu Kristo.

Ekyambalo eky'obwakabaka ky'akuwa tekirimasamasa okutuusa buli kiwero eky'obulungi bwaffe ffennyini lwe kiggyibwawo. Okutya emirundi mingi kutwala abantu eri okukkiriza. Tolabanga kanyonyi akatiitiizi nga kabuuka mu kifuba ky'omuntu kubanga kampago kakagoba? Tekandibuuse awatali kutya kukawaliriza. Bwe kityo bwe kiyinza okuba gy'oli; okutya kwo kuyinza okukwanguyiza okudduka eri Omulokozi, era bwe kiba bwe kityo, n'ennaku zino kaakano bubonero nti Katonda awa omukisa “okumera kwayo.”

Bwe ntunula emabega ku kumera kwange, oluusi ndowooza nti Katonda yampa omukisa mu kiseera ekyo mu ngeri esinga okulungi n'okusinga kaakano. Newaakubadde nga sandyagadde kudda mu mutendera ogwo ogusooka, gwalimu essanyu lingi.

Omuti gw'emiyembe ogujjudde ebibala mulungi, naye omuti gw'emiyembe ogumulisizza gusinga okuba omulungi. Omukristaayo omukulu ajjudde ebibala kya kulabika kirungi, naye omukkiriza omuto alina obulungi obw'enjawulo. Oyinza kaakano okuwulira okukyawa ekibi okusinga abakkiriza abakuze bangi, era obuwewuufu bw'omuntu wo ow'omunda buyinza okusinga obwabwe. Olina okutegeera okw'obuvunaanyizibwa okusinga obuwanvu, okutya okw'ekitiibwa okulema okulagajjalira, n'obunyiikivu obungi.

Okola emirimu gyo egisooka eri Katonda, ng'oyaka olw'okwagala okusooka; tewali kirabika kizibu oba kizito nnyo. Nsaba nti toweddemu maanyi n'akatono, wabula okulaganga mu maaso bulijjo.

Ne kaakano, nga ndaga ku nkomerero. Ndaba amasomo asatu ku ffe. Ekisooka, abatukuvu abakadde basaanidde okuba abakkakkamu era ab'ekisa eri abakkiriza abato. Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwayo—ka naffe tukole bwe tutyo. Temuzikiza kwegomba kw'abato oba okuzikiriza abakkiriza abaggya n'ebibuuzo ebizibu. Nga bakyali baana abeetaaga amata g'Ekigambo, temubazitoowereza n'emmere enkalubo; banaakulira mu yo. Mujjukire nti Yakobo teyawaliriza ndiga—mubeere ba kwegendereza mu ngeri y'emu. Muyigirize era muluŋŋamye n'obukkakkamu n'obuwewuufu, si nga abakulembeze, wabula ng'abazadde abalabirira olwa Kristo. Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwayo—akuwe omukisa ng'ayita mu mmwe!

Essomo ery'okubiri kwe kutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okwebaza. Katonda bw'awa omukisa okumera kwayo, tusaanidde okwebaza ne ku kisa ekitono. Bw'oba olabye akatuuti akasooka kokka nga kayasa ettaka, weebaze, era olilaba akalagala akato akawuuba mu mpewo; weebaze olw'omuddo ogutuuka ku bikere, era olilaba amatabi nga gatandika okukwata; weebaze olw'amatabi amabisi agasooka, era olilaba eŋŋaano ng'emulisa era ng'eyengera eri amakungula.

Essomo ery'okusatu kwe kuzzaamu amaanyi. Katonda bw'awa omukisa “okumera kwayo,” kiki ky'atalikola mu nnaku ez'omu maaso? Bw'akuwa emmere efaanana bw'etyo bw'osooka okumenya okusiiba kwo, mbaga ki gy'alikutegekera bw'aligamba nti, “Jjangu, olye”? Mbaga ki eyeetegese ku kijjulo ky'Omwana gw'Endiga! Ai emmeeme eteganyiziddwa, leka amayengo, omuzira, n'embuyaga ez'obutiti eziruma okumera kwo, byerabirwe mu kirowoozo kino ekizzaamu amaanyi: Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwo, era Katonda gw'awa omukisa tewali ayinza kumukolimira. Waggulu w'omutwe gwo, ggwe emmeeme eyeegomba era esaba, Mukama w'eggulu n'ensi akulangirira omukisa ogwa Kitaffe, n'Omwana, n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Twala omukisa ogwo era ogusanyukire emirembe gyonna. Amiina.
fields.body_text: Katonda awa omukisa ekiseera eky'okumera eky'emmeeme, ng'ateekateeka emitima okukula. Nga bw'afukirira ensi, bw'atyo Omwoyo we akuza okukkiriza okuggya, okwegomba okuwewuufu, okusaba, n'essuubi, ng'assaawo omusingi gw'amakungula ag'omwoyo agabala era agawangaala. "Okyalira ensi n'ogifukirira; ogigaggawaza nnyo; omugga gwa Katonda gujjudde amazzi; obawa emmere yaabwe ey'empeke, kubanga bw'otyo bw'oteekateeka ensi." Zabbuli 65:9-10. Newaakubadde ng'ebiseera ebirala biyinza okusinga mu bujjuvu, ekiseera eky'okumera kirabika obulungi olw'obuggya n'obulungi bwakyo. Twebaza Katonda ng'ekiseera eky'amakungula kituuse ne wabaawo eŋŋaano eya zaabu eyeetegese; naye era tusaanidde okumwebaza olw'ekiseera eky'okumera, ekiteekateeka amakungula. Enkuba eya April ereeta ebimuli bya May, era obunnyogovu n'obutobevu bw' enkuba ereeta obulungi bw'ekyeeya. Katonda awa omukisa ekiseera eky'okumera, nga bw'ateekerateekera ekyeeya; kyeva kitusaanira okumutendereza omwaka gwonna. Ekiseera eky'okumera eky'omwoyo kiseera kya mukisa mu Kkanisa. Okukkiriza okuto kukula, era tuwulira n'essanyu nti, “Tulabye Mukama.” Abaana baffe bameruka ng'omuddo n'emiti egy'oku mabbali g'amazzi. Tuwuniikirira ne twebuuza nti, “Abo be baani abajja ng'ebire, era ng'amayiba nga gadda mu bituli byago?” Mu kiseera eky'okuzuukusibwa, Katonda bw'aleeta abangi gy'ali, Kkanisa esanyuka era eyinza okugamba nti, “Owa omukisa okumera kwayo” (Zabbuli 65:9-10). Nnaassa essira ku mbeera z'abantu ssekinnoomu. Waliwo ekiseera ekisa lwe kitandika okumera, nga bw'akatuuti bwe kayasa ettaka eddaawo era eryomu. Njagala okwogera ku mukisa oguweebwa akalagala akato aka kw'okutya Katonda okumera, eri abo abatandika okusuubira mu Mukama. 1. Emirimu Emisooka Okumera. Ekyawandiikibwa kiraga nti Katonda yekka y'ateekwa okukola emirimu egimu ng'okumera tekunnaba kujja, era akolera ne mu ffe. Waliwo omulimu gwe tulina. Obulamu obuggya nga tebunnaba kulabika mu mmeeme, wateekwa okubaawo okulima, okwabya, n'okusiga. Ettaka lyeteekwa okuteekebwateekebwa, naye tetusuubira kukungula mangu ago. Katonda yeebazibwe, oluusi omukunguzi asinga omulimi, naye si bulijjo. Mu mitima egimu, Katonda akankamya ekiseera ekiwanvu era eky'amaanyi; amateeka gasima nnyo okutuusa buli kitundu ky'emmeeme lwe kirimibwa. Okukankamibwa kutuuka ku ntobo y'omwoyo, ne kugufumita. Katonda bw'akola, ettaka ly'omutima limenyebwa olw'okubaawo kwe. Oluvannyuma lujja okusiga. Okumera kubeeyo, waliwo ekiteekwa okusigibwa. Omubuulizi bw'amala okukozesa enkumbi y'amateeka, akozesa ensigo ey'enjiri. Ebisuubizo eby'enjiri, enjigiriza, n'okuyigiriza okw'olwatu ku kisa ekya bwereere n'okutangirira, birekebwa ng'ensigo bwe misuula. Egimu gigwa ku kkubo ne gibula, naye egirala gigwa ku ttaka eryateekebwateekebwa ne gisigalamu. Ekiddako kwe kwabya. Tetuyinza kuleka nsigo nga tumaze okugisiga; eteekwa okusabirwa. Okusaba okw'omubuulizi n'okwa Kkanisa kubikka ku nsigo, ne kugikweka mu mutima gw'omuwuliriza. Nkirundulula kino okuzzaamu amaanyi abo abatalabye bibala mangu—baleme okuggwaamu essuubi—naye era ng'okulabula eri abo abasuubira amakungula nga tewasoose kuteekateeka. Okuzuukusibwa okw'amangwago awatali kufuba kwa kusaba tekutera kuwangaala. Okuzuukusibwa okuwangaala kuva mu kufuba kungi, okwegomba, okwegayirira, n'okukuuma. Omuweereza wa Katonda abuulira ka abantu babeere beeteeseteese oba nedda, naye okulaba omukisa omunene, emitima giteekwa okuteekebwateekebwa. 2. Emirimu Egisukka Amaanyi Gaffe. Oluvannyuma lw'okulima, okusiga, n'okwabya, wateekwa okujja enkuba okuva mu ggulu. “Okyalira ensi n'ogifukirira” (Zabbuli 65:9). Okufuba kwaffe kwa bwereere awatali mukisa gwa Katonda nga guyita mu Mwoyo. Ai Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ggwe wekka gw'okola eby'ekitalo mu mutima gw'omuntu, ng'ova eri Kitaffe n'Omwana okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bya Katonda. Waliwo ebikolwa bisatu ebyogerwako: Okufukirira obusenyi: Nga enkuba bw'ejjuza obusenyi, bw'atyo Omwoyo asensera era n'akwata buli kitundu ky'omutima. Okutegeera kwakenkanyizibwa, omuntu ow'omunda azuukusibwa, okwagala kufugibwa, n'okwegomba kukoledwa omuliro. Twanjula amazima g'enjiri, naye Omwoyo wa Katonda yekka y'ayinza okukwata omutima ddala. Okuteeka obulungi ensalosalo: Enkuba enkalubo ekunya ettaka. Mu ngeri y'emu, Omwoyo atoowaza era n'anywevu emmeeme. Omutima ogw'amalala era ogutali munywevu gufuuka omunywevu era omuzitowavu. Ebirowoozo eby'ekitiibwa n'amalala ag'omubiri gassibwa wansi. Obwetoowaze obwa nnamaddala kye kibala eky'ekisa eky'Omwoyo. “Omutima ogumenyese era ogumenyefu, Ai Katonda, toligunyooma” (Zabbuli 51:17). Okugonza n'enkuba: Omutima gw'omuntu mu buzaaliranwa mukalubo, ng'ettaka eryomu. Omwoyo agugonza kyenkanyi. Omutima oguweera okwo gubaamu okuwulira ne guddamu; amaziga gakulukuta, obuwewuufu bukula. Bino byonna mulimu gwa Katonda. Katonda akolera mu ffe, naye ye yekka aweereza enkuba ey'ekisa. Mpozzi akola mu bamu ku mmwe kaakano, newaakubadde ng'obulamu obw'omwoyo tebunnalabika. Embeera yammwe eyinza okulabika ng'ennaku, naye tusuubira nti mu bwangu ensigo ey'ekisa erimera, era Mukama awe omukisa okumera kwayo. II. Ekyokubiri, katutegeeze mu bufunze okumera kwayo. Oluvannyuma lw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okubaawo mu kasirise okumala ekiseera, nga bwe kisanyusa Omukama era Omulimi omukulu, wandiitandika okulabika obubonero obw'ekisa. Mujjukire ebigambo by'omutume nti: “Okusooka akalagala, oluvannyuma amatabi, oluvannyuma eŋŋaano ejjuvu mu matabi” (Makko 4:28). Abamu banyolwa nnyo kubanga tebalaba ŋŋaano njjuvu mu matabi mu bo bennyini. Balowooza nti singa baabadde ba mulimu gwa Katonda, bandibadde nga Bakristaayo abamu abakuze be bakwatagana nabo, oba be bayinza okusoma ku byafaayo byabwe. Abaagalwa, guno gwe kusobya okunene. Ekisa bwe kisooka okuyingira mu mutima, tekiba ng'omuti omunene ogubikka ekitundu ekinene n'ekisiikirize kyagwo, wabula kiba ng'ensigo esinga obutono, ng'akaweke ke kaladaali. Bwe kasooka okumera mu mmeeme, tekiba ng'enjuba eyaka ku ttuntu, wabula kiba ng'omuzira omusooka ogw'obudde nga bukya. Mulina obusirusiru okusuubira amakungula nga temunnayita mu kiseera eky'okumera? Nsuubira nti nga nnyinnyonnyola omutendera ogusooka ogw'obulamu obwa Kristaayo, muyinza okugamba nti, “Ntuuse okutuuka wano,” ne mwesanyusa mu kigambo nti: “Owa omukisa okumera kwayo” (Zabbuli 65:9-10). Kale, kwe kutya okumera kw'okutya Katonda mu mutima? Tulowooza nti kusooka kulabika mu kwegomba okw'amazima era okw'amaanyi okulokolebwa. Omuntu tannalokolebwa mu ndaba ye ye, naye ayaayaanira okulokolebwa. Ekyo ekyali tekimufaako kaakano kimweraliikiriza nnyo. Edda yanyooma Abakristaayo n'alowooza nti banyiikira awatali nsonga, n'alowooza nti eddiini kya bwereere, era n'atwala eby'ensi nga bye bintu ebyokka eby'omugaso; naye kaakano akyusiddwa. Akwatirwa obuggya Omukristaayo asinga obwetoowaze, era yandiwanyisizza n'omukkiriza asinga obwavu singa yakakasibwa amaka mu ggulu. Eby'ensi bifiiriddwa obuyinza bwabyo, era eby'omwoyo bye bisinze. Edda, ng'abangi, yakaaba nti, “Ani anaatulaga ekirungi?” naye kaakano akaaba nti, “Nnyweza omusana gw'amaaso go ku nze, Ai Mukama” (Zabbuli 4:6). Edda yali mmere ya mpeke na wayini ebyaleeta essanyu, naye kaakano ye Katonda yekka. Olwazi lwe olw'obubudamo luteekwa okuba Katonda, kubanga tewali ssanyu alifuna awalala. Okwegomba kwe okutukuvu, edda okwali kuggwaawo ng'omukka ogw'oku kikoomi, kaakano kuwangaala, newaakubadde nga tekuli kwenkanankana buli kiseera. Oluusi, okwegomba kuno kufuuka enjala n'ennyonta ey'obutuukirivu, naye tebakkuta era beegomba okwegomba okusinga obuwanvu eri eby'omu ggulu. Okwegomba kuno kwe kumu ku kumera okusooka okw'obulamu obwa Katonda mu mmeeme. “Okumera kwayo” kuddako okweraga mu kusaba. Kaakano kusaba kwa mazima. Edda, ebigambo byali kunyooma Katonda, amaloboozi awatali mutima; naye kaakano, newaakubadde ng'okusaba tekuli ngeri okutu kw'omuntu lwe kuyinza okuwulira, Katonda akukkiriza, kubanga kwe kwogera kw'omwoyo eri Katonda, si kutemya kw'emimwa eri Katonda atamanyiddwa. Okusaba kuyinza okuba okumpi: “Oh!” “Ah!” “Singa Katonda!” “Mukama, onsaasire nze omwonoonyi!” n'okukaaba okumpi okufaanana; naye kwe kusaba. “Laba, asaba” tekitegeeza buwanvu, wabula n'okussa ekikkowe oba erizziga kikakasa obulamu obw'omwoyo. “Okusinda kuno okutayogerekeka” kwe kumu ku “kumera kwayo” (Abaruumi 8:26). Wagenda okulabikawo n'okwagala eby'ekisa n'ennyumba ya Katonda. Baibuli, eyamala ebbanga nga tesomebwa era ng'etwalibwa ng'etasinga kalenda ka kadda mugaso, kaakano etwalibwa n'ekitiibwa. Ne bw'ereeta essanyu ttono era n'entiisa nnyingi mu kiseera, ekyo ekitabo ky'emmeeme, era omusomi akyuka eri empapula zaakyo n'essuubi. Mu kugenda mu nnyumba ya Katonda, omukkiriza awuliriza n'obunyiikivu, ng'asuubira obubaka obuva eri Mukama. Edda, okusinza kwabeerangako ng'omulimu gwa mpisa; kaakano kuba lwa kunoonya Omulokozi. Edda tewali ddiini mu mmeeme okusinga mu luggi olukyukira ku njoola zaalwo; kaakano omutima guyingira mu nnyumba nga gusaba nti, “Mukama, sisinkane n'emmeeme yange,” era omukisa bwe gutajja, guvaayo nga gusinda nti, “Singa mmanyi we nnaamusanga, ndyoke ntuuke ne ku ntebe ye.” Kano ke kamu ku bubonero obw'omukisa obwa “kumera kwayo.” Akabonero akalala kwe kuba nti emmeeme etandika okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo, wadde katono. Kiyinza obutaleeta ssanyu lingi oba mirembe, naye kikuuma omutima okulema okuggwaamu essuubi era ne kikugaana okusaanawo wansi w'omugugu gw'ekibi. Nnamanya ebiseera nga tewali eyayinza kulaba kukkiriza mu nze, era nange nnali sisobola kukulaba mu nze, naye nnali muvumu okugamba ne Peetero nti, “Mukama, omanyi byonna; omanyi nti nkwagala” (Yokaana 21:17). Omuntu ky'atasobola kulaba, Kristo akiraba. Bangi beeyongera nnyo okulowooza ku kukkiriza kwabwe okutono nga tebakitegeera; naye bwe balaba eri Kristo so si eri okukkiriza kwabwe, banaalaba Kristo n'okukkiriza kwabwe. Bayinza okwegeraageranya n'abakkiriza abakuze ne bawulira ng'okukkiriza kwabwe kutono nnyo, naye n'okukkiriza okusinga obutono okufuna Kristo kumala. Mujjukire nti: “Bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda” (Yokaana 1:12). Okukkiriza okunafu kukyali kukkiriza, era Katonda awa omukisa “okumera kwayo.” Ekizibu emirundi mingi kiva mu kutategeera oba obutaba na bwesige mu Katonda. Okutategeera kuli ng'okulaba eŋŋaano embisi omulundi ogusooka n'olowooza nti muddo bufu. Naye omuntu bw'agimanya, tekiba kya kitalo okulaba eŋŋaano ng'eyita mu mitendera: okusooka akalagala, oluvannyuma amatabi, era ekisembayo eŋŋaano ejjuvu mu matabi. Bangi ku bakkiriza abaakakyusibwa bawulira nti tebafaanana ndala na Bakristaayo abakuze, naye babeera busirawo mu mutendera ogukyasooka. Omuntu ateekwa okuyita mu mutendera gw'akalagala nga tannatuuka ku mutendera gw'amatabi, era mu mutendera gw'amatabi, wayinza okubaawo okubuusabuusa ku kutuuka ku ŋŋaano ejjuvu; naye mu kiseera kyakyo, obukulu bulijja. Mwebaze Katonda nti muli mu Kristo ddala. Ka okukkiriza kube kunene oba kutono, ka musobole okukolera Kristo ebingi oba ebitono, okulokolebwa tekusinziira ku kye muli wabula ku ky'ali Yesu Kristo. Okumwesiga, ka okukkiriza kwammwe kube kutono kutya, kubakuuma nga muli bulungi ng'abatukuvu abasinga amaanyi. Naye awamu n'okutategeera, emirundi mingi wabaawo obutakkiriza. Si byonna bya butamanya bwa kusonyiyibwa; waliwo n'obutakkiriza obw'ekibi. Ai omwonoonyi, lwaki teweesiga Kristo? Katonda akuwa ekigambo kye nti abo abamwesiga tebasalirwa musango, naye ggwe oyinza okutya nti osaliddwa. Kino kubuusabuusa amazima ga Katonda. Kwatibwe ensonyi olw'okubuusabuusa ekisuubizo kye. Ebibi ebirala byonna binakuwaza Kristo okusinga ekibi eky'okumubuusabuusa nti tajja kusonyiwa, oba nti alisuula oyo amwesiga. Tovvoola mpisa ye ey'ekisa. “Oyo ajja gye ndi sirimugoba n'akatono” (Yokaana 6:37). Jja n'okukkiriza, era anaakusembeza mangwago. Bwe ntyo nnyinnyonnyodde “okumera kwayo.” III. Ekyokusatu, ng'ekyawandiikibwa bwe kigamba, waliwo omu alaba okumera kuno: Ggwe, Mukama—“Owa omukisa okumera kwayo” (Zabbuli 65:9). Nnandyagadde tubeere n'amaaso amawambufu okulaba entandikwa y'ekisa mu balala; olw'obutassaayo mwoyo, tuleka emikisa mingi egy'okuyamba abanafu. Maama bw'alabirira abaana be, alaba obubonero obusooka obw'obulwadde amangwago; kale tusaanidde nnyo okulabirira n'obwegendereza emmeeme ez'omuwendo. Abakkiriza abato bangi bayinza okugumira wiiki oba emyezi egy'ennaku etaliiko nsonga singa ffe abamanyi Mukama tetussaayo mwoyo. Abasumba babeera awo ekiro kyonna mu kiseera eky'okuzaala kw'endiga, okuwamba n'okulabirira abaana b'endiga abaakazaalibwa; naffe, ng'abasumba ba Katonda, tusaanidde okulabirira abaana bonna abaakazaalibwa mu kisibo kye, naddala ng'abangi bajja gy'ali, kubanga okulabirira okw'obwegendereza kwetaagibwa mu mitendera egisooka egy'obulamu obuggya. Ne bwe tukusubwa, Katonda alaba “okumera kwayo.” Mmwe emmeeme ensirise, ez'ekyama, ezitaagala kwogera na muntu, mugume omwoyo: Katonda alaba obulamu bwammwe obuggya. Ne bwe mulowooza bwokka nti, “Nnaagolokoka ne ŋŋenda eri Kitange,” awulira. Ne bwe kuba kwegomba kwokka, akiwandiika. “Okuŋŋaanyizza amaziga gange mu ccupa yo; tegaali mu kitabo kyo?” (Zabbuli 56:8). Alabirira okudda kwo, akugwa mu kifuba, era akwaniriza n'okwagala okuwewuufu. Gumibwe omwoyo nti wonna w'oli—mu kisenge kyo oba mu kyama—Katonda aliwo. “Ggwe Katonda ondaba” (Olubereberye 16:13). “Mukama asanyukira abo abamutya, abo abasuubira mu kisa kye eky'obwesigwa” (Zabbuli 147:11). Ne kutya oba essuubi eritono kumusanyusa. “Olituukiriza ekigambo ekinkwatako” (Zabbuli 138:8). Emmeeme yo bw'eba n'akeraliikiriza olw'okutabaganyizibwa ne Katonda n'okuba n'omugabo mu musaayi gwa Kristo, kuba “kumera kwayo” kwokka, naye akuwa omukisa. “Olumuli olubetenteddwa talulimenya, era omuliro ogunyookera talugunziya, okutuusa lw'alireeta obwenkanya mu buwanguzi” (Matayo 12:20). Obuwanguzi bujja ne nga emmeeme tennatuuka ku bukulu; n'entandikwa ennafu ennyo ziri wansi w'okulabirira kwa Katonda, era alaba okumera okusooka okw'ekisa. IV. Ebigambo bitono ku nsonga ey'okuna: nga kyandibadde kya nnaku kitya, singa kyandisoboka, okuba n'okumera kuno awatali mukisa gwa Katonda! Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, “Owa omukisa okumera kwayo” (Zabbuli 65:9-10). Katulowooze akaseera okumera bwe kwandibadde awatali mukisa ogwo. Ka tugambe nti wabaddewo okuzuukusibwa mu ffe awatali mukisa gwa Katonda. Nkakasa nti okuzuukusibwa okumu tekuva eri Katonda n'akatono, wabula kuvaako mu kusagaasagana kwokka. Bwe wataba mukisa okuva eri Mukama, kunaaba kulimba kwokka, ejjaaya eryafuuyibwa mu bbanga okumala akaseera ne liggwaawo. Abantu bayinza okusagaasaganyizibwa, oluvannyuma ne bafuuka abateefaayo era abafiiridde okusinga edda, era kino kabi kanene eri Kkanisa. Mu mutima gw'omuntu ssekinnoomu, singa wabaddewo okumera awatali mukisa gwa Katonda, tekwandireese birungi bya nnamaddala. Ka tugambe nti oli n'okwegomba okulungi, naye awatali mukisa ku kwo—kwandikutawaanyizza ne kukubonyaabonya kwokka. Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, kwandibudde, era oyinza okufuuka omukakanyavu okusinga edda eri okukwatibwa okw'eddiini. Okwegomba okw'eddiini bwe kutava eri Katonda wabula ne kuva mu kusagaasagana, kuyinza okukugaana okutwala Ekigambo kya Katonda n'obuzito mu biseera eby'omu maaso. Okukwatibwa okutagonza mutima kugukakanyaza. Lowooza ku abo abaawulira engeri ey'okumera nga tebatwaliddwa eri Kristo—abamu babetenteddwa okugwa mu bujoozi. Abantu oluusi bagamba nti eddiini eyusa abantu—si mazima mu bungi bwabwe, naye tewali kubuusabuusa nti ekika ekimu eky'obunyiikivu obw'eddiini kireese bangi mu ddalu. Emmeeme zino ez'ennaku zaawulira ebiwundu byazo naye tezaalaba ddagala. Tezaamanya Yesu. Zaawulira ekibi kyazo naye tezaddukira mu bubudamo Katonda bw'awa. Teweewuunya singa abantu bagenda mu ddalu bwe bagaana Omulokozi. Kiyinza okuba omusango Katonda gw'asalira abo, ne mu bunaku obungi, abagaana okudduka eri Kristo. Eri abamu, bwe kiba—muteekwa okudduka eri Yesu, oba omugugu gwammwe guneeyongera okuzitowa okutuusa omwoyo gwammwe lwe gunaamenyeka. Kino si nsobi ya ddiini, wabula ya abo abagaana eddagala ly'ewa. Okumera kw'okwegomba awatali mukisa gwa Katonda kwandibadde kya ntiisa, naye tumwebaza nti tetulekeddwa mu mbeera ng'eyo. V. Ne kaakano nnyongera ku kirowoozo ekizzaamu amaanyi nti Katonda awa omukisa “okumera kwayo.” Njagala okwogera eri abo abawewuufu era abateganyiziddwa, okulaga nti Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwammwe, emirundi mingi mu ngeri nnyingi. Emirundi mingi akikola ng'ayita mu ssanyu ettono. Olina obudde obumu obuwoomerera nnyo: toyinza kugamba nti oli wa Kristo, naye oluusi endege z'omutima gwo zivuga ku linnya lye. Eby'ekisa bikuwoomera. Bw'ogenda okusinza, owulira emirembe emitukuvu, era ovaayo ng'oyagala waaliwo ssabbiiti musanvu mu wiiki mu kifo ky'emu. Olw'omukisa gwa Katonda, Ekigambo kiyinza okulabika ng'ekyogeddwa ku mbeera yo yokka: oteeka wamu emmuli zo okumala akaseera n'otandika okudduka. Newaakubadde ng'essanyu lino liyinza okuba eddibi, biba bubonero bwa birungi. Ku luuyi olulala, bw'oba ofunye essanyu ttono oba nga tolina n'akatono, era ng'eby'ekisa bikuleetedde okubudaabudibwa okutono, kirowoozeeko ng'omukisa. Oluusi omukisa omunene kwe kuba nti Katonda aggyawo essanyu okusobola okwanguya okudduka kwo eri enkomerero. Omuntu bw'adduka eri Ekibuga eky'Obubudamo ng'awonawo omuyizzi, kiyinza okuba eky'amagezi okumuleka awummuleko okuddamu amaanyi, naye obulabe nga bulaali, ekikolwa eky'ekisa okusinga kiyinza okuba okumuwa ekitali kyonna, alyoke adduke n'embiro ezitakendeeza. Mukama ayinza okuba ng'akuwa omukisa ng'ayita mu butabeera bwo bulungi. Bw'oba tosobola kugamba nti oli mu Kristo, kiyinza okuba omukisa omunene okuggyawo essanyu eddala olyoke owalirizibwe okudduka gy'ali. Mpozzi obutuukirivu bwo bwennyini obumu bukyaliwo mu ggwe, era okutuusa lwe bunaggwaawo, toyinza kufuna ssanyu na mirembe egya mazima mu Kristo. Ekyambalo eky'obwakabaka ky'akuwa tekirimasamasa okutuusa buli kiwero eky'obulungi bwaffe ffennyini lwe kiggyibwawo. Okutya emirundi mingi kutwala abantu eri okukkiriza. Tolabanga kanyonyi akatiitiizi nga kabuuka mu kifuba ky'omuntu kubanga kampago kakagoba? Tekandibuuse awatali kutya kukawaliriza. Bwe kityo bwe kiyinza okuba gy'oli; okutya kwo kuyinza okukwanguyiza okudduka eri Omulokozi, era bwe kiba bwe kityo, n'ennaku zino kaakano bubonero nti Katonda awa omukisa “okumera kwayo.” Bwe ntunula emabega ku kumera kwange, oluusi ndowooza nti Katonda yampa omukisa mu kiseera ekyo mu ngeri esinga okulungi n'okusinga kaakano. Newaakubadde nga sandyagadde kudda mu mutendera ogwo ogusooka, gwalimu essanyu lingi. Omuti gw'emiyembe ogujjudde ebibala mulungi, naye omuti gw'emiyembe ogumulisizza gusinga okuba omulungi. Omukristaayo omukulu ajjudde ebibala kya kulabika kirungi, naye omukkiriza omuto alina obulungi obw'enjawulo. Oyinza kaakano okuwulira okukyawa ekibi okusinga abakkiriza abakuze bangi, era obuwewuufu bw'omuntu wo ow'omunda buyinza okusinga obwabwe. Olina okutegeera okw'obuvunaanyizibwa okusinga obuwanvu, okutya okw'ekitiibwa okulema okulagajjalira, n'obunyiikivu obungi. Okola emirimu gyo egisooka eri Katonda, ng'oyaka olw'okwagala okusooka; tewali kirabika kizibu oba kizito nnyo. Nsaba nti toweddemu maanyi n'akatono, wabula okulaganga mu maaso bulijjo. Ne kaakano, nga ndaga ku nkomerero. Ndaba amasomo asatu ku ffe. Ekisooka, abatukuvu abakadde basaanidde okuba abakkakkamu era ab'ekisa eri abakkiriza abato. Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwayo—ka naffe tukole bwe tutyo. Temuzikiza kwegomba kw'abato oba okuzikiriza abakkiriza abaggya n'ebibuuzo ebizibu. Nga bakyali baana abeetaaga amata g'Ekigambo, temubazitoowereza n'emmere enkalubo; banaakulira mu yo. Mujjukire nti Yakobo teyawaliriza ndiga—mubeere ba kwegendereza mu ngeri y'emu. Muyigirize era muluŋŋamye n'obukkakkamu n'obuwewuufu, si nga abakulembeze, wabula ng'abazadde abalabirira olwa Kristo. Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwayo—akuwe omukisa ng'ayita mu mmwe! Essomo ery'okubiri kwe kutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa obw'okwebaza. Katonda bw'awa omukisa okumera kwayo, tusaanidde okwebaza ne ku kisa ekitono. Bw'oba olabye akatuuti akasooka kokka nga kayasa ettaka, weebaze, era olilaba akalagala akato akawuuba mu mpewo; weebaze olw'omuddo ogutuuka ku bikere, era olilaba amatabi nga gatandika okukwata; weebaze olw'amatabi amabisi agasooka, era olilaba eŋŋaano ng'emulisa era ng'eyengera eri amakungula. Essomo ery'okusatu kwe kuzzaamu amaanyi. Katonda bw'awa omukisa “okumera kwayo,” kiki ky'atalikola mu nnaku ez'omu maaso? Bw'akuwa emmere efaanana bw'etyo bw'osooka okumenya okusiiba kwo, mbaga ki gy'alikutegekera bw'aligamba nti, “Jjangu, olye”? Mbaga ki eyeetegese ku kijjulo ky'Omwana gw'Endiga! Ai emmeeme eteganyiziddwa, leka amayengo, omuzira, n'embuyaga ez'obutiti eziruma okumera kwo, byerabirwe mu kirowoozo kino ekizzaamu amaanyi: Katonda awa omukisa okumera kwo, era Katonda gw'awa omukisa tewali ayinza kumukolimira. Waggulu w'omutwe gwo, ggwe emmeeme eyeegomba era esaba, Mukama w'eggulu n'ensi akulangirira omukisa ogwa Kitaffe, n'Omwana, n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Twala omukisa ogwo era ogusanyukire emirembe gyonna. Amiina.

fields.title: Abakozi b'omu Nnimiro
fields.body_html:
Ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda, gy’alima n’omukono gwe mu bwegendereza. Tuyitiddwa okukola n’obwesigwa, nga tusiga era nga tufukirira Ekigambo kye, naye ye yekka y’awa okukula. Twewengeyo ddala mu mulimu gwe, nga tubala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kye.

“Nze nnasimba, Apolo n’afukirira; naye Katonda ye yakuza. Kale awo asimba si kintu, newakubadde afukirira, wabula Katonda akuza. N’oyo asimba n’oyo afukirira bali bumu; era buli muntu aliweebwa empeera ye ng’omulimu gwe bwe guli. Kubanga tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu. Muli nnimiro ya Katonda.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:6–9 Nnaatandika ku nkomerero y’ebigambo byange, kubanga ndaba nga y’engeri ennyangu okulambika bye njagala okwogera. Okusooka tulaba nti ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda: “Muli nnimiro ya Katonda.” Ku mbiriizi z’enkyusa eya Revised Version tusoma nti, “Muli ttaka lya Katonda eririmibwa,” era ekyo kye kigambo kye njagala okukozesa. “Muli ttaka lya Katonda eririmibwa,” oba nnimiro. Bwe tumala okwogera ku nnimiro, tunaayogerako katono ku nsonga nti Mukama akozesa abakozi mu byalo bye. Era bwe tunaamala okutunuulira abakozi—abantu abanaku nga bwe bali—tunajjukira nti Katonda yennyini ye mukozi omukulu: “Tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu.”

I. Tutandika nga tulowooza nti ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda. Mukama yafuula ekkanisa okuba eyiye ku bw’okulonda kwe okw’obwakabaka. Era yagifunira ye yennyini ng’agigula, ng’agisasulidde omuwendo omunene ennyo. “Kubanga omugabo gwa Mukama gwe gwe bantu be; Yakobo gwe gugabana obusika bwe.” Buli kibanja ku nnimiro ya Katonda kyawaayo Omulokozi entuuyo ez’omusaayi—weewaawo, omusaayi gw’omutima gwe. Yatwagala n’yeewaayo ku lwaffe; ogwo gwe muwendo gwe yasasula. Okuva kaakano, ekkanisa kya Katonda mu butuufu, era y’alina obwannannyini bwakyo. Kye kisanyusa okumanya nti tetuli baffe ffekka; twagulibwa n’omuwendo. Ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda ku bw’okulonda ne ku bw’okugula.

Ne kaakano agifudde eyiye ng’agizingiza. Edda yali ng’ettaka etterekeddwa bulijjo, nga tekwatiddwa era nga likalu, nga libisiddwa amaggwa n’ebikoola eby’amaggwa, era ng’ennyumba ya buli nsolo ey’omu nsiko; kubanga twali “ku buzaaliranwa baana ba busungu, nga n’abalala bwe bali.” Okumanya kwa Katonda okw’edda kwatunuulira ettaka eryali lifuuse eddungu, n’okwagala okulonda ne kusalirawo omugabo gwalyo n’ekigera ekijjuvu eky’ekisa, nga kitwawulako okuba ebyalo bya Mukama emirembe gyonna. Mu kiseera ekituufu, ekisa eky’amaanyi kyajja n’obuyinza ne kitwawula ku bantu abalala, nga ennimiro bwe zeetooloozebwa olukomera ne zisimibwa emyala okuzaawula ku ttaka eritakwatiddwa. Mukama teyalangirira nti yalonda olusuku lwe n’aluzimbako olukomera?

“Tuli lusuku olwetooloddwa bbugwe, Olulonde era olufuuse ettaka ery’enjawulo; Akafo akatono, akazingiziddwa ekisa Nga kaggiddwa mu ddungu ery’ensi eddene.” Mukama era yafuula ennimiro eno okuba eyiye mu bwannamaddala ng’agirima. Kiki ekirala kye yandikoledde ennimiro ye? Yakyusa ddala obuzaaliranwa bw’ettaka. Okuva ku kuba nga likalu, yalifuula okuba eddebeevu. Yalilima, n’alisima, n’aligaggawaza, n’alifukirira, era n’alisimbamu ebimuli n’ebibala ebya buli ngeri. Limaze okumuwa ebirimba bingi eby’essanyu, era ebiseera ebisingako obulungi bijja, abamalayika lwe balyogerera waggulu essanyu ku makungula, ne Kristo “n’alaba ekibala ky’okutegana kw’emmeeme ye n’akkuta.”

Ennimiro eno ekuumibwa okukuuma kwa Mukama okutasalako. Si kwe kuba nga yagizingiza n’agirima n’amaanyi ge ag’ekyamagero okugifuula ennimiro ye yekka kyokka, wabula agikuuma bulijjo mu bwannannyini bwe.

“Nze, Mukama, nze mukuumi waalwo; buli kaseera ndulukirira. Waleme kubaawo alukola akabi, ndukuuma emisana n’ekiro.” Singa si lwa maanyi ga Katonda agataggwaawo, enkomera zaalwo zandiyise okumenyeka amangu, n’ensolo ez’omu nsiko ne zirya ennimiro zaalwo. Emikono emibi bulijjo gigezaako okumenya bbugwe waalwo n’okuluzikiriza nate lulyoke lubeere matongo, waleme kubaawo kkanisa ya mazima mu nsi. Naye Mukama alina obuggya olw’ettaka lye era tajja kukkiriza kulizikirizibwa. Ekkanisa teyandisigadde nga kkanisa kya bbanga ddene singa Katonda teyagikuuma ye yennyini.

Singa Katonda ayogera nti, “Kale kaakano nnaabalaga kye nnaakola olusuku lwange. Nnaggyawo olukomera lwalwo, lulyoke lulibwe; nnaamenya bbugwe waalwo, lulyoke lulinnyirirwe”? Nga lwandifuuse ddungu ttyo! Ayogera atya?

“Kale mugende mu kifo kyange ekyali mu Siiro, gye nnasooka okuteeka erinnya lyange, mulabe kye nnakikola olw’obubi bw’abantu bange Isirayiri.” Genda e Yerusaalemi, awaali edda ekibuga eky’ekitiibwa kye n’ekifo kye mw’atuula—kiki ekisigaddewo leero? Genda e Ruumi, Pawulo gye yabuulira edda enjiri n’amaanyi—kaakano kiki wabula okuba ekifo ekikulu eky’okusinza ebifaananyi? Mukama ayinza okuggyawo ettaala n’aleka ekifo ekyali ekimasamasa ng’emisana ne kifuuka ekizikiza ng’ekiro. Bwe kityo ennimiro ya Katonda esigala nnimiro kubanga abeeramu bulijjo, ng’agiziyiza okudda mu mbeera yaayo ey’edda ey’omu nsiko. Amaanyi ag’Ayinzabyonna gooba geetaagisa okukuuma ekkanisa nga kirimibwa, nga bwe gaali geetaagisa okukikomyawo mu kusooka.

Olw’okuba ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda ye yennyini, asuubira okufuna amakungula okuva mu kyo. Ensi ddungu, era talina ky’agisuubiramu; naye ffe tuli ttaka eririmibwa, kale amakungula gasuubirwa okuva mu ffe. Obugumba buyinza okusaanira olusenyi olutakwatiddwa, naye ku nnimiro bwandibadde nsonyi. Okwagala kunoonya okwagala okuddizibwa; ekisa ekyaweebwa kyetaagisa ebibala eby’ekisa. Nga tufukiriddwa n’amatondo g’entuuyo z’Omulokozi ez’omusaayi, tetuubale mirundi kikumi olw’okumutendereza? Nga tukuumibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda ataggwaawo, tewaabeewo bibala ebibalibwa mu ffe olw’ekitiibwa kye? Okutulabirira kwa Mukama kwatwala omuwendo omunene, okutegana, n’okulowooza okunene. Tewaabeewo kye kiddizibwa ekyenkanankana? Mukama teyandifunye amakungula ag’obuwulize, amakungula ag’obutukuvu, amakungula ag’omugaso, amakungula ag’okutenderezebwa?

Tekyandibadde bwe kityo?

Ndowooza nti amakanisa agamu geerabira nti okwala kusuubirwa okuva mu buli nnimiro ey’omu byalo bya Mukama, kubanga tebafunayo makungula wadde okuganoonya. Abalimi tebalima ttaka lyabwe wadde okusiga ennimiro zaabwe olw’okuzannya; balina ekigendererwa. Balima era basiga kubanga baagala amakungula. Singa amazima gano gayingira mu birowoozo by’abakkiriza abamu, mazima ddala bandirabye ebintu mu ngeri endala. Naye mu biseera bino kirabika ng’ffe tulowooza nti ekkanisa ya Katonda tesuubirwa kubala kintu era eriwo lwa kwewenyeza n’okuganyulwa kwayo yokka. Baganda bange ne bannyinaze, tekisaana kubeera bwe kityo. Omulimi omukulu ateekwa okufuna empeera ku mulimu gwe. Buli nnimiro eteekwa okuwaayo okwala kwayo, era ekyalo kyonna kiteekwa okuvaamu okumutendereza.

Twegatta ne omugole mu Oluyimba nga twogera nti, “Olusuku lwange, olwange ddala, luli mu maaso gange; ggwe, ai Sulemaani, oyinza okuba n’olukumi, n’abakuumi b’ebibala bafune ebikumi bibiri.”

Naye nzeeddayo we nnatandikira. Ennimiro eno, ku bw’okulonda, ku bw’okugula, ku bw’okuzingiza, ku bw’okulima, ne ku bw’okukuuma, ya Mukama mu bujjuvu. Kale laba nga bwe kyandibadde ekikyamu omukozi yenna okuyita ekitundu ky’ekyalo okuba ekikye.

Singa omusajja omugagga aba n’ennimiro ennene, yandirowoozezza ki singa omulimi agamba nti, “Nze nlima ennimiro eno, kale yange. Ennimiro eno nnaagiyita yange”? Oba singa omulala agamba nti, “Nze nnakungula ettaka liri omwaka oguwedde, kale lyange”? Singa abakozi abalala bonna bagabana ennimiro bokka ne bagituuma amannya gaabwe? Nnyini yo yandibagobyeko bonna mangu. Ennimiro ya nnyini yo, era esaanidde okuyitibwa erinnya lye. Tekirina makulu kugiyita mannya g’abakozi.

Abantu abatalina makulu bandibbye Katonda ekitiibwa kye? Jjukira Pawulo bwe yakyogera nti, “Kale Apolo kye ki? Pawulo ye ani? Baweereza abaabayisaamu okukkiriza, nga Mukama bwe yawa buli omu.” “Kristo ayawuliddwamu? Pawulo yakomererwa ku lwammwe? Oba mwabatizibwa mu linnya lya Pawulo?”

Ekkanisa kyonna kya oyo eyakironda mu bwakabaka bwe, n’akigula n’omusaayi gwe, n’akizimbako olukomera n’ekisa kye, n’akirima n’amagezi ge, n’akikuuma n’amaanyi ge. Waliwo ekkanisa emu yokka ku nsi, era abo abaagala Mukama basaanidde okukijjukira. Pawulo mukozi, Apolo mukozi, Keefa mukozi—naye ennimiro si ya Pawulo, wadde ekitundu kyayo ekitono. Tewali kitundu kya Apolo oba Keefa, kubanga “muli ba Kristo.”

Amazima nti mu nsonga eno abakozi ba nnimiro, so si nnimiro ya bakozi: “Kubanga ebintu byonna byammwe, oba Pawulo oba Apolo oba Keefa.” “Kubanga tetwebuulira ffe, wabula Yesu Kristo nga Mukama, ffe nga baweereza bammwe ku bwa Yesu.”

II. Kaakano tudda ku nsonga yaffe ey’okubiri: Omulimi omukulu akozesa abakozi. Ng’ayita mu bantu, Katonda bulijjo atuukiriza enteekateeka ze. Ayinza, singa ayagala, okukolera butereevu mu mitima gy’abantu ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we Omutukuvu, naye ogwo mulimu gwe so si gwaffe. Tuweebwa ebiragiro nga bino: “Kubanga, mu magezi ga Katonda, ensi bwe teyamanya Katonda ng’eyita mu magezi, Katonda kyeyava asiima okulokola abo abakkiriza ng’ayita mu busirusiru bw’ebyo bye tubuulira.” Ekiragiro kya Mukama si nti, “Tuula kyereere olabe Omwoyo wa Katonda ng’akyusa amawanga,” naye nti, “Mugende mu nsi yonna, mubuulire enjiri eri ebitonde byonna.”

Tunuulira engeri Katonda gy’agabiramu ensi emmere. Ng’addamu okusaba nti, “Otuwe leero emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku,” yandiragidde ebire okutonnyeza maanu buli nkya ku luggi lwa buli muntu. Naye amanyi nti kirungi ffe okukola, kale akozesa emikono gy’omulimi n’omusizi okutuwa bye twetaaga. Katonda yandirimye ennimiro ye gy’eyalonda, ye kkanisa, ng’ayita mu byamagero oba mu bamalayika, naye olw’ekisa ekingi agiwa omukisa ng’ayita mu batabani baayo ne bawala baayo. Atukozesa olw’obulungi bwaffe ffennyini, kubanga ffe abakola mu nnimiro ze tufuna omugaso omunene okusinga gwe tuwaayo. Okukola kunyweza ebinywa byaffe eby’omwoyo era kutukuuma nga tuli balamu mu mwoyo. “Gye ndi, newakubadde nze nsembayo obutono ku batukuvu bonna, ekisa kino kyampeebwa, okubuulira Abaamawanga obugagga bwa Kristo obutanoonyezeka.”

Mukama waffe omukulu ayagala buli mukozi ku nnimiro ye afune omugaso okuva mu yo, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, “Toziba mumwa gwa nte ng’ewuula eŋŋaano.” Emmere ya buli lunaku ey’omukozi eva mu ttaka. Newakubadde takolera ye yennyini wabula akolera Mukama we, akyafuna omugabo gwe ogw’emmere. Mu tterekero lya Mukama mulimu ensigo z’omusizi n’emmere ey’oyo alya. Ne bwe tuweereza Katonda awatali kwerowoolezaako mu kulabirira ekkanisa kye, ffennyini tugabana ku bibala. Kya kisa kinene nnyo eri Katonda okutukozesa n’akatono, kubanga tuli bikozesebwa bya bwerere, era emirundi mingi tuli kiziyiza okusinga okuyamba.

Abakozi Katonda b’akozesa bonna bakola emirimu egyetaagisa. Weetegereze: “Nze nnasimba, Apolo yafukirira.” Ani eyakuba engoma ennene oba eyafuuwa eŋŋombe ye ye? Tewali n’omu. Ku nnimiro ya Katonda, tewali akwatiddwa lwa kwewunda kwokka. Nsomye ebyokubuulira ebyalabika ng’ebyakolebwa lwa kwerabisa kwokka, kubanga temwali mpeke n’emu ey’enjiri. Byali ng’ebiwabyo ebitalina bugi, oba ebyuma eby’okusiga ebitalina ŋŋaano, oba ebikozesebwa ebikoleddwa mu maggi. Sikkiriza nti Katonda asasula empeera abantu abatambulira mu nnimiro ze balyoke beeyoleke bokka. Aboogezi abeeyoleka obumanyirivu bwabwe mu kkuŋŋaaniro basinga kufaananyizibwa ba butambuze abakima enkoko okusinga abakozi abeesigwa abavaamu amakungula eri Mukama waabwe.

Ab’ekkanisa bangi babeera ng’omulimu gwabwe gwokka ku nnimiro kwe kunoga enkenene oba okukuŋŋaanya ebimuli eby’omu nsiko. Bayanguwa okunenya engeri abalala gye balima ne gye basala omuddo, naye tebayimusa ngalo kukola bo bennyini. Mujje kaakano, mikwano gyange. Lwaki muyimirira awo obutakola olunaku lwonna? “Amakungula mangi, naye abakozi batono.” Abo abeerowooza okuba abalongoofu okusinga abalala, bwe muba nga muli Bakristaayo ba mazima, temusaanidde kutambula na malala nga munyooma abo abakola nnyo. Bwe mukola bwe mutyo, nnaabagamba nti mukyamizza mukama wammwe. Oboolyawo mulowooza nti muweereza oyo assaamu ekitiibwa endabika okusinga ebivaamu, naye Mukama waffe omukulu wa nkola, era ku byalo bye abakozi be bakola emirimu egyetaagisa.

Bwe tubuulira oba okuyigiriza, ffe naawe, tusaanidde okwebuuza nti, “Kino kigasa ki? Nnaatera okuyigiriza ensonga enzibu—mazima ddala kijja kuyamba omuntu yenna? Nnalonze ensonga ey’obuyivu obuzibu—ejja kukola mulimu gwa mugaso?” Omukozi ayinza okukola nnyo ku ndowooza ye ye ate n’atakolawo kigasa. Ebyokubuulira ebimu byoleka bwenkanya butono mu mpaka, era kino kigasa ki? Ka tugambe nti tusiga ennimiro obuwunga bw’embaawo oba tuzimansira akaloosa—ekyo kyandikoze ki? Katonda anaawa omukisa ebiwandiiko byaffe eby’empisa, enjogera ennungi, n’ebigambo ebirungiya? Tuteekwa okugendereza omugaso. Ng’abakozi awamu ne Katonda, tuteekwa okussaayo omwoyo ku mulimu ogugasa mazima. “Nze nnasimba,” omu bw’ayogera—era ekyo kirungi, kubanga okusimba kiteekwa okukolebwa. “Nze nnafukirira,” omulala bw’ayogera—era ekyo nakyo kirungi era kyetaagisa. Buli omu ku mmwe abeere n’ebyokubaako by’asobola okuwaayo, naye tewabaawo amatira olw’omulimu ogwokwerabisa gwokka, okwogera mu bantu, oba okutegeka ebyokusanyusa.

Ku nnimiro ya Mukama waliwo okugabana emirimu. Ne Pawulo teyagamba nti, “Nze nnasimba era ne nfukirira.”

Nedda—Pawulo yasimba. Ne Apolo teyagamba nti, “Nasimba era ne mfukirira.” Kyamumala okufukirira. Tewali n’omu alina ekirabo kyonna. Nga kya busirusiru bwe abantu bagamba nti, “Omubuulizi ono musanyusa kubanga azimba abakkiriza mu njigiriza, naye bwe yabulawo saagasibwa mubuulizi mulala kubanga yassa essira ku kukyusa aboonoonyi.” Weewaawo, yali asimba. Wamamze okusimbibwa; teweetaaga kusimbibwa nate. Osaanidde okwebaza nti abalala bafuna omugaso. “Kubanga wano olugero lutuufu, nti ‘Omu asiga n’omulala akungula.’” Mu kifo ky’okwemulugunya nti omulimi teyaleeta kambe, osaanidde okusaba nti afuna amaanyi okulima wansi ennyo n’okumenya emitima emikakanyavu.

Ku nnimiro ya Katonda waliwo obumu mu kigendererwa mu bakozi. “N’oyo asimba n’oyo afukirira bali bumu.” Mukama omu abakozesa. Newakubadde ng’abatuma mu biseera eby’enjawulo ne mu bitundu eby’enjawulo eby’ennimiro, bali bumu mu kigendererwa kimu—okukolera amakungula agamu.

Mu Bungereza tetutegeera bulungi kya kufukirira, kubanga abalimi eyo tebasobola kufukirira ttaka lyabwe lyonna.

Naye mu buvanjuba, abalimi bafukirira kumpi buli kitundu ky’ennimiro zaabwe. Awatali kufukirira tewandibaddewo kibala. Mu bifo nga Italiya, Misiri, oba Palesitaina, mulimu enzizi, ebyuma eby’okuwanika amazzi, ennamuziga, ebidomola, emikutu, obugga obutono, n’emiba egyetikka amazzi eri buli kimera. Awatali kino, ebbugumu eringi lyandikazizza buli kimu. Okusimba kwetaagisa amagezi; okufukirira nakwo kwetaagisa amagezi mangi bwe gatyo. Okuleeta ebbiri bino awamu, abakozi bateekwa okuba abamu mu ndowooza. Kya kabi abakozi bwe baba n’ebigendererwa ebyawukana ne bakolaganako. Kino kya kabi ennyo mu kkanisa. Nnyinza ntya okusimba obulungi singa omuyambi wange takyafukirira kye nsimbye? Oba kufukirira kugasa ki singa tewali kisimbiddwa? Okulima kufa abantu abasirusiru bwe bakikaayanira, kubanga okuva ku kusiga okutuuka ku kukungula gumu mulimu ogugendera awamu. Ka tukolere awamu ennaku zaffe zonna, kubanga okwawukana kuleeta obugumba.

Tubuulirwa mu bigambo byaffe nti abakozi bonna awamu si kintu. “Kale awo asimba si kintu, oba afukirira.” Abakozi si kintu awatali Mukama waabwe. Abakozi bonna ku nnimiro tebandisobodde kugifuga awatali omuntu abakulembera, era ababuulizi bonna n’abakozi Abakristaayo bonna mu nsi tebayinza kutuukiriza kintu okuggyako nga Katonda ali nabo.

Buli mukozi ku nnimiro ya Katonda yaweebwa obusobozi bwe okuva eri Katonda. Tewali amanyi engeri y’okusimba oba okufukirira emmeeme okuggyako nga Mukama amuyigiriza buli lunaku. Ebirabo bino ebitukuvu bikolwa bya kisa kya bwereere. Abakozi bonna bateekwa okukola nga Katonda bw’abalagira, oba nga bakolera bwereere. Awatali bulagirizi bwa Mwoyo, tebandimanyi ddi oba engeri gye bandikoledde, era awatali buyambi bwe tebayinza na kulowooza kirowoozo kirungi. Abakozi bonna bateekwa okufuna ensigo yaabwe okuva eri Katonda, oba banaasiga muddo mu kifo ky’eŋŋaano. Ensigo ennungi yonna eva mu tterekero lya Katonda. Bwe tubuulira, kiteekwa okuba Ekigambo kya Katonda ekya mazima, oba tewali kya lubeerera kinaavaamu.

N’amaanyi ag’okusiga gava eri Mukama. Tetuyinza kubuulira okuggyako nga Katonda ali naffe. Okubuulira kwogera kwereere okuggyako ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuwa obulamu. “Okuteekateeka omutima kwa muntu, naye okuddamu okw’olulimi kuva eri Mukama.” Ensigo ennungi bw’esigibwa, ebivaamu byonna byesigama ku Katonda. Bw’aziyiza omusulo n’enkuba, ensigo teekula. Bw’atagyakira, ebirimba ebibisi tebiyengera. Omutima gw’omuntu gunaasigala nga mugumba—ne bwe kiba nti Pawulo yennyini y’abuulira—okuggyako ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akolagana naye n’awa Ekigambo omukisa. Olw’okuba okukula kuva eri Katonda yekka, abakozi bakuume mu kifo kyabwe ekituufu. Temutulowoozaako nnyo, kubanga bwe tumala okukola byonna, tuli baweereza abatasaanira.

Kyokka, newakubadde ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti abakozi si kintu, era bigamba nti banaaweebwa empeera. Katonda akolera emirimu gyaffe emirungi mu ffe olwo n’atuwa empeera ku gwo. “Buli omu aliweebwa empeera ye ng’omulimu gwe bwe guli.” Empeera teesigama ku kuwangula, wabula ku kufuba. Abakozi bangi abaggwaamu amaanyi bayinza okufuna essanyu mu kino. Tosasulwa lwa bivaamu wabula lwa mulimu ogw’obwesigwa. Oyinza okuba n’ettaka ekkalubo ery’okulima oba ettaka eddibu ery’okusiga, nga waliwo amayinja, ebinyonyi, amaggwa, abatambuze, n’omusana ogwaka nga bikulwanyisa—naye ebyo si ggwe obivunaanyizibwa. Empeera yo eri ng’omulimu gwo bwe guli.

“Omu asiga n’omulala akungula,” naye oyo akungula tafuna mpeera yonna; oyo eyasiga anaagabana ku ssanyu. Abakozi bayinza okubalibwa nga si kintu, naye banaayingira mu ssanyu lya Mukama waabwe.

Awamu, ng’ebigambo bwe bigamba, abakozi bawanguddemu, era ekyo kitundu ku mpeera yaabwe.

“Nze nnasimba, Apolo yafukirira, naye Katonda ye yakuza.” Emirundi mingi mu kusaba twogera nti, “Pawulo ayinza okusimba, Apolo n’afukirira, naye byonna bya bwereere okuggyako nga Katonda awa okukula.” Ekyo kya mazima. Naye amazima amalala gatera okwerabirwa: Pawulo bw’asimba ne Apolo n’afukirira, Katonda mazima awa okukula. Tetukola bwereere. Tewandibadde kukula awatali Katonda, naye tetuli abatalina Katonda. Abakozi abeesigwa bwe bakola n’omwoyo omutuufu, Katonda abawa omukisa. Omukisa ogwo gwe kitundu ekinene ku mpeera.

III. Kaakano tudda ku nsonga enkulu: Katonda yennyini ye Mukozi omukulu. Ayinza okukozesa abakozi be yeeroboza bonna, naye okukula kuva gy’ali yekka. Omanyi nti kino kituufu mu kulima okwa bulijjo. Omulimi omukugu ennyo tasobola kufuula ŋŋaano kumera, kukula, na kwengera.

Tasobola na kukuuma nnimiro okutuusa amakungula, kubanga akabi kangi kagyokerera. Mu kiseera omulimi mw’asuubira amakungula, endwadde y’ebimera oba obulwadde biyinza okugazikiriza. Katonda ye ateekwa okuwa okukula. Bwe wabaawo eyeesigama ku Katonda, ye mulimi. Ng’ayita mu ye, ffenna twesigama ku Katonda buli mwaka olw’emmere yaffe. “Era ne kabaka yennyini aweerezebwa ennimiro.” Katonda awa okwala mu tterekero ne mu ntuumu y’omuddo, era kiri bwe kityo n’okusingawo mu nnimiro ey’omwoyo.

Bw’olowooza nti kyangu okuwangula emmeeme, kigezeeko. Awatali buyambi bwa Katonda, kyandibadde kimu n’okugezaako okutonda ensi. Tosobola kutonda nsowera—oyinza otya okutonda omutima omuggya n’omwoyo omulongoofu? Okuzaalibwa obuggya kya kyama kinene ekisukka amaanyi go. “Empewo ekunta gy’eyagala, era owulira eddoboozi lyayo, naye tomanyi gy’eva oba gy’eraga. Bwe kiri bwe kityo eri buli muntu azaalibwa mu Mwoyo.” Nze naawe kiki kye tuyinza okukola mu nsonga eno? Kitusukka. Tuyinza okulangirira amazima ga Katonda, naye okussa amazima ago mu mutima ne mu munda gwe muntu ye nsonga endala ddala.

Mbuulidde Yesu Kristo n’omutima gwange gwonna, kyokka mmanyi nti sirina we nnavudde bivaamu bya bulokozi mu muntu atazaalibbwa buggya okuggyako ng’Omwoyo wa Katonda ye yaggula omutima n’asimbamu ensigo ennamu ey’amazima. Obumanyirivu bwe butuyigiriza kino. Era mulimu gwa Mukama okukuuma ensigo ng’ennamu bw’emala okumera. Tulowooza nti tulina abakyuse, naye emirundi mingi tuggwaamu essuubi. Bangi bali ng’ebimuli ku miti gy’amasansa—birungi naye tebibala. Abalala bali ng’amasansa amatono agagwa nga tegannayengera.

Omuntu yenna akulembera ekkanisa ennene era afaayo nnyo ku mmeeme anaatera okukakasibwa nti okuggyako nga Katonda akola, tewali kituukirira—tewali kukyuka, tewali kutukuzibwa, tewali kugumiikiriza, tewali kitiibwa eri Katonda, tewali kumatiza kubonaabona kwa Mulokozi—okuggyako nga Mukama ali naffe. “Awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu.”

Okuva mu mazima gano, nsikamu amasomo mangi ag’omugaso. Ekisooka, obanga ennimiro yonna ey’ekkanisa ya Mukama omukulu era abakozi si kintu awatali ye, kino kisaanidde okuleeta obumu mu bonna b’akozesa. Bwe tuweereza Mukama omu, tuleme okuyomba.

Kya nnaku bwe tutasobola kusanyukira birungi ebikolebwa abo ab’amadiini amalala abakola mu ngeri endala okutuva ku ffe. Singa omukozi omuggya atuuka n’akozesa ebikozesebwa ebirala, nsaanidde okufuuka omulabe we?

Bw’akola omulimu gwe obulungi okusinga nze bwe nkola ogwange, nsaanidde okumukwatirwa obuggya?

Ojjukira nti ku mulundi ogumu abayigirizwa baalemwa okugoba dayimoni? Ekyo kyandibakkakkanyizza. Kyokka amangu ago, baalaba omuntu ng’agoba badayimoni mu linnya lya Kristo, ne bagezaako okumuziyiza kubanga teyali wa mu kibiina kyabwe. Baalemwa okugoba dayimoni bo bennyini, kyokka ne bagezaako okuziyiza omuntu eyali asobola. Ebibiina ebimu bikyusa emmeeme, naye olw’okuba tebakikola mu ngeri yaffe, tetukukkiriza. Bayinza okuba n’enkola ez’enjawulo, naye mazima baleeta emmeeme eri Kristo—era ekyo kye kisinga obukulu. Mu kifo ky’okunenya, ka tugumye buli omu ayimirira ne Kristo. “Kyokka amagezi gaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byago.” Abakozi basaanidde okumatira omulimi omuggya singa Mukama waabwe amusiima. Singa Mukama omukulu akukozesezza, si kifo kyange kubuuza ku kulonda kwe. Nnyinza okukuyamba? Nnyinza okukulaga engeri y’okwongera obulungi? Oba oyinza okunyamba nze okwongera obulungi? Bwe kityo abakozi bwe basaanidde okuyisagana.

Amazima gano era gasaanidde okufuula abakozi bonna okwesigama ennyo ku Katonda. Onaatera okubuulira, ggwe omuvubuka? “Yee, nzija kutuukiriza ebintu ebikulu.” Ojja? Weerabidde nti oli si kintu? “Kale awo asimba si kintu, oba afukirira.” Omuyigiriza ayinza okujja ng’ajjudde amazima g’enjiri okugumya abakkiriza, naye bw’atajja ng’eyeesiga Katonda mu bujjuvu, naye si kintu. Amaanyi ga Katonda. Omuntu mwereere n’ebigambo bye mpewo; amaanyi n’amagezi bya Katonda yekka. Bwe tusigala nga tuli beetoowaze, Mukama waffe anaatukozesa. Naye bwe twegulumiza, anaatuleka mu butaba kintu bwaffe. Amazima gano era gawa ekitiibwa eri buli omu akolera mu nnimiro ya Katonda. Omutima gwange gugulumizibwa n’essanyu olw’ebigambo bino: “Kubanga tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu.” Tuli bakozi abayimbulukuse ku nnimiro ye, kyokka tukolera wamu naye. Mukama akolera mazima wamu naffe?

Tukimanyi nti akola olw’ebivaamu ebigoberera. “Kitange akola n’okutuusa kaakano, era nange nkola.”

Ekyo kya mazima eri abaana ba Katonda bonna. Bw’omuweereza n’omutima gwo gwonna, Katonda ali naawe. Bw’oyogera n’ekibiina kyo ku Yesu, Katonda ayogerera mu ggwe. Bw’oyimiriza omugenyi n’omubuulira ku bulokozi obw’okukkiriza, Kristo ayogerera mu ggwe nga bwe yayogera n’omukazi ku luzzi.

Bw’obuulira ekisonyiwo ng’oyita mu musaayi ogutangirira mu bbanga eddungu, ye Katonda wa Peetero akaka ku Mwana we, nga bwe yakola ku lunaku lwa Pentekooti.

Eky’enkomerero, amazima gano gasaanidde okutufukamiza. Olw’okuba tuli si kintu awatali Katonda, ka tumukaabirire okutuyamba mu mulimu guno omutukuvu. Ka omusizi n’omukunguzi basabire wamu, oba tebasanyukirenga wamu. Bw’omukisa guziyizibwa, kiba kubanga tetugusabye era tetugusuubidde. Bakozi bannaffe, ka tujje ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa, era tunaalaba abakunguzi nga bakomawo n’ebinywa byabwe, newakubadde nga baagenda nga bakaaba nga basiga.

Eri Kitaffe, Omulimi, ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere, emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.
fields.body_text: Ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda, gy’alima n’omukono gwe mu bwegendereza. Tuyitiddwa okukola n’obwesigwa, nga tusiga era nga tufukirira Ekigambo kye, naye ye yekka y’awa okukula. Twewengeyo ddala mu mulimu gwe, nga tubala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kye. “Nze nnasimba, Apolo n’afukirira; naye Katonda ye yakuza. Kale awo asimba si kintu, newakubadde afukirira, wabula Katonda akuza. N’oyo asimba n’oyo afukirira bali bumu; era buli muntu aliweebwa empeera ye ng’omulimu gwe bwe guli. Kubanga tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu. Muli nnimiro ya Katonda.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:6–9 Nnaatandika ku nkomerero y’ebigambo byange, kubanga ndaba nga y’engeri ennyangu okulambika bye njagala okwogera. Okusooka tulaba nti ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda: “Muli nnimiro ya Katonda.” Ku mbiriizi z’enkyusa eya Revised Version tusoma nti, “Muli ttaka lya Katonda eririmibwa,” era ekyo kye kigambo kye njagala okukozesa. “Muli ttaka lya Katonda eririmibwa,” oba nnimiro. Bwe tumala okwogera ku nnimiro, tunaayogerako katono ku nsonga nti Mukama akozesa abakozi mu byalo bye. Era bwe tunaamala okutunuulira abakozi—abantu abanaku nga bwe bali—tunajjukira nti Katonda yennyini ye mukozi omukulu: “Tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu.” I. Tutandika nga tulowooza nti ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda. Mukama yafuula ekkanisa okuba eyiye ku bw’okulonda kwe okw’obwakabaka. Era yagifunira ye yennyini ng’agigula, ng’agisasulidde omuwendo omunene ennyo. “Kubanga omugabo gwa Mukama gwe gwe bantu be; Yakobo gwe gugabana obusika bwe.” Buli kibanja ku nnimiro ya Katonda kyawaayo Omulokozi entuuyo ez’omusaayi—weewaawo, omusaayi gw’omutima gwe. Yatwagala n’yeewaayo ku lwaffe; ogwo gwe muwendo gwe yasasula. Okuva kaakano, ekkanisa kya Katonda mu butuufu, era y’alina obwannannyini bwakyo. Kye kisanyusa okumanya nti tetuli baffe ffekka; twagulibwa n’omuwendo. Ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda ku bw’okulonda ne ku bw’okugula. Ne kaakano agifudde eyiye ng’agizingiza. Edda yali ng’ettaka etterekeddwa bulijjo, nga tekwatiddwa era nga likalu, nga libisiddwa amaggwa n’ebikoola eby’amaggwa, era ng’ennyumba ya buli nsolo ey’omu nsiko; kubanga twali “ku buzaaliranwa baana ba busungu, nga n’abalala bwe bali.” Okumanya kwa Katonda okw’edda kwatunuulira ettaka eryali lifuuse eddungu, n’okwagala okulonda ne kusalirawo omugabo gwalyo n’ekigera ekijjuvu eky’ekisa, nga kitwawulako okuba ebyalo bya Mukama emirembe gyonna. Mu kiseera ekituufu, ekisa eky’amaanyi kyajja n’obuyinza ne kitwawula ku bantu abalala, nga ennimiro bwe zeetooloozebwa olukomera ne zisimibwa emyala okuzaawula ku ttaka eritakwatiddwa. Mukama teyalangirira nti yalonda olusuku lwe n’aluzimbako olukomera? “Tuli lusuku olwetooloddwa bbugwe, Olulonde era olufuuse ettaka ery’enjawulo; Akafo akatono, akazingiziddwa ekisa Nga kaggiddwa mu ddungu ery’ensi eddene.” Mukama era yafuula ennimiro eno okuba eyiye mu bwannamaddala ng’agirima. Kiki ekirala kye yandikoledde ennimiro ye? Yakyusa ddala obuzaaliranwa bw’ettaka. Okuva ku kuba nga likalu, yalifuula okuba eddebeevu. Yalilima, n’alisima, n’aligaggawaza, n’alifukirira, era n’alisimbamu ebimuli n’ebibala ebya buli ngeri. Limaze okumuwa ebirimba bingi eby’essanyu, era ebiseera ebisingako obulungi bijja, abamalayika lwe balyogerera waggulu essanyu ku makungula, ne Kristo “n’alaba ekibala ky’okutegana kw’emmeeme ye n’akkuta.” Ennimiro eno ekuumibwa okukuuma kwa Mukama okutasalako. Si kwe kuba nga yagizingiza n’agirima n’amaanyi ge ag’ekyamagero okugifuula ennimiro ye yekka kyokka, wabula agikuuma bulijjo mu bwannannyini bwe. “Nze, Mukama, nze mukuumi waalwo; buli kaseera ndulukirira. Waleme kubaawo alukola akabi, ndukuuma emisana n’ekiro.” Singa si lwa maanyi ga Katonda agataggwaawo, enkomera zaalwo zandiyise okumenyeka amangu, n’ensolo ez’omu nsiko ne zirya ennimiro zaalwo. Emikono emibi bulijjo gigezaako okumenya bbugwe waalwo n’okuluzikiriza nate lulyoke lubeere matongo, waleme kubaawo kkanisa ya mazima mu nsi. Naye Mukama alina obuggya olw’ettaka lye era tajja kukkiriza kulizikirizibwa. Ekkanisa teyandisigadde nga kkanisa kya bbanga ddene singa Katonda teyagikuuma ye yennyini. Singa Katonda ayogera nti, “Kale kaakano nnaabalaga kye nnaakola olusuku lwange. Nnaggyawo olukomera lwalwo, lulyoke lulibwe; nnaamenya bbugwe waalwo, lulyoke lulinnyirirwe”? Nga lwandifuuse ddungu ttyo! Ayogera atya? “Kale mugende mu kifo kyange ekyali mu Siiro, gye nnasooka okuteeka erinnya lyange, mulabe kye nnakikola olw’obubi bw’abantu bange Isirayiri.” Genda e Yerusaalemi, awaali edda ekibuga eky’ekitiibwa kye n’ekifo kye mw’atuula—kiki ekisigaddewo leero? Genda e Ruumi, Pawulo gye yabuulira edda enjiri n’amaanyi—kaakano kiki wabula okuba ekifo ekikulu eky’okusinza ebifaananyi? Mukama ayinza okuggyawo ettaala n’aleka ekifo ekyali ekimasamasa ng’emisana ne kifuuka ekizikiza ng’ekiro. Bwe kityo ennimiro ya Katonda esigala nnimiro kubanga abeeramu bulijjo, ng’agiziyiza okudda mu mbeera yaayo ey’edda ey’omu nsiko. Amaanyi ag’Ayinzabyonna gooba geetaagisa okukuuma ekkanisa nga kirimibwa, nga bwe gaali geetaagisa okukikomyawo mu kusooka. Olw’okuba ekkanisa nnimiro ya Katonda ye yennyini, asuubira okufuna amakungula okuva mu kyo. Ensi ddungu, era talina ky’agisuubiramu; naye ffe tuli ttaka eririmibwa, kale amakungula gasuubirwa okuva mu ffe. Obugumba buyinza okusaanira olusenyi olutakwatiddwa, naye ku nnimiro bwandibadde nsonyi. Okwagala kunoonya okwagala okuddizibwa; ekisa ekyaweebwa kyetaagisa ebibala eby’ekisa. Nga tufukiriddwa n’amatondo g’entuuyo z’Omulokozi ez’omusaayi, tetuubale mirundi kikumi olw’okumutendereza? Nga tukuumibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda ataggwaawo, tewaabeewo bibala ebibalibwa mu ffe olw’ekitiibwa kye? Okutulabirira kwa Mukama kwatwala omuwendo omunene, okutegana, n’okulowooza okunene. Tewaabeewo kye kiddizibwa ekyenkanankana? Mukama teyandifunye amakungula ag’obuwulize, amakungula ag’obutukuvu, amakungula ag’omugaso, amakungula ag’okutenderezebwa? Tekyandibadde bwe kityo? Ndowooza nti amakanisa agamu geerabira nti okwala kusuubirwa okuva mu buli nnimiro ey’omu byalo bya Mukama, kubanga tebafunayo makungula wadde okuganoonya. Abalimi tebalima ttaka lyabwe wadde okusiga ennimiro zaabwe olw’okuzannya; balina ekigendererwa. Balima era basiga kubanga baagala amakungula. Singa amazima gano gayingira mu birowoozo by’abakkiriza abamu, mazima ddala bandirabye ebintu mu ngeri endala. Naye mu biseera bino kirabika ng’ffe tulowooza nti ekkanisa ya Katonda tesuubirwa kubala kintu era eriwo lwa kwewenyeza n’okuganyulwa kwayo yokka. Baganda bange ne bannyinaze, tekisaana kubeera bwe kityo. Omulimi omukulu ateekwa okufuna empeera ku mulimu gwe. Buli nnimiro eteekwa okuwaayo okwala kwayo, era ekyalo kyonna kiteekwa okuvaamu okumutendereza. Twegatta ne omugole mu Oluyimba nga twogera nti, “Olusuku lwange, olwange ddala, luli mu maaso gange; ggwe, ai Sulemaani, oyinza okuba n’olukumi, n’abakuumi b’ebibala bafune ebikumi bibiri.” Naye nzeeddayo we nnatandikira. Ennimiro eno, ku bw’okulonda, ku bw’okugula, ku bw’okuzingiza, ku bw’okulima, ne ku bw’okukuuma, ya Mukama mu bujjuvu. Kale laba nga bwe kyandibadde ekikyamu omukozi yenna okuyita ekitundu ky’ekyalo okuba ekikye. Singa omusajja omugagga aba n’ennimiro ennene, yandirowoozezza ki singa omulimi agamba nti, “Nze nlima ennimiro eno, kale yange. Ennimiro eno nnaagiyita yange”? Oba singa omulala agamba nti, “Nze nnakungula ettaka liri omwaka oguwedde, kale lyange”? Singa abakozi abalala bonna bagabana ennimiro bokka ne bagituuma amannya gaabwe? Nnyini yo yandibagobyeko bonna mangu. Ennimiro ya nnyini yo, era esaanidde okuyitibwa erinnya lye. Tekirina makulu kugiyita mannya g’abakozi. Abantu abatalina makulu bandibbye Katonda ekitiibwa kye? Jjukira Pawulo bwe yakyogera nti, “Kale Apolo kye ki? Pawulo ye ani? Baweereza abaabayisaamu okukkiriza, nga Mukama bwe yawa buli omu.” “Kristo ayawuliddwamu? Pawulo yakomererwa ku lwammwe? Oba mwabatizibwa mu linnya lya Pawulo?” Ekkanisa kyonna kya oyo eyakironda mu bwakabaka bwe, n’akigula n’omusaayi gwe, n’akizimbako olukomera n’ekisa kye, n’akirima n’amagezi ge, n’akikuuma n’amaanyi ge. Waliwo ekkanisa emu yokka ku nsi, era abo abaagala Mukama basaanidde okukijjukira. Pawulo mukozi, Apolo mukozi, Keefa mukozi—naye ennimiro si ya Pawulo, wadde ekitundu kyayo ekitono. Tewali kitundu kya Apolo oba Keefa, kubanga “muli ba Kristo.” Amazima nti mu nsonga eno abakozi ba nnimiro, so si nnimiro ya bakozi: “Kubanga ebintu byonna byammwe, oba Pawulo oba Apolo oba Keefa.” “Kubanga tetwebuulira ffe, wabula Yesu Kristo nga Mukama, ffe nga baweereza bammwe ku bwa Yesu.” II. Kaakano tudda ku nsonga yaffe ey’okubiri: Omulimi omukulu akozesa abakozi. Ng’ayita mu bantu, Katonda bulijjo atuukiriza enteekateeka ze. Ayinza, singa ayagala, okukolera butereevu mu mitima gy’abantu ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we Omutukuvu, naye ogwo mulimu gwe so si gwaffe. Tuweebwa ebiragiro nga bino: “Kubanga, mu magezi ga Katonda, ensi bwe teyamanya Katonda ng’eyita mu magezi, Katonda kyeyava asiima okulokola abo abakkiriza ng’ayita mu busirusiru bw’ebyo bye tubuulira.” Ekiragiro kya Mukama si nti, “Tuula kyereere olabe Omwoyo wa Katonda ng’akyusa amawanga,” naye nti, “Mugende mu nsi yonna, mubuulire enjiri eri ebitonde byonna.” Tunuulira engeri Katonda gy’agabiramu ensi emmere. Ng’addamu okusaba nti, “Otuwe leero emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku,” yandiragidde ebire okutonnyeza maanu buli nkya ku luggi lwa buli muntu. Naye amanyi nti kirungi ffe okukola, kale akozesa emikono gy’omulimi n’omusizi okutuwa bye twetaaga. Katonda yandirimye ennimiro ye gy’eyalonda, ye kkanisa, ng’ayita mu byamagero oba mu bamalayika, naye olw’ekisa ekingi agiwa omukisa ng’ayita mu batabani baayo ne bawala baayo. Atukozesa olw’obulungi bwaffe ffennyini, kubanga ffe abakola mu nnimiro ze tufuna omugaso omunene okusinga gwe tuwaayo. Okukola kunyweza ebinywa byaffe eby’omwoyo era kutukuuma nga tuli balamu mu mwoyo. “Gye ndi, newakubadde nze nsembayo obutono ku batukuvu bonna, ekisa kino kyampeebwa, okubuulira Abaamawanga obugagga bwa Kristo obutanoonyezeka.” Mukama waffe omukulu ayagala buli mukozi ku nnimiro ye afune omugaso okuva mu yo, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, “Toziba mumwa gwa nte ng’ewuula eŋŋaano.” Emmere ya buli lunaku ey’omukozi eva mu ttaka. Newakubadde takolera ye yennyini wabula akolera Mukama we, akyafuna omugabo gwe ogw’emmere. Mu tterekero lya Mukama mulimu ensigo z’omusizi n’emmere ey’oyo alya. Ne bwe tuweereza Katonda awatali kwerowoolezaako mu kulabirira ekkanisa kye, ffennyini tugabana ku bibala. Kya kisa kinene nnyo eri Katonda okutukozesa n’akatono, kubanga tuli bikozesebwa bya bwerere, era emirundi mingi tuli kiziyiza okusinga okuyamba. Abakozi Katonda b’akozesa bonna bakola emirimu egyetaagisa. Weetegereze: “Nze nnasimba, Apolo yafukirira.” Ani eyakuba engoma ennene oba eyafuuwa eŋŋombe ye ye? Tewali n’omu. Ku nnimiro ya Katonda, tewali akwatiddwa lwa kwewunda kwokka. Nsomye ebyokubuulira ebyalabika ng’ebyakolebwa lwa kwerabisa kwokka, kubanga temwali mpeke n’emu ey’enjiri. Byali ng’ebiwabyo ebitalina bugi, oba ebyuma eby’okusiga ebitalina ŋŋaano, oba ebikozesebwa ebikoleddwa mu maggi. Sikkiriza nti Katonda asasula empeera abantu abatambulira mu nnimiro ze balyoke beeyoleke bokka. Aboogezi abeeyoleka obumanyirivu bwabwe mu kkuŋŋaaniro basinga kufaananyizibwa ba butambuze abakima enkoko okusinga abakozi abeesigwa abavaamu amakungula eri Mukama waabwe. Ab’ekkanisa bangi babeera ng’omulimu gwabwe gwokka ku nnimiro kwe kunoga enkenene oba okukuŋŋaanya ebimuli eby’omu nsiko. Bayanguwa okunenya engeri abalala gye balima ne gye basala omuddo, naye tebayimusa ngalo kukola bo bennyini. Mujje kaakano, mikwano gyange. Lwaki muyimirira awo obutakola olunaku lwonna? “Amakungula mangi, naye abakozi batono.” Abo abeerowooza okuba abalongoofu okusinga abalala, bwe muba nga muli Bakristaayo ba mazima, temusaanidde kutambula na malala nga munyooma abo abakola nnyo. Bwe mukola bwe mutyo, nnaabagamba nti mukyamizza mukama wammwe. Oboolyawo mulowooza nti muweereza oyo assaamu ekitiibwa endabika okusinga ebivaamu, naye Mukama waffe omukulu wa nkola, era ku byalo bye abakozi be bakola emirimu egyetaagisa. Bwe tubuulira oba okuyigiriza, ffe naawe, tusaanidde okwebuuza nti, “Kino kigasa ki? Nnaatera okuyigiriza ensonga enzibu—mazima ddala kijja kuyamba omuntu yenna? Nnalonze ensonga ey’obuyivu obuzibu—ejja kukola mulimu gwa mugaso?” Omukozi ayinza okukola nnyo ku ndowooza ye ye ate n’atakolawo kigasa. Ebyokubuulira ebimu byoleka bwenkanya butono mu mpaka, era kino kigasa ki? Ka tugambe nti tusiga ennimiro obuwunga bw’embaawo oba tuzimansira akaloosa—ekyo kyandikoze ki? Katonda anaawa omukisa ebiwandiiko byaffe eby’empisa, enjogera ennungi, n’ebigambo ebirungiya? Tuteekwa okugendereza omugaso. Ng’abakozi awamu ne Katonda, tuteekwa okussaayo omwoyo ku mulimu ogugasa mazima. “Nze nnasimba,” omu bw’ayogera—era ekyo kirungi, kubanga okusimba kiteekwa okukolebwa. “Nze nnafukirira,” omulala bw’ayogera—era ekyo nakyo kirungi era kyetaagisa. Buli omu ku mmwe abeere n’ebyokubaako by’asobola okuwaayo, naye tewabaawo amatira olw’omulimu ogwokwerabisa gwokka, okwogera mu bantu, oba okutegeka ebyokusanyusa. Ku nnimiro ya Mukama waliwo okugabana emirimu. Ne Pawulo teyagamba nti, “Nze nnasimba era ne nfukirira.” Nedda—Pawulo yasimba. Ne Apolo teyagamba nti, “Nasimba era ne mfukirira.” Kyamumala okufukirira. Tewali n’omu alina ekirabo kyonna. Nga kya busirusiru bwe abantu bagamba nti, “Omubuulizi ono musanyusa kubanga azimba abakkiriza mu njigiriza, naye bwe yabulawo saagasibwa mubuulizi mulala kubanga yassa essira ku kukyusa aboonoonyi.” Weewaawo, yali asimba. Wamamze okusimbibwa; teweetaaga kusimbibwa nate. Osaanidde okwebaza nti abalala bafuna omugaso. “Kubanga wano olugero lutuufu, nti ‘Omu asiga n’omulala akungula.’” Mu kifo ky’okwemulugunya nti omulimi teyaleeta kambe, osaanidde okusaba nti afuna amaanyi okulima wansi ennyo n’okumenya emitima emikakanyavu. Ku nnimiro ya Katonda waliwo obumu mu kigendererwa mu bakozi. “N’oyo asimba n’oyo afukirira bali bumu.” Mukama omu abakozesa. Newakubadde ng’abatuma mu biseera eby’enjawulo ne mu bitundu eby’enjawulo eby’ennimiro, bali bumu mu kigendererwa kimu—okukolera amakungula agamu. Mu Bungereza tetutegeera bulungi kya kufukirira, kubanga abalimi eyo tebasobola kufukirira ttaka lyabwe lyonna. Naye mu buvanjuba, abalimi bafukirira kumpi buli kitundu ky’ennimiro zaabwe. Awatali kufukirira tewandibaddewo kibala. Mu bifo nga Italiya, Misiri, oba Palesitaina, mulimu enzizi, ebyuma eby’okuwanika amazzi, ennamuziga, ebidomola, emikutu, obugga obutono, n’emiba egyetikka amazzi eri buli kimera. Awatali kino, ebbugumu eringi lyandikazizza buli kimu. Okusimba kwetaagisa amagezi; okufukirira nakwo kwetaagisa amagezi mangi bwe gatyo. Okuleeta ebbiri bino awamu, abakozi bateekwa okuba abamu mu ndowooza. Kya kabi abakozi bwe baba n’ebigendererwa ebyawukana ne bakolaganako. Kino kya kabi ennyo mu kkanisa. Nnyinza ntya okusimba obulungi singa omuyambi wange takyafukirira kye nsimbye? Oba kufukirira kugasa ki singa tewali kisimbiddwa? Okulima kufa abantu abasirusiru bwe bakikaayanira, kubanga okuva ku kusiga okutuuka ku kukungula gumu mulimu ogugendera awamu. Ka tukolere awamu ennaku zaffe zonna, kubanga okwawukana kuleeta obugumba. Tubuulirwa mu bigambo byaffe nti abakozi bonna awamu si kintu. “Kale awo asimba si kintu, oba afukirira.” Abakozi si kintu awatali Mukama waabwe. Abakozi bonna ku nnimiro tebandisobodde kugifuga awatali omuntu abakulembera, era ababuulizi bonna n’abakozi Abakristaayo bonna mu nsi tebayinza kutuukiriza kintu okuggyako nga Katonda ali nabo. Buli mukozi ku nnimiro ya Katonda yaweebwa obusobozi bwe okuva eri Katonda. Tewali amanyi engeri y’okusimba oba okufukirira emmeeme okuggyako nga Mukama amuyigiriza buli lunaku. Ebirabo bino ebitukuvu bikolwa bya kisa kya bwereere. Abakozi bonna bateekwa okukola nga Katonda bw’abalagira, oba nga bakolera bwereere. Awatali bulagirizi bwa Mwoyo, tebandimanyi ddi oba engeri gye bandikoledde, era awatali buyambi bwe tebayinza na kulowooza kirowoozo kirungi. Abakozi bonna bateekwa okufuna ensigo yaabwe okuva eri Katonda, oba banaasiga muddo mu kifo ky’eŋŋaano. Ensigo ennungi yonna eva mu tterekero lya Katonda. Bwe tubuulira, kiteekwa okuba Ekigambo kya Katonda ekya mazima, oba tewali kya lubeerera kinaavaamu. N’amaanyi ag’okusiga gava eri Mukama. Tetuyinza kubuulira okuggyako nga Katonda ali naffe. Okubuulira kwogera kwereere okuggyako ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuwa obulamu. “Okuteekateeka omutima kwa muntu, naye okuddamu okw’olulimi kuva eri Mukama.” Ensigo ennungi bw’esigibwa, ebivaamu byonna byesigama ku Katonda. Bw’aziyiza omusulo n’enkuba, ensigo teekula. Bw’atagyakira, ebirimba ebibisi tebiyengera. Omutima gw’omuntu gunaasigala nga mugumba—ne bwe kiba nti Pawulo yennyini y’abuulira—okuggyako ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akolagana naye n’awa Ekigambo omukisa. Olw’okuba okukula kuva eri Katonda yekka, abakozi bakuume mu kifo kyabwe ekituufu. Temutulowoozaako nnyo, kubanga bwe tumala okukola byonna, tuli baweereza abatasaanira. Kyokka, newakubadde ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti abakozi si kintu, era bigamba nti banaaweebwa empeera. Katonda akolera emirimu gyaffe emirungi mu ffe olwo n’atuwa empeera ku gwo. “Buli omu aliweebwa empeera ye ng’omulimu gwe bwe guli.” Empeera teesigama ku kuwangula, wabula ku kufuba. Abakozi bangi abaggwaamu amaanyi bayinza okufuna essanyu mu kino. Tosasulwa lwa bivaamu wabula lwa mulimu ogw’obwesigwa. Oyinza okuba n’ettaka ekkalubo ery’okulima oba ettaka eddibu ery’okusiga, nga waliwo amayinja, ebinyonyi, amaggwa, abatambuze, n’omusana ogwaka nga bikulwanyisa—naye ebyo si ggwe obivunaanyizibwa. Empeera yo eri ng’omulimu gwo bwe guli. “Omu asiga n’omulala akungula,” naye oyo akungula tafuna mpeera yonna; oyo eyasiga anaagabana ku ssanyu. Abakozi bayinza okubalibwa nga si kintu, naye banaayingira mu ssanyu lya Mukama waabwe. Awamu, ng’ebigambo bwe bigamba, abakozi bawanguddemu, era ekyo kitundu ku mpeera yaabwe. “Nze nnasimba, Apolo yafukirira, naye Katonda ye yakuza.” Emirundi mingi mu kusaba twogera nti, “Pawulo ayinza okusimba, Apolo n’afukirira, naye byonna bya bwereere okuggyako nga Katonda awa okukula.” Ekyo kya mazima. Naye amazima amalala gatera okwerabirwa: Pawulo bw’asimba ne Apolo n’afukirira, Katonda mazima awa okukula. Tetukola bwereere. Tewandibadde kukula awatali Katonda, naye tetuli abatalina Katonda. Abakozi abeesigwa bwe bakola n’omwoyo omutuufu, Katonda abawa omukisa. Omukisa ogwo gwe kitundu ekinene ku mpeera. III. Kaakano tudda ku nsonga enkulu: Katonda yennyini ye Mukozi omukulu. Ayinza okukozesa abakozi be yeeroboza bonna, naye okukula kuva gy’ali yekka. Omanyi nti kino kituufu mu kulima okwa bulijjo. Omulimi omukugu ennyo tasobola kufuula ŋŋaano kumera, kukula, na kwengera. Tasobola na kukuuma nnimiro okutuusa amakungula, kubanga akabi kangi kagyokerera. Mu kiseera omulimi mw’asuubira amakungula, endwadde y’ebimera oba obulwadde biyinza okugazikiriza. Katonda ye ateekwa okuwa okukula. Bwe wabaawo eyeesigama ku Katonda, ye mulimi. Ng’ayita mu ye, ffenna twesigama ku Katonda buli mwaka olw’emmere yaffe. “Era ne kabaka yennyini aweerezebwa ennimiro.” Katonda awa okwala mu tterekero ne mu ntuumu y’omuddo, era kiri bwe kityo n’okusingawo mu nnimiro ey’omwoyo. Bw’olowooza nti kyangu okuwangula emmeeme, kigezeeko. Awatali buyambi bwa Katonda, kyandibadde kimu n’okugezaako okutonda ensi. Tosobola kutonda nsowera—oyinza otya okutonda omutima omuggya n’omwoyo omulongoofu? Okuzaalibwa obuggya kya kyama kinene ekisukka amaanyi go. “Empewo ekunta gy’eyagala, era owulira eddoboozi lyayo, naye tomanyi gy’eva oba gy’eraga. Bwe kiri bwe kityo eri buli muntu azaalibwa mu Mwoyo.” Nze naawe kiki kye tuyinza okukola mu nsonga eno? Kitusukka. Tuyinza okulangirira amazima ga Katonda, naye okussa amazima ago mu mutima ne mu munda gwe muntu ye nsonga endala ddala. Mbuulidde Yesu Kristo n’omutima gwange gwonna, kyokka mmanyi nti sirina we nnavudde bivaamu bya bulokozi mu muntu atazaalibbwa buggya okuggyako ng’Omwoyo wa Katonda ye yaggula omutima n’asimbamu ensigo ennamu ey’amazima. Obumanyirivu bwe butuyigiriza kino. Era mulimu gwa Mukama okukuuma ensigo ng’ennamu bw’emala okumera. Tulowooza nti tulina abakyuse, naye emirundi mingi tuggwaamu essuubi. Bangi bali ng’ebimuli ku miti gy’amasansa—birungi naye tebibala. Abalala bali ng’amasansa amatono agagwa nga tegannayengera. Omuntu yenna akulembera ekkanisa ennene era afaayo nnyo ku mmeeme anaatera okukakasibwa nti okuggyako nga Katonda akola, tewali kituukirira—tewali kukyuka, tewali kutukuzibwa, tewali kugumiikiriza, tewali kitiibwa eri Katonda, tewali kumatiza kubonaabona kwa Mulokozi—okuggyako nga Mukama ali naffe. “Awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu.” Okuva mu mazima gano, nsikamu amasomo mangi ag’omugaso. Ekisooka, obanga ennimiro yonna ey’ekkanisa ya Mukama omukulu era abakozi si kintu awatali ye, kino kisaanidde okuleeta obumu mu bonna b’akozesa. Bwe tuweereza Mukama omu, tuleme okuyomba. Kya nnaku bwe tutasobola kusanyukira birungi ebikolebwa abo ab’amadiini amalala abakola mu ngeri endala okutuva ku ffe. Singa omukozi omuggya atuuka n’akozesa ebikozesebwa ebirala, nsaanidde okufuuka omulabe we? Bw’akola omulimu gwe obulungi okusinga nze bwe nkola ogwange, nsaanidde okumukwatirwa obuggya? Ojjukira nti ku mulundi ogumu abayigirizwa baalemwa okugoba dayimoni? Ekyo kyandibakkakkanyizza. Kyokka amangu ago, baalaba omuntu ng’agoba badayimoni mu linnya lya Kristo, ne bagezaako okumuziyiza kubanga teyali wa mu kibiina kyabwe. Baalemwa okugoba dayimoni bo bennyini, kyokka ne bagezaako okuziyiza omuntu eyali asobola. Ebibiina ebimu bikyusa emmeeme, naye olw’okuba tebakikola mu ngeri yaffe, tetukukkiriza. Bayinza okuba n’enkola ez’enjawulo, naye mazima baleeta emmeeme eri Kristo—era ekyo kye kisinga obukulu. Mu kifo ky’okunenya, ka tugumye buli omu ayimirira ne Kristo. “Kyokka amagezi gaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’ebikolwa byago.” Abakozi basaanidde okumatira omulimi omuggya singa Mukama waabwe amusiima. Singa Mukama omukulu akukozesezza, si kifo kyange kubuuza ku kulonda kwe. Nnyinza okukuyamba? Nnyinza okukulaga engeri y’okwongera obulungi? Oba oyinza okunyamba nze okwongera obulungi? Bwe kityo abakozi bwe basaanidde okuyisagana. Amazima gano era gasaanidde okufuula abakozi bonna okwesigama ennyo ku Katonda. Onaatera okubuulira, ggwe omuvubuka? “Yee, nzija kutuukiriza ebintu ebikulu.” Ojja? Weerabidde nti oli si kintu? “Kale awo asimba si kintu, oba afukirira.” Omuyigiriza ayinza okujja ng’ajjudde amazima g’enjiri okugumya abakkiriza, naye bw’atajja ng’eyeesiga Katonda mu bujjuvu, naye si kintu. Amaanyi ga Katonda. Omuntu mwereere n’ebigambo bye mpewo; amaanyi n’amagezi bya Katonda yekka. Bwe tusigala nga tuli beetoowaze, Mukama waffe anaatukozesa. Naye bwe twegulumiza, anaatuleka mu butaba kintu bwaffe. Amazima gano era gawa ekitiibwa eri buli omu akolera mu nnimiro ya Katonda. Omutima gwange gugulumizibwa n’essanyu olw’ebigambo bino: “Kubanga tuli bakozi ba Katonda abakolera awamu.” Tuli bakozi abayimbulukuse ku nnimiro ye, kyokka tukolera wamu naye. Mukama akolera mazima wamu naffe? Tukimanyi nti akola olw’ebivaamu ebigoberera. “Kitange akola n’okutuusa kaakano, era nange nkola.” Ekyo kya mazima eri abaana ba Katonda bonna. Bw’omuweereza n’omutima gwo gwonna, Katonda ali naawe. Bw’oyogera n’ekibiina kyo ku Yesu, Katonda ayogerera mu ggwe. Bw’oyimiriza omugenyi n’omubuulira ku bulokozi obw’okukkiriza, Kristo ayogerera mu ggwe nga bwe yayogera n’omukazi ku luzzi. Bw’obuulira ekisonyiwo ng’oyita mu musaayi ogutangirira mu bbanga eddungu, ye Katonda wa Peetero akaka ku Mwana we, nga bwe yakola ku lunaku lwa Pentekooti. Eky’enkomerero, amazima gano gasaanidde okutufukamiza. Olw’okuba tuli si kintu awatali Katonda, ka tumukaabirire okutuyamba mu mulimu guno omutukuvu. Ka omusizi n’omukunguzi basabire wamu, oba tebasanyukirenga wamu. Bw’omukisa guziyizibwa, kiba kubanga tetugusabye era tetugusuubidde. Bakozi bannaffe, ka tujje ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa, era tunaalaba abakunguzi nga bakomawo n’ebinywa byabwe, newakubadde nga baagenda nga bakaaba nga basiga. Eri Kitaffe, Omulimi, ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere, emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.

fields.title: Abakozi ab'Omu Nnimiro Kye Basobola Okukola n'Ekyo Kye Batasobola Kukola
fields.body_html:
Ennyanjula Essuula eno eya Makko etulaga ekyama ky'obwakabaka bwa Katonda, ng'ensigo ekula okusukka okutegeera kw'omuntu. Ka twanukule omulimu gwaffe ng'abasizi, nga tusaasaanya Ekigambo n'obwesigwa, nga twesiga Katonda okukuza, era nga tusanyukira buli mwoyo gw'aleeta mu makungula.

“N'ayogera nti, ‘Obwakabaka bwa Katonda buli ng'omuntu asaasaanya ensigo mu ttaka. Yeebaka n'agolokoka ekiro n'emisana, ensigo n'emera n'ekula; ye tamanyi engeri gy'ekulamu. Ettaka lyokka lyereeta ebibala, olubereberye akati, oluvannyuma birimba, n'oluvannyuma empeke enkulukuse mu birimba. Naye empeke bw'eyengera, amangwago assaamu olukajjo, kubanga amakungula gatuuse.’” Makko 4:26–29. Wano waliwo essomo eri abo abakolera awamu ne Katonda. Lugero eri bonna abeenyigira mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda. Terijja kugasa nnyo abo abasigala mu bwakabaka obw'ekizikiza, kubanga tebaayitibwa kusiga nsigo nnungi. “Naye eri omubi Katonda agamba nti: ‘Olina buyinza ki okwatula amateeka gange oba okutwala endagaano yange ku mimwa gyo?’” Naye bonna abaweebwa obuvunaanyizibwa okusaasaanya ensigo ku lw'Omulimi wa Kabaka banaasanyuka okutegeera engeri amakungula gye gategekebwamu ku lw'oyo gwe baweereza. Kale muwulire, mmwe abasiga ku mabbali g'amazzi gonna; mmwe abanoonya n'obunyiikivu okujjuza amawanika g'eggulu—muwulire, era Omwoyo wa Katonda abayogeese nga bwe musobola okukikkiriza.

Okusooka tujja kuyigira mu bigambo byaffe kye tusobola okukola n'ekyo kye tutasobola kukola. “Obwakabaka bwa Katonda buli ng'omuntu asaasaanya ensigo mu ttaka.” Kino kye ky'omukozi ow'ekisa asobola okukola. “Yeebaka n'agolokoka ekiro n'emisana, ensigo n'emera n'ekula; ye tamanyi engeri gy'ekulamu.” Kino kye kye atasobola kukola. Ensigo bw'emala okusigibwa, teri muntu asobola kugifuga, era omuntu tasobola kugimeza wadde okugikuza. Naye nga tekinnawera omukozi addamu okulabika: “Naye empeke bw'eyengera, amangwago assaamu olukajjo.” Tusobola okukungula mu kiseera kyakyo, era kwe kuvunaanyizibwa kwaffe n'enkizo yaffe okukola bwe tutyo. Kale olaba nti waliwo ekifo eri omukozi ku ntandikwa; newankubadde nga teri kifo eri ye mu mulimu ogw'omu makkati, akyawaddwa omukisa omulala oluvannyuma ng'ekyo kye yasiga kimaze okubala ebibala.

Kale weetegereze nti tusobola okusiga. Buli muntu afunye okumanya ekisa kya Katonda mu mutima gwe asobola okuyigiriza abalala. Nkozesa ekigambo “omuntu” okugatta bonna abamanyi Mukama, oba musajja oba mukazi. Ffenna tetuyinza kuyigiriza mu ngeri y'emu, kubanga tetulina birabo bya ngeri emu; omu aweebwa talanta emu, omulala talanta kkumi. So n'emikisa tetugirina egy'enjawulo, kubanga omu abeera mu bwama, omulala nga alina obuyinza obutuuka wala. Naye mu maka ga Katonda temuli mukono muto ogutasobola kuteeka akasigo kaagwo mu ttaka. Teri muntu mu ffe eyeetaaga okuyimirira nga tayina kya kukola, kubanga omulimu ogutuukira ku maanyi ge gumulindiridde. Teri mukazi eyalokolebwa alekeddwa awo nga tayina mulimu mutukuvu; ka akikole afune ekigambo eky'okukkirizibwa nti, “Akoze ky'asobodde.”

Tetusaanidde kwemulugunya nti tetusobola kukola byonna nga Katonda atuganya okukola ekintu kino kimu; kubanga okusiga ensigo ennungi mulimu gwetaaga amagezi gaffe gonna, amaanyi, okwagala, n'obwegendereza. Okusiga ensigo entukuvu tusaanidde okukwanukula ng'okuyitibwa kwaffe okusinga obukulu, so si mulimu gunyoomebwa eri obulamu obusinga ekitiibwa. Ojja kwetaaga okuyigirizibwa okuva mu ggulu osobole okulonda n'obwegendereza eŋŋaano ennungi era ogikuume nga tegalimu muddo gwa buwabe. Ojja kwetaaga obuluŋŋamu okuggyamu ebirowoozo n'endowooza yo gwennyini, kubanga ebyo biyinza obutakwatagana na birowoozo bya Katonda. Abantu tebalokolebwa bigambo byaffe wabula Ekigambo kya Katonda. Twetaaga ekisa okutegeera Enjiri obulungi n'okuyigiriza yonna. Eri abantu ab'enjawulo tusaanidde n'amagezi okuleeta ekitundu kya Kigambo kya Katonda ekyogera obulungi eri omuntu gw'omutima gwe, kubanga ebingi biyinza okusinziira ku kigambo ekyogeddwa mu kiseera ekituufu.

Bwe tumala okulonda ensigo, tujja kuba n'omulimu mungi bwe tunaafuluma okugisiga buli wamu, kubanga buli lunaku luleeta omukisa era buli kukuŋŋaana kuleeta oluggi. “Mu makya siga ensigo yo, ne mu kawungeezi toziyiza mukono gwo.” “Balina omukisa mmwe abasiga ku mabbali g'amazzi gonna.” Abasizi ab'amagezi bategeera emikisa emirungi era ne bagifunirako n'essanyu.
