Ekibi bwe kiggalibwa ku luggi olw'omu maaso, kigezaako oluggi olw'emabega, kirinnya mu ddirisa, oba kikka mu kkuubo ly'omukka. Abo abatasobola kukiraba mu bo bennyini emirundi mingi baziba amaaso omukka gwakyo. Bali mu kibi ennyo ne batamanya nti enkuba etonnya. Mu bye ndabye, sinnaba kulaba muntu abasomesa ab'edda gwe bandiyise omutuukirivu ddala. Omuntu atuukiridde mu buli ngeri gwe nsuubira okulaba mu ggulu, so si mu nsi eno egudde. Ffenna twetaaga okunaazibwa n'okulongoosebwa egguuliro kwe lyakolerwa.

Okuwuula era kuggya empeke ennungi ku kikuta. Kya lwatu, singa empeke evanga mu kikuta mangu, kyandyetaagisa kukunkumula kwokka. Tewandibadde kyetaagisa muggo, luga, so tekulyogera ku bigere by'embalaasi oba enziga y'eggaali. Naye eno ye nkalubo: emyoyo gyaffe tegigalamira mu nfuufu bwokka—ginywerera ku yo. Waliwo omukwano ogw'entiisa wakati w'obuntu obwagwa n'ekibi ekiri mu nsi, era endagaano eno tekyusibwamu mangu. Mu mitima gyaffe, tukyawa buli kkubo ery'obulimba, kyokka n'ennaku tulyatula nti, “Kubanga ekirungi kye njagala sikikola, naye ekibi kye saagala kye nkola” (Abaruumi 7:19). Oluusi omwoyo gwaffe gwegomba Katonda n'obunyiikivu, okwagala okutukuvu kubaawo, kyokka tetumanya ngeri ya kukola birungi. Omubiri n'omusaayi birina obulungamu n'obunafu obutali kibi mu byo byennyini, naye obiwabya eri ekibi. Okwegomba kwetaaga akasa katono okukula ne kufuuka okwegomba okw'ekibi. Si kyangu kwerabira ekika kyaffe oba ennyumba ya kitaffe, ne Kabaka bw'ayagala obulungi bwaffe. Obuntu bwaffe obw'ekigwira bujjukira Misiri n'entamu ez'ennyama nga maanu akyali mu kamwa kaffe. Ffenna twazaalibwa mu nnyumba y'ekibi; abamu baalerwa ku kifuba ky'obutali butuukirivu, banne abaasooka nga ba baana b'obusungu. Ekyazaalibwa mu ggumba kizibu okukiggya mu mubiri.

Okuwuula kukozesebwa okuggya emikono gyaffe ku bintu eby'ensi n'okutwawula ku kibi. Kino kyetaaga omukono gwa Katonda, so tewali kirala okuggyako ekisa kya Katonda ekiyinza okufuula okuwuula okw'omugaso. Ekintu kikoleddwa omwoyo bwe guleka okunywerera ku kibi, ekibi bwe kireka okuleeta essanyu oba obumativu. Kyokka, ng'okuwuula bwe kutakoma okutuusa empeke lw'ejjula okwawulibwa ku kikuta, bwe kutyo okukangavvula n'okuyigiriza tekukoma okutuusa abantu ba Katonda lwe baleka buli ngeri ya kibi ne bakyawa obutali butuukirivu bwonna.

Bwe tumala okwawulibwa ddala ku subi ne bisusunku, omuggo guwummula. Kitwetaagisizza okuwuulibwa okungi okutuusa abamu ku kumpi n'ekifo ekyo, era ebikonde ebizito ebirala bingi biraba nga bituguddeko nga tetunnatuuka ku kwawulibwa okutuukiridde. Ebibi ebimu biggyibwawo mangu ekisa kya Katonda ku ntandikwa y'obulamu bwaffe obw'omwoyo, naye bwe biggwaako, oluwu olulala olw'ekibi lujja, era enkola eddamu. Okuggyibwawo okutuukiridde okw'okunywerera kwaffe ku kibi kwetaaga obukugu n'amaanyi ga Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka.

Okuwuula kyetaagisa olw'omugaso: eŋŋaano eteekwa okuwona ekikuta okusobola okuweereza. Tusobola okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa n'okuwa abalala omukisa nga tuli batukuvu, abatalina bulabe, abataliiko bbala, era abaawukanye ku boonoonyi.

Ai ggwe ŋŋaano ey'oku gguuliro lya Mukama, oteekwa okukubibwa n'okusekulwa oba ozikirire ng'ekitaliimu mugaso!

Omugaso omungi bulijjo gujja n'okubonaabona okungi. Awatali kwawulibwa ku kibi ng'okwo, tetuyinza kuyingizibwa mu tterekero. Eŋŋaano ya Katonda ennongoofu teteekwa kwonoonebwa bisusunku.

Tewali kintu kyonna kyonoona kiyinza kuyingira mu ggulu; noolwekyo, buli bbala liteekwa okuggyibwawo olw'omukisa ogutaggwaawo n'obutuukirivu. Ne kaakano, tetuyinza kubeera na bumu na Kitaffe okuggyako nga tununulibwa ku kibi buli lunaku.

Abamu ku ffe tuyinza okuba nga tugalamidde ku gguuliro leero, nga tubonerezebwa. Kale ki? Musanyuke, kubanga kino kiraga omuwendo gwaffe eri Katonda. Singa eŋŋaano yakaaba nti, ‘Ekiwaluzo ekinene kimpiseeko, noolwekyo omulimi tandaba,’ twandiddemu nti: omulimi awalula ŋŋaano ennungi yokka, so si omuddo. Olw'okuba assaamu eŋŋaano ekitiibwa, agikwatako n'obukambwe so tagirekera. Toteeberezanga nti Katonda akukyaawa olw'okubonaabona; naye laba nti akuwa ekitiibwa mu buli kikonde. Nga Mukama bw'agamba nti, “Mmwe mwekka be mmanyi ku nnyingiri zonna ez'ensi; kyennaava mbabonereza olw'obutali butuukirivu bwammwe bwonna” (Amosi 3:2). Olw'okuba Kristo yatangirira abantu be okujjuvu, Katonda tatubonereza nga omulamuzi; naye olw'okuba tuli baana be, atukangavvula nga kitaffe. Mu kwagala, alongoosa abaana be okubatuukiriza mu kifaananyi kye n'okubafuula abassa mu butukuvu bwe.

“Ndibabonereza n'oluga olw'endagaano” (Zabbuli 89:32). “Nkulongoosezza, naye si na ffeeza; nkulonze mu kyoto eky'okubonaabona” (Isaaya 48:10).

Tosalanga musango ng'osinziira ku ky'olaba oba ky'owulira, naye ng'osinziira ku kukkiriza. Nga okuwuula bwe kulaga omuwendo gw'eŋŋaano, bwe kutyo okubonaabona bwe kulaga essanyu lya Katonda eri abantu be. Nga okuwuula bwe kulaga obutali bulongoofu, bwe kutyo okubonaabona bwe kulaga obutatuukirira bw'Omukristaayo kaakano. Singa twali tetulina kibi, okukangavvula tekyandyetaagisizza.

Eddoboozi ly'omuggo teriwulirwa mu ggulu, kubanga eyo tewali kuwuula—wabaawo tterekero lya abo abaatukuzibwa okujjuvu. Ekyuma eky'okuwuula kabonero ka kwetoowaza, era ekiseera kyonna kye tukiwulira, tuteekwa okwetoowaza wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda, nga tumanyi nti tetunnaba kwawulibwa ku subi ne bisusunku eby'obuntu obugudde.

Ku luuyi olulala, ekyuma kino kiragula obutuukirivu bwaffe obw'omu maaso. Tuli mu kukangavvulwa okuva mu mukono gwa Katonda okutalirema: olw'amagezi ge n'obwegendereza bwe, tulyawulibwa ddala ku kikuta ky'ekibi. Tuwulira ebikonde by'omuggo, kyokka tuli mu kwawulibwa n'obwesigwa ku kibi ekyatwetoolodde ebbanga eddene, era olunaku olumu tulibeera abalongoofu era abatuukiridde. Buli lulungamu eri ekibi luliggyibwawo. “Obusirusiru busibiddwa mu mutima gw'omwana, naye oluga olw'okukangavvula lubugoba wala naye” (Engero 22:15). Bwe tuba, nga tukyali abatatuukirira, tuwangula n'abaana baffe olw'okubakangavvula kwaffe okutono era okukoma, kikira nnyo Kitaawe w'emyoyo bw'anaatutuusa okubeera mu ye olw'okukangavvula kwe okutukuvu! Singa eŋŋaano yategeera omugaso gw'omuggo, yandisanyukidde omulimu gw'omuwuuzi.

Olw'okuba tumanyi okubonaabona gye kutuusa, ka tukusanyukiremu era twewaayo n'essanyu eri enkola zaakwo. Twetaaga okuwuulwa; kukakasa omuwendo gwaffe mu maaso ga Katonda, era ne bwe kuraga obutatuukirira bwaffe, kukakasa okunaazibwa kwaffe okusembayo.

II. Ekyokubiri, okuwuula kwa Katonda kukolebwa n'amagezi mangi: “Kubanga obululu tebubuulwa na kyuma kya kuwuula.” Obululu obutono, ensigo entono ekozesebwa okuwoomya emigaati, tebusekulwa na kiwaluzo kizito, kubanga okukwatibwa okukambwe ng'okwo kwandibuzikirizza. “So n'enziga y'eggaali tekyusibwa ku kaminu”; ensigo eno entono, oboolyawo kaaraweeya, yandisekuddwa obuzito ng'obwo. Obululu buggyibwa ku bikoola nga “bukubibwa na muggo,” ne kaminu kyetaaga kukwatibwako luga lwokka. Ku nsigo ennafu, omulimi akozesa engeri enteefu; ku mpeke ez'amaanyi, akuumira enkola ez'obukambwe. Lowooza ku kuyigiriza okw'omwoyo okuli wano.

Lowooza, owooluganda, nti okuwuula kwo n'okwange kuli mu mikono gya Katonda. Okukangavvulwa kwaffe tekulekeddwa baddu, so si balabe: “Tukangavvulwa Mukama!” (Abaebbulaniya 12:6). Omulimi Omukulu yennyini y'alagira abakozi, kubanga tebamanyi kiseera so si ngeri okuggyako ng'amagezi bwe galagira. Bandikyusizza enziga ku kaminu oba ne bagezaako okuwuula eŋŋaano n'omuggo. Ndabye abaddu ba Katonda nga bagezaako obusirusiru buno bwombi: nga basekula abanafu era abagonvu, ne bakwatagana n'obukwafu n'abo abaali beetaaga okunenyezebwa okukambwe. Abaweereza abamu, abakadde, n'abasajja n'abakazi abatya Katonda bakambwe eri emyoyo egyekokkola; kyokka tetwetaaga kutya nti balizikiriza abalina emitima emyesigwa, kubanga Mukama akuuma abalonde be okuva mu bukambwe obwo obw'obusobyo. Nga kino bwe kigumya! Bangi leero bandisekedde omugonvu ne bamufuula olufufugge singa baali basobola.

Nga Mukama bw'atatuleka mu mukono gw'omuntu, bw'atyo tatuleka mu mukono gwa Setaani. Setaani ayinza okutuwewa ng'eŋŋaano, naye tayinza kutuwuula ng'obululu. Ayinza okufuumuula ebisusunku n'omukka gwe omubi, naye taddukanya ŋŋaano ya Mukama: “Mukama akuuma abatuukirivu” (Zabbuli 37:17). Tewali kikonde kya kuragira Katonda ekirekebwa mu kubeeramu buwoomerevu. Mukama y'alagira ekiseera, ekigero, n'ekifo. Ekiragiro kya Katonda tekireka kintu mu kubuusabuusa; okwagala okusinga byonna kufuga n'ebintu ebisinga obutono. Oba tugumira amannyo g'ekiwaluzo, okulinnyirirwa embalaasi, oba okukwatibwako okugonvu, byonna biteekebwawo amagezi agatalimba. Kino kizzeemu amaanyi abo abanakuwadde.

Weetegereze era nti ebikozesebwa mu kutuwuula bironderwa Omulimi Omukulu. Nga omulimi ow'ebuvanjuba bw'alina ebikozesebwa bingi, bw'atyo ne Katonda waffe bw'alina. Tewali ngeri ya kuwuula esanyusa; buli emu erabika ng'ekyenyinyalwa eri oyo agigumira. Twogera nti, “Nandigumidde kyonna okuggyako akabi kano,” oba “Singa kyali kya mulabe, nandikigumidde.” Oboolyawo kaminu asirira nti ebigere by'embalaasi byandibadde bigonvu okusinga oluga, oba obululu bwandyagadde enziga okusinga omuggo. Kya kwebaza, okulonda kulekeddwa oyo asalawo obulungi ddala. Kiki kye tuyinza okumanya? “Waa!” bw'akaaba maama, “Nandigumidde obwavu, naye okufiirwa omwana wange kunsukkiridde!” Omulala akuba ebiwoobe nti, “Nandifiiriddwa obugagga bwonna, naye okuwaayirizibwa kunsala omutima.” Tetusobola kwesanyusa mu kukangavvulwa. Bwe nnali ku ssomero wansi wa kojjaange, nnalina okumunoonyeza oluga; sirina lumu lwe nnasalawo olwasanyusa oyo eyali agenda okukubibwa.

Oba lwali luwewuka nnyo oba lugumu nnyo, ne ntiisibwatiisibwa okubonerezebwa singa nnalemererwa omulundi oguddako. Nayiga obutasuubira baana ba Katonda kwagala luga olubakangavvula. Oyinza okumwenyera olw'ekifaananyi kyange, kyokka oyinza okwesanga ng'okaaba nti, “Akabi konna okuggyako kano, Mukama.” Ebikemo bulijjo tebisanyusa; ddala buli ddagala erikola kabi ku ndabika, era buli kulongoosa okukola kaluma. Tewali kigezo kisanyusa mu kiseera kyennyini, kyokka kituufu, era kituufu newankubadde nga kikaawa.

Weetegereze era nti Katonda y'alonda ekifo. Abalimi ab'ebuvanjuba balina egguuliro amanene ag'eŋŋaano oba sayiri, naye okumpi n'ennyumba, ndabye empeta entono ez'ebbumba erikaluba oba ssamentti egguuliro empeke ez'omu nnimiro gy'ekubirwa n'obwegendereza. Abatukuvu abamu tebabonyaabonyezebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo naye bagumira ennaku mu mwoyo ogw'omunda ennyo; bawuulirwa ku gguuliro entono, ey'ekyama, kyokka ekivaamu si kitono. Nga kya busirusiru okujeemera ekiragiro kya Mukama, ng'abo abandyesalidde okubonaabona kwabwe! “Kisaana kibeere nga bwe ggwe bw'olowooza?” Empeke esaana erondere omuwuuzi waayo? Omwana asaana alonde oluga?

Ebintu bino bireke eri amagezi agasinga. Abamu beemulugunya ku kiseera: okulemala mu buto, okwavuwala mu bukadde, oba okufuuka nnamwandu ng'olina abaana abato. Kyokka mulimu amagezi. Nga omusawo bw'ateekateeka emiwendo gy'eddagala okusobola okukola, bwe kityo Mukama amanyi kiseera ki kye tusaana okunywa ekikompe ky'atuteekerateekera. Omutukuvu omwagalwa agumira ekigezo mu bukadde; wadde nga nnandimukuumye, Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu amanyi obulungi. Ekyuma, ekifo, ekigero, ekiseera, n'ekigendererwa biteekebwawo okwagala okutalimba.

Ekyawandiikibwa era kiraga ekkomo ery'okuwuula. Omulimi akuba okwawula empeke, naye si kugizikiriza. Enziga tesekula; ebigere by'embalaasi tebimenya. Aggya kaminu ku kikuta kyayo awatali kumusekula. Bw'atyo, Mukama apima okukangavvula kwonna. Guma omwoyo, munnange eyagezesebwa: olibonaabonyezebwa nga bw'oyetaaga, naye si nga bw'osaanira. Okubonaabona kujja nga bw'osobola okugumira. Eŋŋaano eyinza okuwulira enziga, naye obululu tebugumira kizito okusinga omuggo. Tewali mutukuvu akemebwa okusukka ekigero; buli kikonde kiteekebwako ekkomo amagezi ag'ekisa.

Kyangu okwogera kino mu kufumiitiriza okuteefu, naye kizibu wansi w'omuggo. Kyokka nkiraze mu bulumi n'okweraliikirira kw'omutima. Neebaza Katonda olw'okubonaabona kwange; sirina lwe nnabuusabuusa amagezi ge. Omulimi Omukulu amanyi engeri y'okutwawulamu ku kikuta, era enkola ye esaanira okutenderezebwa emirembe gyonna.

Kizzaamu amaanyi nti ekkomo lya Katonda terijjulukuka: “Singa ebigezo mukaaga biteekerwateekerwa abantu, Tebalibonaabona musanvu.

Singa Katonda alagira okubonaabona kkumi, Tekulibeera kkumi na kumu.”

Amateeka gaakkiriza embooko amakumi ana ng'oggyeeko emu; mu kukubibwa kwaffe kwonna, ‘oggyeeko emu’ kirabika. Katonda bw'ayaza ennaku, kiba lwa kubanga ebigero ebyakulembera byalema; tewali maanyi gasobola kutuwa kikonde kimu ekisukka ku muwendo ogwateekebwawo. Mukama tazannya na nneewulira z'abatukuvu be. “Tabonyaabonya na kwagala kwe” (Okukungubaga 3:33). Tewali kikonde kya bwereere ekiweebwa.

Amagezi g'omulimi mu kukoma okuwuula gasingibwa nnyo amagezi ga Katonda mu kuteeka ekkomo ku nnaku. Abamu bagumira katono, oboolyawo olw'obunafu. Ensigo ennafu teziteekwa kukubibwa; abatukuvu abalina emibiri eminafu tebalikwatibwako bukambwe. Oboolyawo ebirowoozo byabwe binafu, era ekyo abalala kye bagumira mangu kyandibasse; bakuumibwa ng'emmunye y'eriiso lya Katonda.

Bw'oba nga toli mu kubonaabona, tokusaba. Owooluganda yeeraliikiridde gyebuvuddeko olw'okuba teyalina buzibu; ne mmugamba nti, “Sanyuka nga bw'osobola.” Omwana omusirusiru yekka y'ayinza okusaba okukubibwa. Abatukuvu abamu abagonvu era abamasamasa balekebwa awo obutakwatibwako bukambwe; tebakwetaaga so tebandikigumidde. Lwaki okwegomba kwo?

Abalala bagumira okunyigirizibwa okuzito. Kyokka bwe baba nga ŋŋaano esingako obulungi, esuubirwa okukozesebwa okusingawo, baleme kukyejjusa. Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati eteekwa okuyita wansi w'ebigere by'embalaasi n'enziga y'eggaali; abasinga omugaso beetaaga okuyita mu nkola ez'obukambwe ennyo. Tewali ku ffe ayinza kugamba nti, “Nandyagadde okuba nga Martini Luuseri oba omukkulu nga ye?” Kyokka okuggyako akabi ak'ebweru, okubonaabona kwe okw'omunda kwali kunene nga tewali n'omu ayinza kukwegomba.

Yayolekera ebikemo bya Setaani n'okuggwaamu essuubi, ng'avuga ku mayengo g'olutalo, n'oluvannyuma n'agalamira ng'amenyese era ng'akankana.

Tulaba bazira ba lujjudde bokka, so si kubonaabona kwabwe okw'ekyama; eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa, era abo abagumya abalala emirundi mingi be babonaabona ennyo. Tokwatirwanga muntu buggya; tomanyi engeri gye baawuulirwamu okubatereeza.

Katonda akozesa amagezi mu kukangavvula; ka tukole bwe tutyo eri abalala. Beeranga ba kisa eri abaana; nenyanga ab'oluganda n'obukwafu. Tovuganga mbalaasi ku nsigo ennafu. Jjukira: kaminu akubibwa na muggo, so tasekulwa na nziga. Oboolyawo oluga luleke mu mikono egy'amagezi; siga oleke abakadde okuwuula.

Ka twesige amagezi ga Katonda. Tonoonyanga kudduka kubonaabona. Bw'osaba, gamba nti, “Wabula si nga bwe njagala nze.” Yawukananga n'ebisusunku byo n'essanyu. Okuwona omuggo, yawukana ku kikuta mangu: “Muveemu wakati mu bo” (2 Abakkolinso 6:17). Yawukana ku kibi ne ku boonoonyi; enkola eggwaawo mangu. Katonda atufuule ba magezi!

III. Ekyokusatu, okuwuula tekulirwawo mirembe gyonna. Tekulijjuza ennaku zaffe zonna: “Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa, naye taagiwuulenga bulijjo” (Isaaya 28:28). “Akaseera katono nakuleka, naye n'okusaasira okungi ndikukuuŋŋaanya” (Isaaya 54:7). “Talinenya bulijjo, so talikuuma busungu bwe emirembe gyonna” (Zabbuli 103:9). “Okukaaba kuyinza okusula ekiro, naye essanyu lijja mu makya” (Zabbuli 30:5). Musanyuke, bawala b'ennaku; mukubwe amaanyi, batabani b'obuyinike; mube n'essuubi mu Katonda, kubanga mulimutendereza. Enkuba tetonnya bulijjo, ebire tebidda bulijjo; ennaku n'okusinda biriddukanga. Okuwuula tekwetaagisa mwaka mulamba; emirundi mingi omuggo guwummula. Weebaze Mukama, ggwe emmeeme yange! Aliddayo okuleeta abaawaŋŋangusibwa eka.

Okusingira ddala, okubonaabona tekulirwawo mirembe gyonna. Amangu ago tulitwalibwa mu nsi esinga obulungi, gye watali gguuliro oba biwaluzo bya ŋŋaano. Oluusi mpulira eddoboozi ly'omubaka nga likoowoola nti: “Musituke mugende! Mwambale mutwale! Muveemu mu lusiisira ne mu lutalo, mudde nga muwangudde!” Ekiro kisembedde okuggwaako, naye enkya ejja. Obudde bwakya ku nsozi. Olunaku olutaggwaawo lujja. Mujje, mulye emmere yammwe n'essanyu, era mutambule n'omutima ogusanyufu; ensi ekulukuta amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki eri kumpi. Okutuusa obudde lwe bunaakya, mugumire okwagala kw'Omulimi Omukulu, era Mukama yeegulumize mu mmwe. Amiina.
fields.body_text: Amagezi ga Katonda mu by'okulima gatuyigiriza ebisingawo ku kulima kwokka—galaga engeri gy'akangavvulamu abantu be n'obwegendereza. Nga bwe ensigo ez'enjawulo zeetaaga engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okuwuula, bw'atyo bw'akangavvula buli mukkiriza ng'okwetaaga kwe bwe kuli. Ka twanguyize emitima gyaffe eri omukono gwe ogulongoosa, nga twesiga obulagirizi bwe obutuleeta eri obutukuvu n'okuba ab'omugaso emirembe gyonna. “Kubanga obululu tebubuulwa na kyuma kya kuwuula, so n'enziga y'eggaali tekyusibwa ku kaminu; naye obululu bukubibwa na muggo, ne kaminu na luga. Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa; kubanga taagigenderere kugiwuula bulijjo, so tagimenya na nziga ya ggaali lye, so tagisekula na baleeta be ab'embalaasi” (Isaaya 28:27–28). Obukugu bw'okulima Katonda ye yabuyigiriza omuntu. Awatali kuyigirizibwa kuno, yandifudde enjala nga akyabunoonya. Noolwekyo, Mukama bwe yamugoba mu nnimiro ya Adeni, yamuwa okuyigirizibwa okutonotono ku by'okulima. Nga nnabbi bw'ayogera nti, “Katonda we amuyigiriza okusalawo obulungi, era amuyigiriza” (Isaaya 28:26). Katonda yayigiriza omuntu okulima, okumenya amafunfugu, okusiga ebika by'empeke eby'enjawulo, n'okuwuula ebika by'ensigo eby'enjawulo. Omulimi ow'ebuvanjuba teyasobola kuwuula na byuma nga ffe bwe tukola leero, naye yali mukugu era ow'obwegendereza mu nkola ye. Oluusi ekyuma ekizito baakiwalulanga ku ŋŋaano okwawula empeke. Kino kye kitegeezebwa mu kigambo ekisooka nga bagamba ‘ekyuma eky'okuwuula,’ nga bwe kiri ne mu kifo ekigamba nti, “Nkufudde ekyuma eky'okuwuula ekyogi ekirina amannyo” (Yeremiya 51:20). Bwe baalema okukozesa ekiwaluzo ky'eŋŋaano, emirundi mingi baakyusanga enziga enzito ey'eggaali ery'omu byalo ku subi. Kino kye kyogerwako mu sentensi eddako nti: “So n'enziga y'eggaali tekyusibwa ku kaminu.” Baalina n'ebiwuulo ebiringa ebyaffe, era ku nsigo entonotono ennyo, ng'obululu ne kaminu, baakozesanga omuggo omwangu oba oluga oluwewuka: “Obululu bukubibwa na muggo, ne kaminu na luga.” Guno si gwe mulundi oba ekifo eky'okwogera ennyo ku kuwuula. Ebitabo ebituufu biwa amawulire gonna geetaagisa ku nsonga eno. Naye amakulu g'ekifaananyi kino ge gano: nga Katonda bwe yayigiriza abalimi okwawula ebika by'empeke eby'enjawulo mu kuwuula, bw'atyo, mu magezi ge agatakoma, bw'akwata n'abantu ab'engeri ez'enjawulo mu ngeri ey'obwegendereza. Tatugezesa ffenna mu ngeri y'emu, kubanga tuli ba njawulo. Tatuyisa fenna mu kubonaabona kw'okukwatibwa okwenkanankana; tetuwuulwa fenna na ntiisa ya kigero kimu. Tawa fenna kibonoobono kya maka oba kya mubiri; omu ayinza okuwona ng'akubiddwa oluga lwokka, ate omulala n'awulira, ng'ebigere by'embalaasi, mu kubonaabona okuzitowa. Omulamwa gwaffe gwe guno: okuwuula—ekisooka, ebika by'ensigo byonna bikwetaaga; ekyokubiri, kukolebwa n'amagezi; ekyokusatu, tekulirwawo mirembe gyonna, kubanga nga ekyawandiikibwa bwe kigamba nti, “Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa; kubanga taagiwuule bulijjo, so tagimenya na nziga ya ggaali lye, so tagisekula na baleeta be ab'embalaasi” (Isaaya 28:28). I. Ekisooka, ffenna twetaaga okuwuulwa. Abamu balina okwemanyisa okw'obusirusiru nti tebalina kibi, naye beerimba bokka, era amazima tegali mu bo. N'abasajja abasingayo obulungi bantu bwabantu. Nga bwe bali abantu, si batuukirivu, naye babeera mu bunafu. Ekigendererwa ky'okuwuula empeke kiki? Si kwe kwawula empeke ku subi ne bisusunku? N'abasajja abasingayo obulungi bakyalina ebisusunku ebimu. Si byonna ŋŋaano ku gguuliro. Si byonna ŋŋaano n'ebibundu ebya zaabu ebireetebwa mu tterekero n'essanyu. N'eŋŋaano yeegatta ku subi, eryali lyetaagisa emabega. Okwetooloola empeke, ekikuta kikyaginywezaako ne ku gguuliro. N'abasajja abatukuvu ennyo balina ekintu ekisukkiridde, ekyetaaga okuggyibwawo. Twonoona oba mu kulekwa oba mu kukola—oba mu mwoyo, mu nsonga, mu bunyiikivu, oba mu kusalawo. Bwe twewala ensobi emu, emirundi mingi tugwa mu ndala ey'okwawukana. Ebikolwa byaffe bwe biba nga bituufu nga tetunnabikola, tuyinza okusobya nga tubikola, oba ne twegulumiza oluvannyuma. Ekibi bwe kiggalibwa ku luggi olw'omu maaso, kigezaako oluggi olw'emabega, kirinnya mu ddirisa, oba kikka mu kkuubo ly'omukka. Abo abatasobola kukiraba mu bo bennyini emirundi mingi baziba amaaso omukka gwakyo. Bali mu kibi ennyo ne batamanya nti enkuba etonnya. Mu bye ndabye, sinnaba kulaba muntu abasomesa ab'edda gwe bandiyise omutuukirivu ddala. Omuntu atuukiridde mu buli ngeri gwe nsuubira okulaba mu ggulu, so si mu nsi eno egudde. Ffenna twetaaga okunaazibwa n'okulongoosebwa egguuliro kwe lyakolerwa. Okuwuula era kuggya empeke ennungi ku kikuta. Kya lwatu, singa empeke evanga mu kikuta mangu, kyandyetaagisa kukunkumula kwokka. Tewandibadde kyetaagisa muggo, luga, so tekulyogera ku bigere by'embalaasi oba enziga y'eggaali. Naye eno ye nkalubo: emyoyo gyaffe tegigalamira mu nfuufu bwokka—ginywerera ku yo. Waliwo omukwano ogw'entiisa wakati w'obuntu obwagwa n'ekibi ekiri mu nsi, era endagaano eno tekyusibwamu mangu. Mu mitima gyaffe, tukyawa buli kkubo ery'obulimba, kyokka n'ennaku tulyatula nti, “Kubanga ekirungi kye njagala sikikola, naye ekibi kye saagala kye nkola” (Abaruumi 7:19). Oluusi omwoyo gwaffe gwegomba Katonda n'obunyiikivu, okwagala okutukuvu kubaawo, kyokka tetumanya ngeri ya kukola birungi. Omubiri n'omusaayi birina obulungamu n'obunafu obutali kibi mu byo byennyini, naye obiwabya eri ekibi. Okwegomba kwetaaga akasa katono okukula ne kufuuka okwegomba okw'ekibi. Si kyangu kwerabira ekika kyaffe oba ennyumba ya kitaffe, ne Kabaka bw'ayagala obulungi bwaffe. Obuntu bwaffe obw'ekigwira bujjukira Misiri n'entamu ez'ennyama nga maanu akyali mu kamwa kaffe. Ffenna twazaalibwa mu nnyumba y'ekibi; abamu baalerwa ku kifuba ky'obutali butuukirivu, banne abaasooka nga ba baana b'obusungu. Ekyazaalibwa mu ggumba kizibu okukiggya mu mubiri. Okuwuula kukozesebwa okuggya emikono gyaffe ku bintu eby'ensi n'okutwawula ku kibi. Kino kyetaaga omukono gwa Katonda, so tewali kirala okuggyako ekisa kya Katonda ekiyinza okufuula okuwuula okw'omugaso. Ekintu kikoleddwa omwoyo bwe guleka okunywerera ku kibi, ekibi bwe kireka okuleeta essanyu oba obumativu. Kyokka, ng'okuwuula bwe kutakoma okutuusa empeke lw'ejjula okwawulibwa ku kikuta, bwe kutyo okukangavvula n'okuyigiriza tekukoma okutuusa abantu ba Katonda lwe baleka buli ngeri ya kibi ne bakyawa obutali butuukirivu bwonna. Bwe tumala okwawulibwa ddala ku subi ne bisusunku, omuggo guwummula. Kitwetaagisizza okuwuulibwa okungi okutuusa abamu ku kumpi n'ekifo ekyo, era ebikonde ebizito ebirala bingi biraba nga bituguddeko nga tetunnatuuka ku kwawulibwa okutuukiridde. Ebibi ebimu biggyibwawo mangu ekisa kya Katonda ku ntandikwa y'obulamu bwaffe obw'omwoyo, naye bwe biggwaako, oluwu olulala olw'ekibi lujja, era enkola eddamu. Okuggyibwawo okutuukiridde okw'okunywerera kwaffe ku kibi kwetaaga obukugu n'amaanyi ga Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka. Okuwuula kyetaagisa olw'omugaso: eŋŋaano eteekwa okuwona ekikuta okusobola okuweereza. Tusobola okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa n'okuwa abalala omukisa nga tuli batukuvu, abatalina bulabe, abataliiko bbala, era abaawukanye ku boonoonyi. Ai ggwe ŋŋaano ey'oku gguuliro lya Mukama, oteekwa okukubibwa n'okusekulwa oba ozikirire ng'ekitaliimu mugaso! Omugaso omungi bulijjo gujja n'okubonaabona okungi. Awatali kwawulibwa ku kibi ng'okwo, tetuyinza kuyingizibwa mu tterekero. Eŋŋaano ya Katonda ennongoofu teteekwa kwonoonebwa bisusunku. Tewali kintu kyonna kyonoona kiyinza kuyingira mu ggulu; noolwekyo, buli bbala liteekwa okuggyibwawo olw'omukisa ogutaggwaawo n'obutuukirivu. Ne kaakano, tetuyinza kubeera na bumu na Kitaffe okuggyako nga tununulibwa ku kibi buli lunaku. Abamu ku ffe tuyinza okuba nga tugalamidde ku gguuliro leero, nga tubonerezebwa. Kale ki? Musanyuke, kubanga kino kiraga omuwendo gwaffe eri Katonda. Singa eŋŋaano yakaaba nti, ‘Ekiwaluzo ekinene kimpiseeko, noolwekyo omulimi tandaba,’ twandiddemu nti: omulimi awalula ŋŋaano ennungi yokka, so si omuddo. Olw'okuba assaamu eŋŋaano ekitiibwa, agikwatako n'obukambwe so tagirekera. Toteeberezanga nti Katonda akukyaawa olw'okubonaabona; naye laba nti akuwa ekitiibwa mu buli kikonde. Nga Mukama bw'agamba nti, “Mmwe mwekka be mmanyi ku nnyingiri zonna ez'ensi; kyennaava mbabonereza olw'obutali butuukirivu bwammwe bwonna” (Amosi 3:2). Olw'okuba Kristo yatangirira abantu be okujjuvu, Katonda tatubonereza nga omulamuzi; naye olw'okuba tuli baana be, atukangavvula nga kitaffe. Mu kwagala, alongoosa abaana be okubatuukiriza mu kifaananyi kye n'okubafuula abassa mu butukuvu bwe. “Ndibabonereza n'oluga olw'endagaano” (Zabbuli 89:32). “Nkulongoosezza, naye si na ffeeza; nkulonze mu kyoto eky'okubonaabona” (Isaaya 48:10). Tosalanga musango ng'osinziira ku ky'olaba oba ky'owulira, naye ng'osinziira ku kukkiriza. Nga okuwuula bwe kulaga omuwendo gw'eŋŋaano, bwe kutyo okubonaabona bwe kulaga essanyu lya Katonda eri abantu be. Nga okuwuula bwe kulaga obutali bulongoofu, bwe kutyo okubonaabona bwe kulaga obutatuukirira bw'Omukristaayo kaakano. Singa twali tetulina kibi, okukangavvula tekyandyetaagisizza. Eddoboozi ly'omuggo teriwulirwa mu ggulu, kubanga eyo tewali kuwuula—wabaawo tterekero lya abo abaatukuzibwa okujjuvu. Ekyuma eky'okuwuula kabonero ka kwetoowaza, era ekiseera kyonna kye tukiwulira, tuteekwa okwetoowaza wansi w'omukono gwa Katonda, nga tumanyi nti tetunnaba kwawulibwa ku subi ne bisusunku eby'obuntu obugudde. Ku luuyi olulala, ekyuma kino kiragula obutuukirivu bwaffe obw'omu maaso. Tuli mu kukangavvulwa okuva mu mukono gwa Katonda okutalirema: olw'amagezi ge n'obwegendereza bwe, tulyawulibwa ddala ku kikuta ky'ekibi. Tuwulira ebikonde by'omuggo, kyokka tuli mu kwawulibwa n'obwesigwa ku kibi ekyatwetoolodde ebbanga eddene, era olunaku olumu tulibeera abalongoofu era abatuukiridde. Buli lulungamu eri ekibi luliggyibwawo. “Obusirusiru busibiddwa mu mutima gw'omwana, naye oluga olw'okukangavvula lubugoba wala naye” (Engero 22:15). Bwe tuba, nga tukyali abatatuukirira, tuwangula n'abaana baffe olw'okubakangavvula kwaffe okutono era okukoma, kikira nnyo Kitaawe w'emyoyo bw'anaatutuusa okubeera mu ye olw'okukangavvula kwe okutukuvu! Singa eŋŋaano yategeera omugaso gw'omuggo, yandisanyukidde omulimu gw'omuwuuzi. Olw'okuba tumanyi okubonaabona gye kutuusa, ka tukusanyukiremu era twewaayo n'essanyu eri enkola zaakwo. Twetaaga okuwuulwa; kukakasa omuwendo gwaffe mu maaso ga Katonda, era ne bwe kuraga obutatuukirira bwaffe, kukakasa okunaazibwa kwaffe okusembayo. II. Ekyokubiri, okuwuula kwa Katonda kukolebwa n'amagezi mangi: “Kubanga obululu tebubuulwa na kyuma kya kuwuula.” Obululu obutono, ensigo entono ekozesebwa okuwoomya emigaati, tebusekulwa na kiwaluzo kizito, kubanga okukwatibwa okukambwe ng'okwo kwandibuzikirizza. “So n'enziga y'eggaali tekyusibwa ku kaminu”; ensigo eno entono, oboolyawo kaaraweeya, yandisekuddwa obuzito ng'obwo. Obululu buggyibwa ku bikoola nga “bukubibwa na muggo,” ne kaminu kyetaaga kukwatibwako luga lwokka. Ku nsigo ennafu, omulimi akozesa engeri enteefu; ku mpeke ez'amaanyi, akuumira enkola ez'obukambwe. Lowooza ku kuyigiriza okw'omwoyo okuli wano. Lowooza, owooluganda, nti okuwuula kwo n'okwange kuli mu mikono gya Katonda. Okukangavvulwa kwaffe tekulekeddwa baddu, so si balabe: “Tukangavvulwa Mukama!” (Abaebbulaniya 12:6). Omulimi Omukulu yennyini y'alagira abakozi, kubanga tebamanyi kiseera so si ngeri okuggyako ng'amagezi bwe galagira. Bandikyusizza enziga ku kaminu oba ne bagezaako okuwuula eŋŋaano n'omuggo. Ndabye abaddu ba Katonda nga bagezaako obusirusiru buno bwombi: nga basekula abanafu era abagonvu, ne bakwatagana n'obukwafu n'abo abaali beetaaga okunenyezebwa okukambwe. Abaweereza abamu, abakadde, n'abasajja n'abakazi abatya Katonda bakambwe eri emyoyo egyekokkola; kyokka tetwetaaga kutya nti balizikiriza abalina emitima emyesigwa, kubanga Mukama akuuma abalonde be okuva mu bukambwe obwo obw'obusobyo. Nga kino bwe kigumya! Bangi leero bandisekedde omugonvu ne bamufuula olufufugge singa baali basobola. Nga Mukama bw'atatuleka mu mukono gw'omuntu, bw'atyo tatuleka mu mukono gwa Setaani. Setaani ayinza okutuwewa ng'eŋŋaano, naye tayinza kutuwuula ng'obululu. Ayinza okufuumuula ebisusunku n'omukka gwe omubi, naye taddukanya ŋŋaano ya Mukama: “Mukama akuuma abatuukirivu” (Zabbuli 37:17). Tewali kikonde kya kuragira Katonda ekirekebwa mu kubeeramu buwoomerevu. Mukama y'alagira ekiseera, ekigero, n'ekifo. Ekiragiro kya Katonda tekireka kintu mu kubuusabuusa; okwagala okusinga byonna kufuga n'ebintu ebisinga obutono. Oba tugumira amannyo g'ekiwaluzo, okulinnyirirwa embalaasi, oba okukwatibwako okugonvu, byonna biteekebwawo amagezi agatalimba. Kino kizzeemu amaanyi abo abanakuwadde. Weetegereze era nti ebikozesebwa mu kutuwuula bironderwa Omulimi Omukulu. Nga omulimi ow'ebuvanjuba bw'alina ebikozesebwa bingi, bw'atyo ne Katonda waffe bw'alina. Tewali ngeri ya kuwuula esanyusa; buli emu erabika ng'ekyenyinyalwa eri oyo agigumira. Twogera nti, “Nandigumidde kyonna okuggyako akabi kano,” oba “Singa kyali kya mulabe, nandikigumidde.” Oboolyawo kaminu asirira nti ebigere by'embalaasi byandibadde bigonvu okusinga oluga, oba obululu bwandyagadde enziga okusinga omuggo. Kya kwebaza, okulonda kulekeddwa oyo asalawo obulungi ddala. Kiki kye tuyinza okumanya? “Waa!” bw'akaaba maama, “Nandigumidde obwavu, naye okufiirwa omwana wange kunsukkiridde!” Omulala akuba ebiwoobe nti, “Nandifiiriddwa obugagga bwonna, naye okuwaayirizibwa kunsala omutima.” Tetusobola kwesanyusa mu kukangavvulwa. Bwe nnali ku ssomero wansi wa kojjaange, nnalina okumunoonyeza oluga; sirina lumu lwe nnasalawo olwasanyusa oyo eyali agenda okukubibwa. Oba lwali luwewuka nnyo oba lugumu nnyo, ne ntiisibwatiisibwa okubonerezebwa singa nnalemererwa omulundi oguddako. Nayiga obutasuubira baana ba Katonda kwagala luga olubakangavvula. Oyinza okumwenyera olw'ekifaananyi kyange, kyokka oyinza okwesanga ng'okaaba nti, “Akabi konna okuggyako kano, Mukama.” Ebikemo bulijjo tebisanyusa; ddala buli ddagala erikola kabi ku ndabika, era buli kulongoosa okukola kaluma. Tewali kigezo kisanyusa mu kiseera kyennyini, kyokka kituufu, era kituufu newankubadde nga kikaawa. Weetegereze era nti Katonda y'alonda ekifo. Abalimi ab'ebuvanjuba balina egguuliro amanene ag'eŋŋaano oba sayiri, naye okumpi n'ennyumba, ndabye empeta entono ez'ebbumba erikaluba oba ssamentti egguuliro empeke ez'omu nnimiro gy'ekubirwa n'obwegendereza. Abatukuvu abamu tebabonyaabonyezebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo naye bagumira ennaku mu mwoyo ogw'omunda ennyo; bawuulirwa ku gguuliro entono, ey'ekyama, kyokka ekivaamu si kitono. Nga kya busirusiru okujeemera ekiragiro kya Mukama, ng'abo abandyesalidde okubonaabona kwabwe! “Kisaana kibeere nga bwe ggwe bw'olowooza?” Empeke esaana erondere omuwuuzi waayo? Omwana asaana alonde oluga? Ebintu bino bireke eri amagezi agasinga. Abamu beemulugunya ku kiseera: okulemala mu buto, okwavuwala mu bukadde, oba okufuuka nnamwandu ng'olina abaana abato. Kyokka mulimu amagezi. Nga omusawo bw'ateekateeka emiwendo gy'eddagala okusobola okukola, bwe kityo Mukama amanyi kiseera ki kye tusaana okunywa ekikompe ky'atuteekerateekera. Omutukuvu omwagalwa agumira ekigezo mu bukadde; wadde nga nnandimukuumye, Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu amanyi obulungi. Ekyuma, ekifo, ekigero, ekiseera, n'ekigendererwa biteekebwawo okwagala okutalimba. Ekyawandiikibwa era kiraga ekkomo ery'okuwuula. Omulimi akuba okwawula empeke, naye si kugizikiriza. Enziga tesekula; ebigere by'embalaasi tebimenya. Aggya kaminu ku kikuta kyayo awatali kumusekula. Bw'atyo, Mukama apima okukangavvula kwonna. Guma omwoyo, munnange eyagezesebwa: olibonaabonyezebwa nga bw'oyetaaga, naye si nga bw'osaanira. Okubonaabona kujja nga bw'osobola okugumira. Eŋŋaano eyinza okuwulira enziga, naye obululu tebugumira kizito okusinga omuggo. Tewali mutukuvu akemebwa okusukka ekigero; buli kikonde kiteekebwako ekkomo amagezi ag'ekisa. Kyangu okwogera kino mu kufumiitiriza okuteefu, naye kizibu wansi w'omuggo. Kyokka nkiraze mu bulumi n'okweraliikirira kw'omutima. Neebaza Katonda olw'okubonaabona kwange; sirina lwe nnabuusabuusa amagezi ge. Omulimi Omukulu amanyi engeri y'okutwawulamu ku kikuta, era enkola ye esaanira okutenderezebwa emirembe gyonna. Kizzaamu amaanyi nti ekkomo lya Katonda terijjulukuka: “Singa ebigezo mukaaga biteekerwateekerwa abantu, Tebalibonaabona musanvu. Singa Katonda alagira okubonaabona kkumi, Tekulibeera kkumi na kumu.” Amateeka gaakkiriza embooko amakumi ana ng'oggyeeko emu; mu kukubibwa kwaffe kwonna, ‘oggyeeko emu’ kirabika. Katonda bw'ayaza ennaku, kiba lwa kubanga ebigero ebyakulembera byalema; tewali maanyi gasobola kutuwa kikonde kimu ekisukka ku muwendo ogwateekebwawo. Mukama tazannya na nneewulira z'abatukuvu be. “Tabonyaabonya na kwagala kwe” (Okukungubaga 3:33). Tewali kikonde kya bwereere ekiweebwa. Amagezi g'omulimi mu kukoma okuwuula gasingibwa nnyo amagezi ga Katonda mu kuteeka ekkomo ku nnaku. Abamu bagumira katono, oboolyawo olw'obunafu. Ensigo ennafu teziteekwa kukubibwa; abatukuvu abalina emibiri eminafu tebalikwatibwako bukambwe. Oboolyawo ebirowoozo byabwe binafu, era ekyo abalala kye bagumira mangu kyandibasse; bakuumibwa ng'emmunye y'eriiso lya Katonda. Bw'oba nga toli mu kubonaabona, tokusaba. Owooluganda yeeraliikiridde gyebuvuddeko olw'okuba teyalina buzibu; ne mmugamba nti, “Sanyuka nga bw'osobola.” Omwana omusirusiru yekka y'ayinza okusaba okukubibwa. Abatukuvu abamu abagonvu era abamasamasa balekebwa awo obutakwatibwako bukambwe; tebakwetaaga so tebandikigumidde. Lwaki okwegomba kwo? Abalala bagumira okunyigirizibwa okuzito. Kyokka bwe baba nga ŋŋaano esingako obulungi, esuubirwa okukozesebwa okusingawo, baleme kukyejjusa. Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati eteekwa okuyita wansi w'ebigere by'embalaasi n'enziga y'eggaali; abasinga omugaso beetaaga okuyita mu nkola ez'obukambwe ennyo. Tewali ku ffe ayinza kugamba nti, “Nandyagadde okuba nga Martini Luuseri oba omukkulu nga ye?” Kyokka okuggyako akabi ak'ebweru, okubonaabona kwe okw'omunda kwali kunene nga tewali n'omu ayinza kukwegomba. Yayolekera ebikemo bya Setaani n'okuggwaamu essuubi, ng'avuga ku mayengo g'olutalo, n'oluvannyuma n'agalamira ng'amenyese era ng'akankana. Tulaba bazira ba lujjudde bokka, so si kubonaabona kwabwe okw'ekyama; eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa, era abo abagumya abalala emirundi mingi be babonaabona ennyo. Tokwatirwanga muntu buggya; tomanyi engeri gye baawuulirwamu okubatereeza. Katonda akozesa amagezi mu kukangavvula; ka tukole bwe tutyo eri abalala. Beeranga ba kisa eri abaana; nenyanga ab'oluganda n'obukwafu. Tovuganga mbalaasi ku nsigo ennafu. Jjukira: kaminu akubibwa na muggo, so tasekulwa na nziga. Oboolyawo oluga luleke mu mikono egy'amagezi; siga oleke abakadde okuwuula. Ka twesige amagezi ga Katonda. Tonoonyanga kudduka kubonaabona. Bw'osaba, gamba nti, “Wabula si nga bwe njagala nze.” Yawukananga n'ebisusunku byo n'essanyu. Okuwona omuggo, yawukana ku kikuta mangu: “Muveemu wakati mu bo” (2 Abakkolinso 6:17). Yawukana ku kibi ne ku boonoonyi; enkola eggwaawo mangu. Katonda atufuule ba magezi! III. Ekyokusatu, okuwuula tekulirwawo mirembe gyonna. Tekulijjuza ennaku zaffe zonna: “Eŋŋaano ey'omugaati esekulwa, naye taagiwuulenga bulijjo” (Isaaya 28:28). “Akaseera katono nakuleka, naye n'okusaasira okungi ndikukuuŋŋaanya” (Isaaya 54:7). “Talinenya bulijjo, so talikuuma busungu bwe emirembe gyonna” (Zabbuli 103:9). “Okukaaba kuyinza okusula ekiro, naye essanyu lijja mu makya” (Zabbuli 30:5). Musanyuke, bawala b'ennaku; mukubwe amaanyi, batabani b'obuyinike; mube n'essuubi mu Katonda, kubanga mulimutendereza. Enkuba tetonnya bulijjo, ebire tebidda bulijjo; ennaku n'okusinda biriddukanga. Okuwuula tekwetaagisa mwaka mulamba; emirundi mingi omuggo guwummula. Weebaze Mukama, ggwe emmeeme yange! Aliddayo okuleeta abaawaŋŋangusibwa eka. Okusingira ddala, okubonaabona tekulirwawo mirembe gyonna. Amangu ago tulitwalibwa mu nsi esinga obulungi, gye watali gguuliro oba biwaluzo bya ŋŋaano. Oluusi mpulira eddoboozi ly'omubaka nga likoowoola nti: “Musituke mugende! Mwambale mutwale! Muveemu mu lusiisira ne mu lutalo, mudde nga muwangudde!” Ekiro kisembedde okuggwaako, naye enkya ejja. Obudde bwakya ku nsozi. Olunaku olutaggwaawo lujja. Mujje, mulye emmere yammwe n'essanyu, era mutambule n'omutima ogusanyufu; ensi ekulukuta amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki eri kumpi. Okutuusa obudde lwe bunaakya, mugumire okwagala kw'Omulimi Omukulu, era Mukama yeegulumize mu mmwe. Amiina.

fields.title: Eŋŋaano mu Tterekero
fields.body_html:
Omwana w'Omuntu asiga ensigo ennungi n'obugumiikiriza n'ekigendererwa. Newaakubadde ng'omuddo gukula mu ŋŋaano, Kristo alyawula era akuŋŋaanye ababe. Essuula eno eyanjula amakungula g'ekisa, omulimu gwa bamalayika ogw'essanyu, n'obukuume obutaggwaawo obw'abatuukirivu mu tterekero lya Mukama.

"Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange."—Matayo 13:30 "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Olwo ekigendererwa ky'Omwana w'Omuntu kirituukirira. Yasiga ensigo ennungi, era ku nkomerero alijjuza etterekero lye nayo. Toterebuka— Kristo tajja kunyolwa nnaku. "Aliraba ekibala ky'okubonaabona kwe n'akkuta." Yagenda ng'akaaba, ng'atadde ensigo ey'omuwendo, naye alikomawo ng'ajaguza, ng'aleeta ebinywa bye.

"Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange;" olwo enteekateeka ya Setaani erifa bwereere. Omulabe yajja n'asiga omuddo mu ŋŋaano, ng'asuubira nti eŋŋaano ey'obulimba erizikiriza oba erikosa nnyo eŋŋaano ey'amazima; naye ku nkomerero yalemererwa, kubanga eŋŋaano yakula n'etuuka okukungulwa. Etterekero lya Kristo lirijjula; omuddo tegulitta ŋŋaano. Omubi aliswazibwa.

Mu kukuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano, bamalayika abalungi be baliyambisibwa: "bamalayika be bakunguzi." Kino kyoleka okuwangulwa kwa malayika omubi omukulu. Ye asiga omuddo, ng'agezaako okwonoona amakungula; kale bamalayika abalungi batumibwa okujaguza olw'okulemererwa kwe n'okusanyukira awamu ne Mukama waabwe olw'obuwanguzi bw'omulimu gwa Katonda. Setaani talibaako ky'aganyulwa kinene mu kutaataaganya kwe; alilemererwa mu byonna by'akola, kale ekyokutiisa kirituukirira: "Olyewalula ku lubuto lwo era olirya enfuufu."

Nga bamalayika baweebwa omulimu, ebitonde byonna eby'amagezi bye tumanyi, biyingizibwa mu mulimu gw'ekisa; oba lwa bukyayi oba lwa kutya, okununulibwa kubasikiriza bonna. Buli omu, emirimu gya Katonda egy'ekitalo giyolekebwa; kubanga ebintu bino tebikolerwa mu kyama.

Emirundi mingi twerabira bamalayika. Tuleme kubuusa maaso ku kufaayo kwabwe okw'ekisa gye tuli; balaba Mukama ng'asanyukira okwenenya kwaffe, era basanyukira wamu naye.

Be bakuumi baffe era be babaka ba Mukama ab'okusaasira; batuwanirira tuleme okwesittala, era bwe tufa, batutwala mu maaso ga Mukama waffe. Ekimu ku bisanyusa byaffe kwe kuba nti tuli ba kibiina kya bamalayika ekitabalika; katulowooze ku bo n'okwagala.

Kaakano nnaanya nnyo ku kyawandiikibwa kyange, nga mbuulira kigambo ku kigambo. Kitandika ne "naye," era ekyo kye kigambo eky'okwawukana.

Wetegereze nti omuddo n'eŋŋaano birikula wamu okutuusa ekiseera ky'amakungula lwe kirituuka. Kya nnaku nnyingi eri eŋŋaano endala okukula ng'eriraanye omuddo. Abatatya Katonda bali ng'amaggwa n'ebisaka eri abo abatya Mukama. Emirundi emeka omutima ogutya Katonda gwe gusinda: "Zinsanze nze kubanga ntuula mu Meseki, era mbeera mu weema za Kedali!" Abalabe b'omuntu emirundi mingi basangibwa mu maka ge ye; abo abandimuyambye okusinga be bayinza okumulemesa okusinga; okwogera kwabwe kumuteganya era kumubonyaabonya. Emirundi mingi tekigasa kugezaako kubadduka, kubanga omuddo guganyizibwa mu nteekateeka ya Katonda okukula wamu ne ŋŋaano, era bwe gutyo bwe gulikola okutuusa ku nkomerero.

Abantu abatya Katonda basenguse okugenda mu nsi ez'ewala okuzimba ebibiina by'abatukuvu, naye abakola ebibi balabise ne mu bo. Okugezaako okuggyamu abo abatatya Katonda n'abayigiriza eby'obuwaboya kuvuddeko okuyigganyizibwa n'ebizibu ebirala, era enteekateeka yeeyongedde okulemererwa. Abalala beekwese mu bifo eby'obuntu bwokka okwewala okukemebwa kw'ensi, nga basuubira okufuna obuwanguzi olw'okudduka; guno si gwe mukubo gw'amagezi. Ekigambo kya kaakano kiri nti, "Bikule byombi wamu," naye ekiseera kirituuka okwawukana okw'enkomerero lwe kulibaawo. Olwo, mukyala Omukristaayo omwagalwa, balo taakyakuyigganya.

Mwannyoko omutukuvu, mwannyoko taakyakuduulira. Omukozi omutya Katonda, abatatya Katonda tebaakyakusekerera. "Naye" oyo aliba mulyango gwa kyuma wakati w'abo abatya Katonda n'abo abatamutya; olwo omuddo gulisuulibwa mu muliro, naye Mukama w'amakungula aligamba nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange."

Okwawukana kuno kuteekwa okubaawo; kubanga eŋŋaano n'omuddo bwe bikula wamu ku nsi bireeta obulumi bungi n'okwonoona, era kino tekiryeyongera mu nsi esinga obulungi. Abasajja n'abakazi abatya Katonda bayinza okwagala abaana baabwe abatakyusibwa okubeera nabo mu ggulu; naye kino tekiyinza kubaawo, kubanga Katonda tajja kukkiriza abatukuzibbwa be okwonoonebwa, wadde abagulumizibwa be okukemebwa olw'okubeerawo kw'abatakkiriza. Omuddo guteekwa okuggyibwawo olw'obutuukirivu n'okugasa kwa ŋŋaano. Wandyagadde okuba n'omuddo n'eŋŋaano ebituumiddwa wamu mu tterekero? Ekyo kyandibadde bulimi bubi nnyo. Tebiyinza kukozesebwa bulungi okutuusa lwe biryawulibwa ddala.

Mu ngeri y'emu, abalokoddwa n'abatalokoka bayinza okubeera wamu wano, naye si mu nsi ejja. Ekiragiro kya lwatu: "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mugusibe mu binywa okugwokya, naye mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange."

Ggwe omwonoonyi, oyinza okusuubira okuyingira mu ggulu? Tewali lwe wayagala Katonda wa maama wo, kale alikukkiriza okuyingira mu mpya ze ez'omu ggulu? Tewali lwe weesiga Omulokozi wa kitaawo, ate ng'osuubira okulaba ekitiibwa kye emirembe gyonna? Onooyita mu ggulu n'amalala, ng'ovuma, oba ng'oyimba ennyimba ez'obugwagwa?

Okoowa okusinza ku Lunaku lwa Mukama; olowooza nti Mukama alikkiriza abasinza abatayagala mu yeekaalu ye ey'omu ggulu? Osanga Ssabbiiti ng'ekikooya; oyinza otya okusuubira okuyingira mu kiwummulo kya Katonda eky'olubeerera? Tolina kwegomba mirimu gya mu ggulu, era gyandivumisibwa singa okkirizibwa okugyenyigiramu; kale, "naye" oyo ateekwa okujja, era oteekwa okwawukana ku bantu ba Mukama emirembe gyonna. Oyinza okugumira okwawulibwa ku mikwano egitya Katonda emirembe gyonna?

Okwawukana okwo kuzingiramu enjawulo entiisa ey'ebiribaawo: "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mu binywa okugwokya." Siyinza kukubira kifaananyi kyonna kijjuvu; naye ekinywa bwe kimala okusibibwa, ekifo kyakyo kyokka gwe muliro. Wandidduka okuva mu nnaku eyo yonna. Si nsonga ntono Mukama ow'okwagala gy'ageraageranya n'okumalibwawo omuliro. Tewali bigambo biyinza kutegeeza bulungi entiisa yaakyo. Emirundi mingi twogera ku busungu obugenda okujja; naye mazima tubukendeeza. Yesu omuwombeefu, ow'okwagala, ow'ekisa yagamba ki ng'agamba nti "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mugusibe mu binywa okugwokya"? Lowooza ku njawulo ennene wakati w'ebiribaawo ku bantu ba Mukama n'abagoberezi ba Setaani. Okwokya eŋŋaano? Nedda— "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Eyo mwe basigala nga bakuumiddwa era nga basanyufu emirembe gyonna. Woowe, olwenya olutakoma wakati w'eggulu n'omuliro ogutazikira—ennanga ne bamalayika, okukaaba n'okuluma amannyo! Ani ayinza okupima olwenya wakati w'omutukuvu agulumizibbwa, ayambadde engoye enjeru era atikkiddwa engule ey'obutafa, n'emmeeme egobeddwa emirembe gyonna okuva ku Katonda n'ekitiibwa kye? "Naye" oyo wa ntiisa. Jjukira, gyawula muganda ku muganda we, maama ku mwana, omwami ku mukyala we. "Omu alitwalibwa, omulala n'alekebwa." Era ekitala ekyo bwe kimala okukka, tewaba kwegatta nate. Okwawukana kwa lubeerera.

Naye omuntu ayinza okubuuza nti, "Lwaki enjawulo eyenkana awo?" Kubanga bulijjo wabaddewo enjawulo. Eŋŋaano yasigibwa Omwana w'Omuntu; eŋŋaano ey'obulimba n'esigibwa omulabe. Bulijjo wabaddewo enjawulo mu mpisa—eŋŋaano nnungi, omuddo mubi. Okusooka enjawulo eno eyinza obutalabika, naye eyolekebwa ng'eŋŋaano n'omuddo bikula. Bimera bya njawulo ddala; bwe kityo n'omuntu azaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri n'oyo atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri be bantu ba njawulo ddala. Mpulidde omuntu atazaalidwa mulundi gwakubiri ng'agamba nti mulungi nga bw'ali omuntu atya Katonda; mu kukola bw'atyo, ayolesa amalala ge.

Mazima, mu maaso ga Katonda, enjawulo wakati w'akkiriza n'atakkiriza nnene ng'ey'ekitangaala n'ekizikiza, oba ey'obulamu n'okufa. Omu alina obulamu, omulala talina; enjawulo ya musingi era ya mu makkati.

Woowe, toziluganya na nsonga eno, naye beera eŋŋaano ya Mukama ddala! Tekimala kwetikka linnya lya ŋŋaano—tuteekwa okuba n'obuzaale bwayo. Katonda tasekererwa; tasanyusibwa abo abeeyita Abakristaayo so nga si bo. Toematizibwa kubeera mu bwaŋŋanda bwa kkanisa; noonya okuba mu bumu ne Kristo. Toyogera ku kukkiriza; kukozese. Toyewaana ku bumanyirivu; bufune. Beera eŋŋaano, so si kikoppa. "Naye" ow'entiisa alyeyiringisa ng'ennyanja y'omuliro wakati w'amazima n'obulimba. Ayi Mwoyo Mutukuvu, buli omu ku ffe akyusibwe olw'amaanyi go.

Ekigambo eky'okubiri mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe kiri nti "kuŋŋaanya"—kigambo kya kuŋŋaana. Nga mukisa mungi okukuŋŋaana kuno! Kya ssanyu okuleeta ebibiina bingi okuwulira enjiri; si ssanyu okulaba ennyumba ejjudde abantu, ku nnaku eza wakati ne za Ssabbiiti, nga beetegefu okutambula okuwulira enjiri? Ekyo kikulu; naye okukuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano mu tterekero kwe kw'ekitalo ekisingako. Okukuŋŋaanya kwennyini kusinga okusaasaanya, era nsaba nti Mukama Yesu bulijjo asikirize abantu wano; kubanga si Mwawuzi, naye "gy'ali gye lulijja okukuŋŋaana kw'abantu bonna." Teyagamba nti, "Nange, bwe ndiwanikibwa okuva ku nsi, ndisikiriza abantu bonna gye ndi"?

Wetegereze nti ekibiina mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe kirondebwa era kikuŋŋaanyizibwa abakuŋŋaanya abakugu: "Bamalayika be bakunguzi." Abaweereza tebandisobodde kukola kino bokka, kubanga tebamanyi ŋŋaano yonna ya Mukama era basobola okukola ensobi—abamu nga ba kisa ekisukkiridde, abalala nga bakambwe ennyo. Okusalawo kw'abantu oluusi kuggyamu abatukuvu ne kukkiriza aboonoonyi. Bamalayika bamanyi ebintu bya Mukama waabwe. Bamanyi buli mutukuvu, kubanga baaliwo ng'azaalibwa. Bamalayika bamanyi aboonoonyi lwe beenenya era tebeerabira eyeenenyezza.

Balabye obulamu bw'abakkiriza era babayambye mu ntalo ez'omwoyo. Weewaawo, bamalayika, olw'obusobozi obutukuvu, bategeera abaana ba Kitaffe era tebalimbibwa. Balikuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano yonna ne baleka buli muddo.

Naye bakuŋŋaanyizibwa wansi w'amateeka amakalubo ennyo. Ng'olugero bwe lugamba, omuddo—eŋŋaano ey'obulimba—gusooka kuggyibwawo, olwo abakunguzi ba bamalayika ne bakuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano yokka. Ensigo y'omusota, eyazaalibwa Setaani, yawulibwa okuva ku nsigo ey'obwakabaka, eya Yesu, Omununuzi eyasuubizibwa. Eno y'enjawulo emu; tewali ndala erowoozebwako. Ne singa omuntu atakyusibwa asinga okwagalibwa, ng'ayimiridde mu batukuvu, tandutwalibwa bamalayika kugenda mu ggulu, kubanga ekiragiro kiri nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Ne singa omuntu asinga obwesigwa yandiyimiridde wakati mu kkanisa, ng'ateekeddwako abaŋŋanda n'abaweereza nga bamwegayiririra okusaasirwa, singa teyali mukkiriza, tandiyingidde mu tterekero lya Katonda. Tewali kya njawulo. Bamalayika tebalina kya kulonda; ekiragiro ekitakyukakyuka kiri nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano," era tewali mulala yenna gwe balikuŋŋaanya.

Okukuŋŋaanya kuliva mu bifo eby'ewala ennyo. Eŋŋaano endala eyengera mu bizinga eby'omu Nnyanja ey'Obukiikaddyo, mu Bukyayina, ne mu Buyapani. Endala emera bulungi mu Bufalansa, era ennimiro engazi zikula mu Amerika. Tewali nsi eterimu ŋŋaano ya Katonda ennungi. Eŋŋaano ya Katonda yonna gy'emerera, siyinza kugamba. Waliwo ekitundu ekifisseewo, ng'okulonda kw'ekisa bwe kuli, mu buli ggwanga na bantu; naye bamalayika balikuŋŋaanyiza eŋŋaano ennungi yonna mu tterekero limu.

"Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Abatukuvu balisangibwa mu buli mutindo gw'abantu. Bamalayika baliggya ebirimba ebitono mu mbiri z'abakabaka, n'emiganda emikulu mu bisulo eby'obwavu. Bangi balikuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu maka ag'obwetoowaze ag'omu byalo byaffe n'obubuga obutono, n'abalala balisitulibwa okuva mu nguudo ez'emabega ez'ebibuga byaffe ebinene okutuuka mu kibuga kya Katonda ekikulu. Okuva mu nsonda ezisinga ekizikiza, bamalayika baliggyayo abaana abo ab'obuwoomu n'ekitangaala abatalabanga njuba naye nga balina omutima omulongoofu era nga bamanyi Katonda waabwe. Abakwese n'abatamanyiddwa balireetebwa mu kitangaala, kubanga Mukama amanyi abo ababe, era abakungula be tebalibabuusa.

Kirowoozo kya kitalo nti baliva mu mirembe gyonna. Katusuubire nti kitaffe omusooka, Adamu, aliba eyo, ne maama Kaawa, nga bagoberera ebigere by'omwana waabwe omwagalwa Abeeri, nga beesiga ssaddaaka y'emu. Tulisisinkana Ibulayimu, Isaaka, Yakobo, Musa, Dawudi, Danyeeri, n'abatukuvu bonna abaatuukirira. Nga ssanyu okulaba abatume, abaafiira okukkiriza, n'abazza obuggya! Njagala okulaba Luteeri, Kaluvino, Bunyan, ne Whitefield. Njagala oluyimba lwa kitaffe omukadde omulungi Ryland: "Bonna baliba eyo, abakulu n'abato, Nze omwavu ndikwata mu ngalo Pawulo omutukuvu."

Simanyi bulungi engeri gye kiriba, naye nkakasa nti tuliba n'obumu n'abatukuvu bonna ab'omu mirembe gyonna mu lukuŋŋaana olunene n'ekkanisa ey'ababereberye, abalinnya gaabwe gawandiikiddwa mu ggulu.

Ka kibe nti eŋŋaano yakula ddi oba wa, erikuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero limu—so terikyasaasaanyizibwa nate. Zaakula mu nnimiro ez'enjawulo. Endala zaakula bulungi ku busozi Ababisopo gye bakulaakulanira, n'endala mu ttaka erya wansi Ababatisiti gye beeyongera n'Abamesodisiti gye bakulaakulanira. Naye eŋŋaano bw'emala okuba mu tterekero, tewali ayinza kugamba nnimiro ki ebirimba gye byava.

Olwo, mazima, okusaba kwa Mukama kulifuna okuddibwamu okw'ekitiibwa: "Balyoke babeere bumu." Ensobi zonna nga ziggyibbwawo, obukyamu bwonna nga bugololeddwa era nga busonyiyiddwa, Mukama omu, okukkiriza kumu, n'okubatizibwa kumu birimanyibwa mu bujjuvu, era tewaliba kunyiiza wadde buggya nate. Nga kukuŋŋaana kwa mukisa!

Nga lukuŋŋaana! Abalonde ba Katonda, abasinga obulungi mu mirembe gyonna, ensi be yataasaanira.

Sandyagadde kubulawo. Ne singa tewaliwo muliro ogutazikira, kyandibadde muliro okubula ku kibiina ekyenkanidde awo eky'omu ggulu. Ne awatali kukaaba na kuluma mannyo, kyandibadde kya ntiisa okubula ku kubeerawo kwa Mukama, essanyu ery'okumutendereza emirembe gyonna, n'essanyu ery'okusisinkana ab'ekitiibwa abasinga abaali bawangaalako. Wakati mu mpaka ez'omulembe, nze, eyalabise ng'omusajja ow'entalo, njagala nnyo okuwummula okw'omukisa emmeeme zonna ez'omwoyo gye zirisenderezebwa mu bumu obutaggwaawo mu maaso g'entebe ya Katonda n'ey'Omwana gw'Endiga. Woowe, singa twali bonna nga tuli bulungi, tulyoke twegatte mu mwoyo gumu!

Mu kyawandiikibwa, ekigambo ekiddako kya kulaga. Nkiddeko dda. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano."

Tewali kirala okuggyako "eŋŋaano" ekiyinza okuyingira mu maka ga Mukama. Mumpe emitima gyammwe nga mbakubiriza okwekebejja okunoonyereza okumala ebbanga ttono. Eŋŋaano yasigibwa Mukama. Ggwe wasigibwa Mukama? Munnange, bw'oba olina eddiini yonna, wagifuna otya? Weesiga wekka? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, tegasa. Eŋŋaano ey'amazima yasigibwa Omwana w'Omuntu. Ggwe wasigibwa Mukama? Omwoyo wa Katonda yasimba obulamu obutaggwaawo mu mutima gwo? Bwava mu mukono ogwo ogwakomererwa ku musaalaba? Yesu bwe bulamu bwo? Obulamu bwo butandikira era ne bukoma ku ye? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, kirungi.

Eŋŋaano esigibwa Mukama era y'efaayibwako. Eŋŋaano yeetaaga okulabirirwa okunene. Omulimi tafunamu kantu bw'ateegendereza kugirabirira. Ggwe oli wansi w'okulabirira kwa Mukama? Akukuuma? Kya mazima eri emmeeme yo nti: "Nze, Mukama, ngikuuma; ngifukirira buli kaseera: waleme kubaawo agyonoona, ngikuuma emisana n'ekiro"? Ofuna okukuumibwa okwenkanidde awo? Ddamu mu bwesimbu, ku lw'emmeeme yo.

Ekiddako, eŋŋaano ya mugaso, kirabo okuva eri Katonda olw'okuganyula abantu. Eŋŋaano ey'obulimba teyalina ky'egasa; yasobola kuliisa ngulube zokka, n'eziyuuguumya ng'eziyingiddwa omwenge. Ggwe oli omu ku abo abalamu obulungi mu bantu—ng'emmere eri ensi, nti abantu bwe bakkiriza ekyokulabirako kyo, okuyigiriza kwo, n'obulamu bwo, baweebwa omukisa? Salawo oba oli mulungi oba wa kabi mu bulamu ne mu buyinza bwo.

"Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Katonda ateekwa okuteeka mu ggwe obulungi, ekisa, amaanyi, n'omugaso, oba toolibe ŋŋaano esaanira okukuŋŋaanyizibwa bamalayika. Eŋŋaano y'ekimera ekisinga okwesigama ku kirala mu bimera byonna. Sirina lwe nawulira nnimiro ya ŋŋaano eyakula n'eyengera awatali kulabirira kwa mulimi.

Ebirimba ebimu biyinza okulabika oluvannyuma lw'amakungula, naye sirina lwe nawulira nsenyi zibisse ŋŋaano etaasigibwa.

Tewali ŋŋaano awatali muntu, era tewali kisa awatali Kristo. Okubeerawo kwaffe tukuwa Kitaffe, omulimi. Naye newaakubadde ng'eyesigama bw'etyo, eŋŋaano erina ekitiibwa n'ekissa; bwe kityo, abantu abatya Katonda bassibwamu ekitiibwa abo ab'okutegeera. Tetuli kantu awatali Kristo, naye nga tuli naye tujjudde ekitiibwa. Woowe, okuba mu abo ensi be ekuumibwa, abalungi ab'ensi, abatukuvu mwe basanyukira. Katonda akyewale tuleme kubeera mu muddo omubi ogutaliimu mugaso!

Ekisembayo, ekigambo eky'ekifo eky'omugendo: "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Enkola ey'okukuŋŋaanya erimalirizibwa ku lunaku olw'omusango, naye egenda mu maaso buli lunaku. Abatukuvu bakuŋŋaanyizibwa bulijjo, nga bagenda eri eggulu ne kaakano. Nsanyuka okuwulira nti abaŋŋanda abaafa aba kkanisa yange basanyukira okukungulwa. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda, abantu baffe bafa bulungi. Okubeera obulungi kwe kusinga, naye okufa obulungi emirundi mingi kwe kukakasa n'amaanyi amasingira ddala okutya Katonda okw'amazima. Ensi ewulira amaanyi ag'okufa okw'obuwanguzi.

Buli ssaawa, abatukuvu bakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero. Eyo gye baagala okubeera. Tetuwulira nnaku ku kukuŋŋaanya kuno, kubanga twagala okuterekebwa obulungi Mukama waffe. Singa eŋŋaano mu nnimiro yandyogedde, buli kirimba kyandigambye nti: "Ekiruubirirwa kye tubeerera ne tukulira ye tterekero, etterekero ery'empeke." Olw'ekigendererwa kino omusanvu n'enjuba, omusulo n'enkuba, byonna bikola. Buli nkola ey'eŋŋaano etambulira eri etterekero ery'empeke. Bwe kityo, buli kintu kiri mu ffe kikolera eri eggulu—ekifo eky'okukuŋŋaana, ekibiina ky'abatuukirivu, okulaba amaaso g'Omununuzi waffe. Okufa kwaffe tekuleeta buyombo; kutuukiriza oluyimba lw'obulamu bwaffe. Eri eŋŋaano, etterekero kifo kya bukuume. Temuli buku, musanvu, bbugumu, ekyeeya, wadde obunnyogovu ng'emala okuyingira. Akabi konna kayiseewo. Etuuse ku butuukirivu, eyeeyanjudde omulimu gw'omulimi, era eterekeddwa obulungi. Woowe, olunaku olwasuubirwa ebbanga eddene, tandika! Woowe, abooluganda, nga mukisa nnyo bwe tutuuka ku bukulu, Kristo n'alaba mu ffe ekibala ky'okubonaabona kw'emmeeme ye.

Nsanyukira okulowooza ku ggulu ng'etterekero lye—nga kirowoozo! Olulimi lwavu kubanga tuteekwa okuyita amaka ga Kitaffe, ekifo Yesu w'abeera, etterekero. Eggulu lye lubiri lwa Kabaka, naye gye tuli tterekero, ekifo eky'obukuume, eky'okuwummula, n'eky'obutebenkevu. Ge maka ga Kristo, era tuli mu kwengera olw'ago. Kirowoozeeko n'essanyu erisukkiridde; kubanga okukuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero kwe kukomawo eka okw'amakungula. Abantu tebakaaba ku makungula ag'ensi, so tebagoberera binywa na maziga. Bakuba mu ngalo, bazina, ne baleekaana olw'essanyu. Katukole bwe tutyo eri abo abamaze okuterekebwa. N'ennyimba enzito era ennungi, katuyimbe okwetooloola amalaalo gaabwe.

Obukaawu bw'okufa buyiseewo. Jjukira ekitiibwa kyabwe, era sanyuka ng'omukazi eyazadde omwana, "atakyajjukira nnaku, olw'essanyu nti omuntu azaaliddwa mu nsi." Emmeeme endala etandika okuyimba mu ggulu—lwaki mukaaba, mmwe abasika b'obutafa? Essanyu ery'olubeerera lye kuzaalibwa okuddirira obulumi bw'okufa? Kale ba mukisa abo abafa. Ekitiibwa kye kivaamu ekyo ekijjuza amaka gaffe okukungubaga? Weebaze Katonda olw'okufiirwa, olw'okwawukana okw'ennaku. Agulumizza abaagalwa baffe okubatwala waggulu mu bbanga! Abawadde omukisa okusukka byonna bye twandisabye oba bye twandirowoozezza, ng'abaggya mu nsi eno ekooya okubagalamiza mu kifuba kye emirembe gyonna. Erinnya lye litenderezebwe, ne bwe kiba nga si lwa kirala okuggyako kino.

Wandyagadde okukuuma kitaawo omukadde wano, ng'ajjudde obulumi n'obunafu? Mukazi wo omwagalwa, ng'agumira okubonaabona? Balo n'omuggya ku ngule ey'obutafa? Omwana wo okudda ku nsi okuva mu ssanyu? Nedda.

Twegomba okuddayo eka ffennyini, naye ku bikwata ku abo abaafa, tusanyukira mu maaso ga Mukama nga ku makungula. "Kale mugumyaganenga na bigambo bino."

ENKOMERERO
fields.body_text: Omwana w'Omuntu asiga ensigo ennungi n'obugumiikiriza n'ekigendererwa. Newaakubadde ng'omuddo gukula mu ŋŋaano, Kristo alyawula era akuŋŋaanye ababe. Essuula eno eyanjula amakungula g'ekisa, omulimu gwa bamalayika ogw'essanyu, n'obukuume obutaggwaawo obw'abatuukirivu mu tterekero lya Mukama. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange."—Matayo 13:30 "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Olwo ekigendererwa ky'Omwana w'Omuntu kirituukirira. Yasiga ensigo ennungi, era ku nkomerero alijjuza etterekero lye nayo. Toterebuka— Kristo tajja kunyolwa nnaku. "Aliraba ekibala ky'okubonaabona kwe n'akkuta." Yagenda ng'akaaba, ng'atadde ensigo ey'omuwendo, naye alikomawo ng'ajaguza, ng'aleeta ebinywa bye. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange;" olwo enteekateeka ya Setaani erifa bwereere. Omulabe yajja n'asiga omuddo mu ŋŋaano, ng'asuubira nti eŋŋaano ey'obulimba erizikiriza oba erikosa nnyo eŋŋaano ey'amazima; naye ku nkomerero yalemererwa, kubanga eŋŋaano yakula n'etuuka okukungulwa. Etterekero lya Kristo lirijjula; omuddo tegulitta ŋŋaano. Omubi aliswazibwa. Mu kukuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano, bamalayika abalungi be baliyambisibwa: "bamalayika be bakunguzi." Kino kyoleka okuwangulwa kwa malayika omubi omukulu. Ye asiga omuddo, ng'agezaako okwonoona amakungula; kale bamalayika abalungi batumibwa okujaguza olw'okulemererwa kwe n'okusanyukira awamu ne Mukama waabwe olw'obuwanguzi bw'omulimu gwa Katonda. Setaani talibaako ky'aganyulwa kinene mu kutaataaganya kwe; alilemererwa mu byonna by'akola, kale ekyokutiisa kirituukirira: "Olyewalula ku lubuto lwo era olirya enfuufu." Nga bamalayika baweebwa omulimu, ebitonde byonna eby'amagezi bye tumanyi, biyingizibwa mu mulimu gw'ekisa; oba lwa bukyayi oba lwa kutya, okununulibwa kubasikiriza bonna. Buli omu, emirimu gya Katonda egy'ekitalo giyolekebwa; kubanga ebintu bino tebikolerwa mu kyama. Emirundi mingi twerabira bamalayika. Tuleme kubuusa maaso ku kufaayo kwabwe okw'ekisa gye tuli; balaba Mukama ng'asanyukira okwenenya kwaffe, era basanyukira wamu naye. Be bakuumi baffe era be babaka ba Mukama ab'okusaasira; batuwanirira tuleme okwesittala, era bwe tufa, batutwala mu maaso ga Mukama waffe. Ekimu ku bisanyusa byaffe kwe kuba nti tuli ba kibiina kya bamalayika ekitabalika; katulowooze ku bo n'okwagala. Kaakano nnaanya nnyo ku kyawandiikibwa kyange, nga mbuulira kigambo ku kigambo. Kitandika ne "naye," era ekyo kye kigambo eky'okwawukana. Wetegereze nti omuddo n'eŋŋaano birikula wamu okutuusa ekiseera ky'amakungula lwe kirituuka. Kya nnaku nnyingi eri eŋŋaano endala okukula ng'eriraanye omuddo. Abatatya Katonda bali ng'amaggwa n'ebisaka eri abo abatya Mukama. Emirundi emeka omutima ogutya Katonda gwe gusinda: "Zinsanze nze kubanga ntuula mu Meseki, era mbeera mu weema za Kedali!" Abalabe b'omuntu emirundi mingi basangibwa mu maka ge ye; abo abandimuyambye okusinga be bayinza okumulemesa okusinga; okwogera kwabwe kumuteganya era kumubonyaabonya. Emirundi mingi tekigasa kugezaako kubadduka, kubanga omuddo guganyizibwa mu nteekateeka ya Katonda okukula wamu ne ŋŋaano, era bwe gutyo bwe gulikola okutuusa ku nkomerero. Abantu abatya Katonda basenguse okugenda mu nsi ez'ewala okuzimba ebibiina by'abatukuvu, naye abakola ebibi balabise ne mu bo. Okugezaako okuggyamu abo abatatya Katonda n'abayigiriza eby'obuwaboya kuvuddeko okuyigganyizibwa n'ebizibu ebirala, era enteekateeka yeeyongedde okulemererwa. Abalala beekwese mu bifo eby'obuntu bwokka okwewala okukemebwa kw'ensi, nga basuubira okufuna obuwanguzi olw'okudduka; guno si gwe mukubo gw'amagezi. Ekigambo kya kaakano kiri nti, "Bikule byombi wamu," naye ekiseera kirituuka okwawukana okw'enkomerero lwe kulibaawo. Olwo, mukyala Omukristaayo omwagalwa, balo taakyakuyigganya. Mwannyoko omutukuvu, mwannyoko taakyakuduulira. Omukozi omutya Katonda, abatatya Katonda tebaakyakusekerera. "Naye" oyo aliba mulyango gwa kyuma wakati w'abo abatya Katonda n'abo abatamutya; olwo omuddo gulisuulibwa mu muliro, naye Mukama w'amakungula aligamba nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Okwawukana kuno kuteekwa okubaawo; kubanga eŋŋaano n'omuddo bwe bikula wamu ku nsi bireeta obulumi bungi n'okwonoona, era kino tekiryeyongera mu nsi esinga obulungi. Abasajja n'abakazi abatya Katonda bayinza okwagala abaana baabwe abatakyusibwa okubeera nabo mu ggulu; naye kino tekiyinza kubaawo, kubanga Katonda tajja kukkiriza abatukuzibbwa be okwonoonebwa, wadde abagulumizibwa be okukemebwa olw'okubeerawo kw'abatakkiriza. Omuddo guteekwa okuggyibwawo olw'obutuukirivu n'okugasa kwa ŋŋaano. Wandyagadde okuba n'omuddo n'eŋŋaano ebituumiddwa wamu mu tterekero? Ekyo kyandibadde bulimi bubi nnyo. Tebiyinza kukozesebwa bulungi okutuusa lwe biryawulibwa ddala. Mu ngeri y'emu, abalokoddwa n'abatalokoka bayinza okubeera wamu wano, naye si mu nsi ejja. Ekiragiro kya lwatu: "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mugusibe mu binywa okugwokya, naye mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Ggwe omwonoonyi, oyinza okusuubira okuyingira mu ggulu? Tewali lwe wayagala Katonda wa maama wo, kale alikukkiriza okuyingira mu mpya ze ez'omu ggulu? Tewali lwe weesiga Omulokozi wa kitaawo, ate ng'osuubira okulaba ekitiibwa kye emirembe gyonna? Onooyita mu ggulu n'amalala, ng'ovuma, oba ng'oyimba ennyimba ez'obugwagwa? Okoowa okusinza ku Lunaku lwa Mukama; olowooza nti Mukama alikkiriza abasinza abatayagala mu yeekaalu ye ey'omu ggulu? Osanga Ssabbiiti ng'ekikooya; oyinza otya okusuubira okuyingira mu kiwummulo kya Katonda eky'olubeerera? Tolina kwegomba mirimu gya mu ggulu, era gyandivumisibwa singa okkirizibwa okugyenyigiramu; kale, "naye" oyo ateekwa okujja, era oteekwa okwawukana ku bantu ba Mukama emirembe gyonna. Oyinza okugumira okwawulibwa ku mikwano egitya Katonda emirembe gyonna? Okwawukana okwo kuzingiramu enjawulo entiisa ey'ebiribaawo: "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mu binywa okugwokya." Siyinza kukubira kifaananyi kyonna kijjuvu; naye ekinywa bwe kimala okusibibwa, ekifo kyakyo kyokka gwe muliro. Wandidduka okuva mu nnaku eyo yonna. Si nsonga ntono Mukama ow'okwagala gy'ageraageranya n'okumalibwawo omuliro. Tewali bigambo biyinza kutegeeza bulungi entiisa yaakyo. Emirundi mingi twogera ku busungu obugenda okujja; naye mazima tubukendeeza. Yesu omuwombeefu, ow'okwagala, ow'ekisa yagamba ki ng'agamba nti "Mukuŋŋaanye omuddo mugusibe mu binywa okugwokya"? Lowooza ku njawulo ennene wakati w'ebiribaawo ku bantu ba Mukama n'abagoberezi ba Setaani. Okwokya eŋŋaano? Nedda— "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Eyo mwe basigala nga bakuumiddwa era nga basanyufu emirembe gyonna. Woowe, olwenya olutakoma wakati w'eggulu n'omuliro ogutazikira—ennanga ne bamalayika, okukaaba n'okuluma amannyo! Ani ayinza okupima olwenya wakati w'omutukuvu agulumizibbwa, ayambadde engoye enjeru era atikkiddwa engule ey'obutafa, n'emmeeme egobeddwa emirembe gyonna okuva ku Katonda n'ekitiibwa kye? "Naye" oyo wa ntiisa. Jjukira, gyawula muganda ku muganda we, maama ku mwana, omwami ku mukyala we. "Omu alitwalibwa, omulala n'alekebwa." Era ekitala ekyo bwe kimala okukka, tewaba kwegatta nate. Okwawukana kwa lubeerera. Naye omuntu ayinza okubuuza nti, "Lwaki enjawulo eyenkana awo?" Kubanga bulijjo wabaddewo enjawulo. Eŋŋaano yasigibwa Omwana w'Omuntu; eŋŋaano ey'obulimba n'esigibwa omulabe. Bulijjo wabaddewo enjawulo mu mpisa—eŋŋaano nnungi, omuddo mubi. Okusooka enjawulo eno eyinza obutalabika, naye eyolekebwa ng'eŋŋaano n'omuddo bikula. Bimera bya njawulo ddala; bwe kityo n'omuntu azaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri n'oyo atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri be bantu ba njawulo ddala. Mpulidde omuntu atazaalidwa mulundi gwakubiri ng'agamba nti mulungi nga bw'ali omuntu atya Katonda; mu kukola bw'atyo, ayolesa amalala ge. Mazima, mu maaso ga Katonda, enjawulo wakati w'akkiriza n'atakkiriza nnene ng'ey'ekitangaala n'ekizikiza, oba ey'obulamu n'okufa. Omu alina obulamu, omulala talina; enjawulo ya musingi era ya mu makkati. Woowe, toziluganya na nsonga eno, naye beera eŋŋaano ya Mukama ddala! Tekimala kwetikka linnya lya ŋŋaano—tuteekwa okuba n'obuzaale bwayo. Katonda tasekererwa; tasanyusibwa abo abeeyita Abakristaayo so nga si bo. Toematizibwa kubeera mu bwaŋŋanda bwa kkanisa; noonya okuba mu bumu ne Kristo. Toyogera ku kukkiriza; kukozese. Toyewaana ku bumanyirivu; bufune. Beera eŋŋaano, so si kikoppa. "Naye" ow'entiisa alyeyiringisa ng'ennyanja y'omuliro wakati w'amazima n'obulimba. Ayi Mwoyo Mutukuvu, buli omu ku ffe akyusibwe olw'amaanyi go. Ekigambo eky'okubiri mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe kiri nti "kuŋŋaanya"—kigambo kya kuŋŋaana. Nga mukisa mungi okukuŋŋaana kuno! Kya ssanyu okuleeta ebibiina bingi okuwulira enjiri; si ssanyu okulaba ennyumba ejjudde abantu, ku nnaku eza wakati ne za Ssabbiiti, nga beetegefu okutambula okuwulira enjiri? Ekyo kikulu; naye okukuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano mu tterekero kwe kw'ekitalo ekisingako. Okukuŋŋaanya kwennyini kusinga okusaasaanya, era nsaba nti Mukama Yesu bulijjo asikirize abantu wano; kubanga si Mwawuzi, naye "gy'ali gye lulijja okukuŋŋaana kw'abantu bonna." Teyagamba nti, "Nange, bwe ndiwanikibwa okuva ku nsi, ndisikiriza abantu bonna gye ndi"? Wetegereze nti ekibiina mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe kirondebwa era kikuŋŋaanyizibwa abakuŋŋaanya abakugu: "Bamalayika be bakunguzi." Abaweereza tebandisobodde kukola kino bokka, kubanga tebamanyi ŋŋaano yonna ya Mukama era basobola okukola ensobi—abamu nga ba kisa ekisukkiridde, abalala nga bakambwe ennyo. Okusalawo kw'abantu oluusi kuggyamu abatukuvu ne kukkiriza aboonoonyi. Bamalayika bamanyi ebintu bya Mukama waabwe. Bamanyi buli mutukuvu, kubanga baaliwo ng'azaalibwa. Bamalayika bamanyi aboonoonyi lwe beenenya era tebeerabira eyeenenyezza. Balabye obulamu bw'abakkiriza era babayambye mu ntalo ez'omwoyo. Weewaawo, bamalayika, olw'obusobozi obutukuvu, bategeera abaana ba Kitaffe era tebalimbibwa. Balikuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano yonna ne baleka buli muddo. Naye bakuŋŋaanyizibwa wansi w'amateeka amakalubo ennyo. Ng'olugero bwe lugamba, omuddo—eŋŋaano ey'obulimba—gusooka kuggyibwawo, olwo abakunguzi ba bamalayika ne bakuŋŋaanya eŋŋaano yokka. Ensigo y'omusota, eyazaalibwa Setaani, yawulibwa okuva ku nsigo ey'obwakabaka, eya Yesu, Omununuzi eyasuubizibwa. Eno y'enjawulo emu; tewali ndala erowoozebwako. Ne singa omuntu atakyusibwa asinga okwagalibwa, ng'ayimiridde mu batukuvu, tandutwalibwa bamalayika kugenda mu ggulu, kubanga ekiragiro kiri nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Ne singa omuntu asinga obwesigwa yandiyimiridde wakati mu kkanisa, ng'ateekeddwako abaŋŋanda n'abaweereza nga bamwegayiririra okusaasirwa, singa teyali mukkiriza, tandiyingidde mu tterekero lya Katonda. Tewali kya njawulo. Bamalayika tebalina kya kulonda; ekiragiro ekitakyukakyuka kiri nti, "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano," era tewali mulala yenna gwe balikuŋŋaanya. Okukuŋŋaanya kuliva mu bifo eby'ewala ennyo. Eŋŋaano endala eyengera mu bizinga eby'omu Nnyanja ey'Obukiikaddyo, mu Bukyayina, ne mu Buyapani. Endala emera bulungi mu Bufalansa, era ennimiro engazi zikula mu Amerika. Tewali nsi eterimu ŋŋaano ya Katonda ennungi. Eŋŋaano ya Katonda yonna gy'emerera, siyinza kugamba. Waliwo ekitundu ekifisseewo, ng'okulonda kw'ekisa bwe kuli, mu buli ggwanga na bantu; naye bamalayika balikuŋŋaanyiza eŋŋaano ennungi yonna mu tterekero limu. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Abatukuvu balisangibwa mu buli mutindo gw'abantu. Bamalayika baliggya ebirimba ebitono mu mbiri z'abakabaka, n'emiganda emikulu mu bisulo eby'obwavu. Bangi balikuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu maka ag'obwetoowaze ag'omu byalo byaffe n'obubuga obutono, n'abalala balisitulibwa okuva mu nguudo ez'emabega ez'ebibuga byaffe ebinene okutuuka mu kibuga kya Katonda ekikulu. Okuva mu nsonda ezisinga ekizikiza, bamalayika baliggyayo abaana abo ab'obuwoomu n'ekitangaala abatalabanga njuba naye nga balina omutima omulongoofu era nga bamanyi Katonda waabwe. Abakwese n'abatamanyiddwa balireetebwa mu kitangaala, kubanga Mukama amanyi abo ababe, era abakungula be tebalibabuusa. Kirowoozo kya kitalo nti baliva mu mirembe gyonna. Katusuubire nti kitaffe omusooka, Adamu, aliba eyo, ne maama Kaawa, nga bagoberera ebigere by'omwana waabwe omwagalwa Abeeri, nga beesiga ssaddaaka y'emu. Tulisisinkana Ibulayimu, Isaaka, Yakobo, Musa, Dawudi, Danyeeri, n'abatukuvu bonna abaatuukirira. Nga ssanyu okulaba abatume, abaafiira okukkiriza, n'abazza obuggya! Njagala okulaba Luteeri, Kaluvino, Bunyan, ne Whitefield. Njagala oluyimba lwa kitaffe omukadde omulungi Ryland: "Bonna baliba eyo, abakulu n'abato, Nze omwavu ndikwata mu ngalo Pawulo omutukuvu." Simanyi bulungi engeri gye kiriba, naye nkakasa nti tuliba n'obumu n'abatukuvu bonna ab'omu mirembe gyonna mu lukuŋŋaana olunene n'ekkanisa ey'ababereberye, abalinnya gaabwe gawandiikiddwa mu ggulu. Ka kibe nti eŋŋaano yakula ddi oba wa, erikuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero limu—so terikyasaasaanyizibwa nate. Zaakula mu nnimiro ez'enjawulo. Endala zaakula bulungi ku busozi Ababisopo gye bakulaakulanira, n'endala mu ttaka erya wansi Ababatisiti gye beeyongera n'Abamesodisiti gye bakulaakulanira. Naye eŋŋaano bw'emala okuba mu tterekero, tewali ayinza kugamba nnimiro ki ebirimba gye byava. Olwo, mazima, okusaba kwa Mukama kulifuna okuddibwamu okw'ekitiibwa: "Balyoke babeere bumu." Ensobi zonna nga ziggyibbwawo, obukyamu bwonna nga bugololeddwa era nga busonyiyiddwa, Mukama omu, okukkiriza kumu, n'okubatizibwa kumu birimanyibwa mu bujjuvu, era tewaliba kunyiiza wadde buggya nate. Nga kukuŋŋaana kwa mukisa! Nga lukuŋŋaana! Abalonde ba Katonda, abasinga obulungi mu mirembe gyonna, ensi be yataasaanira. Sandyagadde kubulawo. Ne singa tewaliwo muliro ogutazikira, kyandibadde muliro okubula ku kibiina ekyenkanidde awo eky'omu ggulu. Ne awatali kukaaba na kuluma mannyo, kyandibadde kya ntiisa okubula ku kubeerawo kwa Mukama, essanyu ery'okumutendereza emirembe gyonna, n'essanyu ery'okusisinkana ab'ekitiibwa abasinga abaali bawangaalako. Wakati mu mpaka ez'omulembe, nze, eyalabise ng'omusajja ow'entalo, njagala nnyo okuwummula okw'omukisa emmeeme zonna ez'omwoyo gye zirisenderezebwa mu bumu obutaggwaawo mu maaso g'entebe ya Katonda n'ey'Omwana gw'Endiga. Woowe, singa twali bonna nga tuli bulungi, tulyoke twegatte mu mwoyo gumu! Mu kyawandiikibwa, ekigambo ekiddako kya kulaga. Nkiddeko dda. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Tewali kirala okuggyako "eŋŋaano" ekiyinza okuyingira mu maka ga Mukama. Mumpe emitima gyammwe nga mbakubiriza okwekebejja okunoonyereza okumala ebbanga ttono. Eŋŋaano yasigibwa Mukama. Ggwe wasigibwa Mukama? Munnange, bw'oba olina eddiini yonna, wagifuna otya? Weesiga wekka? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, tegasa. Eŋŋaano ey'amazima yasigibwa Omwana w'Omuntu. Ggwe wasigibwa Mukama? Omwoyo wa Katonda yasimba obulamu obutaggwaawo mu mutima gwo? Bwava mu mukono ogwo ogwakomererwa ku musaalaba? Yesu bwe bulamu bwo? Obulamu bwo butandikira era ne bukoma ku ye? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, kirungi. Eŋŋaano esigibwa Mukama era y'efaayibwako. Eŋŋaano yeetaaga okulabirirwa okunene. Omulimi tafunamu kantu bw'ateegendereza kugirabirira. Ggwe oli wansi w'okulabirira kwa Mukama? Akukuuma? Kya mazima eri emmeeme yo nti: "Nze, Mukama, ngikuuma; ngifukirira buli kaseera: waleme kubaawo agyonoona, ngikuuma emisana n'ekiro"? Ofuna okukuumibwa okwenkanidde awo? Ddamu mu bwesimbu, ku lw'emmeeme yo. Ekiddako, eŋŋaano ya mugaso, kirabo okuva eri Katonda olw'okuganyula abantu. Eŋŋaano ey'obulimba teyalina ky'egasa; yasobola kuliisa ngulube zokka, n'eziyuuguumya ng'eziyingiddwa omwenge. Ggwe oli omu ku abo abalamu obulungi mu bantu—ng'emmere eri ensi, nti abantu bwe bakkiriza ekyokulabirako kyo, okuyigiriza kwo, n'obulamu bwo, baweebwa omukisa? Salawo oba oli mulungi oba wa kabi mu bulamu ne mu buyinza bwo. "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano." Katonda ateekwa okuteeka mu ggwe obulungi, ekisa, amaanyi, n'omugaso, oba toolibe ŋŋaano esaanira okukuŋŋaanyizibwa bamalayika. Eŋŋaano y'ekimera ekisinga okwesigama ku kirala mu bimera byonna. Sirina lwe nawulira nnimiro ya ŋŋaano eyakula n'eyengera awatali kulabirira kwa mulimi. Ebirimba ebimu biyinza okulabika oluvannyuma lw'amakungula, naye sirina lwe nawulira nsenyi zibisse ŋŋaano etaasigibwa. Tewali ŋŋaano awatali muntu, era tewali kisa awatali Kristo. Okubeerawo kwaffe tukuwa Kitaffe, omulimi. Naye newaakubadde ng'eyesigama bw'etyo, eŋŋaano erina ekitiibwa n'ekissa; bwe kityo, abantu abatya Katonda bassibwamu ekitiibwa abo ab'okutegeera. Tetuli kantu awatali Kristo, naye nga tuli naye tujjudde ekitiibwa. Woowe, okuba mu abo ensi be ekuumibwa, abalungi ab'ensi, abatukuvu mwe basanyukira. Katonda akyewale tuleme kubeera mu muddo omubi ogutaliimu mugaso! Ekisembayo, ekigambo eky'ekifo eky'omugendo: "Mukuŋŋaanye eŋŋaano mugiteeke mu tterekero lyange." Enkola ey'okukuŋŋaanya erimalirizibwa ku lunaku olw'omusango, naye egenda mu maaso buli lunaku. Abatukuvu bakuŋŋaanyizibwa bulijjo, nga bagenda eri eggulu ne kaakano. Nsanyuka okuwulira nti abaŋŋanda abaafa aba kkanisa yange basanyukira okukungulwa. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda, abantu baffe bafa bulungi. Okubeera obulungi kwe kusinga, naye okufa obulungi emirundi mingi kwe kukakasa n'amaanyi amasingira ddala okutya Katonda okw'amazima. Ensi ewulira amaanyi ag'okufa okw'obuwanguzi. Buli ssaawa, abatukuvu bakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero. Eyo gye baagala okubeera. Tetuwulira nnaku ku kukuŋŋaanya kuno, kubanga twagala okuterekebwa obulungi Mukama waffe. Singa eŋŋaano mu nnimiro yandyogedde, buli kirimba kyandigambye nti: "Ekiruubirirwa kye tubeerera ne tukulira ye tterekero, etterekero ery'empeke." Olw'ekigendererwa kino omusanvu n'enjuba, omusulo n'enkuba, byonna bikola. Buli nkola ey'eŋŋaano etambulira eri etterekero ery'empeke. Bwe kityo, buli kintu kiri mu ffe kikolera eri eggulu—ekifo eky'okukuŋŋaana, ekibiina ky'abatuukirivu, okulaba amaaso g'Omununuzi waffe. Okufa kwaffe tekuleeta buyombo; kutuukiriza oluyimba lw'obulamu bwaffe. Eri eŋŋaano, etterekero kifo kya bukuume. Temuli buku, musanvu, bbugumu, ekyeeya, wadde obunnyogovu ng'emala okuyingira. Akabi konna kayiseewo. Etuuse ku butuukirivu, eyeeyanjudde omulimu gw'omulimi, era eterekeddwa obulungi. Woowe, olunaku olwasuubirwa ebbanga eddene, tandika! Woowe, abooluganda, nga mukisa nnyo bwe tutuuka ku bukulu, Kristo n'alaba mu ffe ekibala ky'okubonaabona kw'emmeeme ye. Nsanyukira okulowooza ku ggulu ng'etterekero lye—nga kirowoozo! Olulimi lwavu kubanga tuteekwa okuyita amaka ga Kitaffe, ekifo Yesu w'abeera, etterekero. Eggulu lye lubiri lwa Kabaka, naye gye tuli tterekero, ekifo eky'obukuume, eky'okuwummula, n'eky'obutebenkevu. Ge maka ga Kristo, era tuli mu kwengera olw'ago. Kirowoozeeko n'essanyu erisukkiridde; kubanga okukuŋŋaanyizibwa mu tterekero kwe kukomawo eka okw'amakungula. Abantu tebakaaba ku makungula ag'ensi, so tebagoberera binywa na maziga. Bakuba mu ngalo, bazina, ne baleekaana olw'essanyu. Katukole bwe tutyo eri abo abamaze okuterekebwa. N'ennyimba enzito era ennungi, katuyimbe okwetooloola amalaalo gaabwe. Obukaawu bw'okufa buyiseewo. Jjukira ekitiibwa kyabwe, era sanyuka ng'omukazi eyazadde omwana, "atakyajjukira nnaku, olw'essanyu nti omuntu azaaliddwa mu nsi." Emmeeme endala etandika okuyimba mu ggulu—lwaki mukaaba, mmwe abasika b'obutafa? Essanyu ery'olubeerera lye kuzaalibwa okuddirira obulumi bw'okufa? Kale ba mukisa abo abafa. Ekitiibwa kye kivaamu ekyo ekijjuza amaka gaffe okukungubaga? Weebaze Katonda olw'okufiirwa, olw'okwawukana okw'ennaku. Agulumizza abaagalwa baffe okubatwala waggulu mu bbanga! Abawadde omukisa okusukka byonna bye twandisabye oba bye twandirowoozezza, ng'abaggya mu nsi eno ekooya okubagalamiza mu kifuba kye emirembe gyonna. Erinnya lye litenderezebwe, ne bwe kiba nga si lwa kirala okuggyako kino. Wandyagadde okukuuma kitaawo omukadde wano, ng'ajjudde obulumi n'obunafu? Mukazi wo omwagalwa, ng'agumira okubonaabona? Balo n'omuggya ku ngule ey'obutafa? Omwana wo okudda ku nsi okuva mu ssanyu? Nedda. Twegomba okuddayo eka ffennyini, naye ku bikwata ku abo abaafa, tusanyukira mu maaso ga Mukama nga ku makungula. "Kale mugumyaganenga na bigambo bino." ENKOMERERO
